qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Beukering-Huijbregts over ‘Vanaf morgen weer subsidie voor opleiding, maar niet als je boa wil worden’

An MP asked why STAP training subsidies exclude jobs in shortage sectors such as boa and childcare, and raised concerns about dubious courses, pricing and the scope of the scheme. The minister answered that employers are responsible for mandatory training, promised to explore compensation options before summer, and described stricter measures and ongoing investigations by the Toetsingskamer.
The cabinet is exploring whether and how we can address this within the STAP scheme.
Het kabinet verkent of en zo ja hoe wij hieraan binnen de STAP-regeling tegemoet willen en kunnen komen.

An MP from D66 asked the minister about union efforts to build early-retirement entitlements, and how this fits with lifelong learning and extended working lives. The minister answered that employers, employees and unions bear primary responsibility for lifelong learning, outlined existing public and sectoral budgets, and noted the temporary early-exit allowance and the planned pension reform.
Employers and employees are primarily responsible for lifelong learning.
Werkgevers en werknemers zijn primair verantwoordelijk voor een leven lang ontwikkelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil, Smals, Van Beukering-Huijbregts en Sahla over het bericht ‘Werkgevers niet happig om mensen meer in te zetten, ondanks personeelstekort’

Four MPs asked the ministers of Social Affairs and of Long-Term Care about a news report that employers are reluctant to offer more hours despite staff shortages, and about measures to reduce involuntary part-time work. The government answered that it urges employers to talk with staff, points to the Flexible Working Act while saying it cannot oblige employers to offer full-time contracts, and describes ongoing studies and pilots on a multi-hours bonus and combination jobs.
The cabinet cannot, however, oblige employers to always offer full-time contracts or more working hours when employees ask for them, and to make this standard.
Het kabinet kan echter werkgevers niet verplichten om werknemers altijd voltijdcontracten of meer uren werk aan te bieden als zij erom vragen en dit standaard te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts en Podt over het bericht 'Arbeidsinspectie kreeg toch signalen over zwaar sjouwwerk Schiphol'

MPs Van Beukering-Huijbregts and Podt (D66) asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the Labour Inspectorate ignored several worker complaints about heavy physical work at Schiphol baggage handling, why its self-regulation approach and the handling of signals were not adequate, and what will be done so the Chamber receives correct information. The Minister acknowledged that seven complaints related to physical strain were judged not relevant, that the inspectorate is reviewing its approach, will give heavier weight to airside work, and will improve its complaint registration and transparency, reporting back in the 2024 annual plan.

At my request, the Labour Inspectorate is reviewing its working method and I will enter into further discussion with the Inspectorate on how the method can be further improved and made more transparent.
Op mijn verzoek houdt de Arbeidsinspectie haar werkwijze tegen het licht en ga ik met de Arbeidsinspectie nader in gesprek over hoe de werkwijze verder verbeterd en transparanter kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts en Hagen over het bericht ‘Stap-subsidieregeling blijkt funest voor kleine opleiders’

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about small training providers being excluded from the STAP subsidy scheme because they lack quality marks, some of which impose turnover thresholds. The minister acknowledged the problem, said talks with the sector are underway, and committed to informing parliament on a plan to steer STAP funds toward shortage sectors in early 2023.
In consultation with the training sector and industry organisations, we are examining how to make access to the training register easier for small providers.
In overleg met het opleidingsveld en brancheorganisaties wordt bekeken hoe we de toegang tot het scholingsregister voor de kleine opleiders kunnen vergemakkelijken

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts, Podt en Boucke over de berichten 'Inspectie controleerde twaalf jaar niet op Schiphol' en 'Schiphol geeft toe: we hadden te weinig oog voor arbeidsomstandigheden'

D66 MPs asked the Ministers of Social Affairs and of Infrastructure about press reports that the labour inspectorate did not inspect physical workload at Schiphol baggage handling for twelve years and that many workers became incapacitated. The government answered that employers bear primary responsibility, the Inspectorate has started an investigation and will report on its past inspections at Schiphol, and it committed to talks with Schiphol and KLM and to a site visit in November.
Following the press reports, the Labour Inspectorate has meanwhile started an investigation into the situation of baggage staff at Schiphol.
De Arbeidsinspectie is, naar aanleiding van de berichtgeving, inmiddels een onderzoek gestart naar de situatie bij het bagagepersoneel op Schiphol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Beukering-Huijbregts over een onvolledige AOW-uitkering voor stellen die lager uitkomt dan een AOW-uitkering voor alleenstaanden

An MP asked why couples with one partner having incomplete AOW accrual can receive less pension than a single-person full AOW benefit, how many households are affected, and what the budgetary cost of compensating them would be. The minister confirmed about 4,389 such couples, explained the cause (short residence), pointed to AIO means-tested support and information channels, and declined compensation as it would breach equality principles and the couple-scale logic.
On 1 July 2022 there were 4,389 cohabiting couples whose total AOW benefit was lower than a single-person benefit because one partner had an incomplete AOW benefit.
Op 1 juli 2022 waren er 4.389 samenwonende paren waarvan de totale AOW-uitkering lager uitkomt dan een alleenstaande uitkering doordat één van de partners een onvolledige AOW-uitkering heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts en Hagen over het bericht Opleidingsinstituten profiteren massaal van royale subsidieregeling

MPs Van Beukering-Huijbregts and Hagen (D66) asked whether training providers inflating course prices to exhaust the STAP training budget is acceptable, how providers can circumvent rules, why public institutions offer little STAP-funded training, and how supervision can be strengthened. Minister Van Gennip answered that price inflation is unacceptable, that the Toetsingskamer STAP monitors and sanctions providers (removal from the register, reclaiming subsidy, possible criminal investigation), that four providers received intent-to-remove notices, and that the regulation will be reviewed.
Improper price increases are highly undesirable.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Beukering-Huijbregts over het bericht 'Bent u geen acteur, liegt u niet’ Esmee (32) is chronisch ziek, maar krijgt geen uitkering van het UWV'

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a news report in which a chronically ill WIA applicant was advised to find a partner to support her, and was judged able to work as a crane operator. The minister called such statements undesirable and not regular policy, said UWV should work from trust, pointed to the complaint procedure, and announced a review of the CBBS functie-duiding method and a commission on the future of the sickness and disability system.
Based on the report, it is not possible for UWV to proactively contact the person concerned because UWV does not have all the required personal data.
Het is voor UWV op basis van het bericht niet mogelijk proactief contact met betrokkene op te nemen omdat UWV niet over alle benodigde persoonsgegevens beschikt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland, Van Beukering-Huijbregts en Den Haan over het nader verslag inzake wijziging van de Pensioenwet, de Wet inkomstenbelasting 2001 en enige andere wetten in verband met herziening va

MPs Palland, Van Beukering-Huijbregts and Den Haan asked whether the government's pension projection table ignores the 1.5% projection return, whether pensions can keep pace with 2%, 4% or 6% inflation, and whether more detailed scenario tables are possible. The minister admitted the table was a simplified example with an implicit zero nominal projection return and that the assumptions should have been stated more clearly, argued the new contract offers earlier prospects of indexation than the current one, and promised supplementary DNB calculations before the 12 September hearing.
I acknowledge that the answer could have been clearer about the assumptions underlying the projection return used.
Ik erken dat in de beantwoording duidelijker had kunnen worden aangegeven van welke veronderstellingen bij het gehanteerde projectierendement is uitgegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts, Podt en Boucke over het artikel 'Op de banenmarkt van Schiphol voelen werkzoekenden zich ‘heel speciaal’ – mits ze uit Nederland komen'

MPs from D66 asked the ministers whether the government shares a newspaper's claim that only people resident in the Netherlands for eight years can obtain a security clearance (VGB) for Schiphol jobs, and how employers' misconceptions could be addressed. The minister denies any legal eight-year rule, explains that the Wvo has no nationality or residence requirement but foreign stays can lengthen screening, and promises to raise the issue with Schiphol and employers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts en Romke de Jong over pensioenopbouw door zzp’ers

MPs Van Beukering-Huijbregts and Romke de Jong asked about pension accrual by self-employed workers (zzp'ers) during and after the coronavirus crisis, including the role of home equity as a pension provision, administrative burdens and withdrawal flexibility. Minister Schouten answered that the proposed Wetsvoorstel toekomst pensioenen raises the tax-facilitated savings room for the self-employed, that home equity is not designed as a pension provision and will not be promoted specifically, and that an experiment will ease access to second-pillar schemes.
The cabinet is of the view that pension accrual for self-employed workers will thereby be better facilitated.
Het kabinet is van mening dat pensioenopbouw voor zelfstandigen hierdoor beter wordt gefaciliteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Van Beukering-Huijbregts over werkenden en studenten met Long Covid

Two MPs from D66 asked ministers about workers and students with long-covid, covering occupational care for self-employed, WIA disability inflow, paramedical recovery care coverage, and university support. The government answered that research on long-covid is ongoing, WIA inflow is partly explained by structural factors while UWV investigates the rest, paramedical care is capped at two six-month periods, and it will not extend this limit.
I do not intend to extend the maximum treatment period of twice six months.
Ik ben niet voornemens de maximale behandeltermijn van tweemaal zes maanden te verlengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts, Romke de Jong, Tielen en Aartsen over de signalen die zij ontvangen m.b.t. de steunmaatregelen voor zzp’ers

MPs asked whether municipalities impose wealth and viability tests on self-employed applicants for support beyond what the government intends, and about income losses and reskilling. The minister acknowledges reports of excessive information requests, says municipalities have decentralised responsibility and are being asked to limit requests to what is necessary, and largely defends the simplified Bbz scheme without reinstating the earlier TOZO.

Where signals reach the ministry that municipalities are requesting too much information, this is investigated, and if unnecessary information is indeed requested, the VNG is asked to contact the municipality concerned.

Daar waar bij het ministerie signalen binnenkomen dat gemeenten (te)veel informatie zouden uitvragen, wordt dit uitgezocht en als blijkt dat er inderdaad onnodige informatie wordt uitgevraagd, wordt de VNG verzocht contact hierover op te nemen met de betreffende gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts en Van der Laan over het bericht ‘Thuiszorghulp heeft voortaan ook recht op sociale zekerheidsregelingen’

MPs Van Beukering-Huijbregts and Van der Laan asked the government about a court ruling that personal care helpers paid via a PGB (personal budget) are entitled to unemployment insurance (WW) under indirect sex discrimination, and about its consequences for premiums, informal work, and social security for domestic workers. The minister answered that the ruling is under appeal at the CRvB and should not be extrapolated, that UWV continues to apply the exemption pending the appeal, and that extending WW coverage would have far-reaching implications for the system, so no change is planned.
This concerns a ruling by one court in an individual case. There is therefore no settled case law.
Het betreft hier een uitspraak van één rechtbank in een individuele casus. Daarmee is geen sprake van bestendige jurisprudentie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Beukering-Huijbregts over het bericht 'Rechtbank Arnhem fluit uitkeringsinstantie terug om te strikte toepassing wet'

An MP asked the minister about a court ruling that overturned UWV's strict application of the WIA daily-wage rules, which left a claimant with a lower benefit because of one day of work in the reference period. The minister answered that the rules are binding, that UWV had no discretion, that UWV will not appeal, and that the government is examining possible adjustments and a hardship clause.
UWV has indicated that it will not appeal this ruling.
UWV heeft aangegeven niet in beroep te gaan tegen deze uitspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Beukering-Huijbregts over de rol en representativiteit van vakbonden

An MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about whether trade unions truly represent workers in a sector, including young workers, and about the union subsidy paid by employers and the role of unions versus works councils in pensions. The State Secretary replied that the union and collective agreement system enjoys broad satisfaction, that membership growth lags and may affect representativeness, and that he is willing to discuss representation with social partners.
That does not alter the fact that I consider good representation of all employees important, including employees not covered by a collective agreement.
Dat neemt niet weg dat ik een goede vertegenwoordiging van alle werknemers van belang acht, inclusief de werknemers die niet onder een cao vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beukering-Huijbregts over het stappenplan ‘OR zoekt jonge collega’s’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about the SER step-plan 'OR zoekt jonge collega's' and how to encourage young people to join pension fund accountability and beneficiary bodies. The State Secretary answered that diversity matters, that the sector itself is primarily responsible, pointed to existing initiatives and the diversity norm, and agreed to discuss a similar step-plan with the Stichting van de Arbeid and the Pensioenfederatie.

I would like to enter into discussion with the Stichting van de Arbeid and the Pensioenfederatie to see whether a similar step-plan can be made to increase the number of young people in accountability and beneficiary bodies.

In aanvulling daarop ga ik graag in gesprek met de Stichting van de Arbeid en de Pensioenfederatie, om te bezien of er ook een soortgelijk stappenplan gemaakt kan worden om het aantal jongeren in verantwoordingsorganen en belanghebbendenorganen te vergroten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts en Van Meenen over het bericht 'Personeelstekorten kinderopvang lopen spuigaten uit: vrees voor langere wachtlijsten'

Two D66 MPs asked the government about staff shortages in childcare, the status of a motion calling for a labour market vision, and possible actions. The state secretary acknowledged the shortages, said the work on a labour market vision was delayed by COVID-19 and would resume, and listed steps taken such as a recruitment campaign and postponed quality requirements.
I have committed to your House to work towards solutions to address the labour shortage through discussions with the sector.
Ik heb uw Kamer toegezegd om aan de hand van gesprekken met de sector te komen tot oplossingsrichtingen om de krapte aan te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Beukering-Huijbregts over het bericht 'OM ziet te weinig bewijs uitbuiting truckers: 'Moet er eerst iemand doodgaan?''

An MP asked the minister about a report that the Public Prosecution Service dropped a labour exploitation case against truck drivers for lack of evidence, and about related rules on forced work, prosecution, and tachograph fraud. The state secretary said prosecutorial decisions are independent, outlined existing criminal and administrative tools and a planned review of article 273f, and committed to informing parliament on the implementation of recommendations by year end.
As Minister I do not comment on decisions of the Public Prosecution Service, which independently decides which cases are brought before the court.
Als Minister doe ik geen uitspraken over besluiten van het OM, dat onafhankelijk en zelfstandig besluit welke zaken al dan niet voor de rechter gebracht worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts en Hammelburg over het bericht 'Partnerverlof nadeliger voor laagste inkomens'

Two MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether partner leave (aanvullend geboorteverlof) financially disadvantages the lowest incomes, and how net income effects arise. The minister confirmed the net loss pattern stems mainly from the tax structure (arbeidskorting and the benefit cap), said the NRC figures are factually correct but incomplete as they ignore annual tax and allowances, provided household tables, and said the only options are raising the benefit, which the cabinet considers adequate, or a structural tax change beyond scope, with an evaluation of the WIEG to follow.
The evaluation will be sent to your House at the end of this year or the beginning of next year, and may prompt a next cabinet to look again at the level of the benefit.
De evaluatie zal eind dit jaar of begin volgend jaar naar uw Kamer worden gestuurd, en kan mogelijk voor een volgend kabinet aanleiding zijn om opnieuw naar de hoogte van de uitkering te kijken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Beukering-Huijbregts over het bericht 'België wil rouwverlof uitbreiden, schrijnend dat Nederland het niet heeft'

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether Dutch bereavement leave is adequate after a relative dies, compared with Belgium's proposal to extend it. The minister said calamity leave is available for funerals, that more collective agreements now include bereavement leave, and that a study on work and grief is under way.
Questions about absence due to grief were not included in the survey this year. I expect these results in 2022.
Vragen omtrent uitval door rouw zijn dit jaar niet in de enquête opgenomen. Ik verwacht deze uitkomsten in 2022.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg, Van Beukering-Huijbregts en Van Kent over het bericht 'Betere bescherming arbeidsmigranten kan niet wachten op nieuw kabinet'

MPs from D66 and SP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports of migrant workers found in degrading conditions on a farm in Limburg, including inspection roles, sanctions, the welfare of the workers and the registration of migrant workers. The minister answered that inspections were carried out by the Inspectorate SZW, police and municipality, that investigations are ongoing, that the workers were traced to Belgium, and that the implementation of the Roemer taskforce recommendations is being pursued with some measures awaiting a new cabinet.
The investigation into this incident has not yet been completed and I cannot therefore assess it at this time.
Het onderzoek naar dit voorval is op dit moment nog niet afgerond en ik kan dit derhalve nog niet beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Beukering-Huijbregts over de tijdelijke Bbz-compensatieregeling

An MP asked how many entrepreneurs used the temporary Bbz compensation scheme, why the 2010–2014 cohort was excluded, and whether it could be extended. The minister answered that 1169 people applied, about 2.8 million euro was paid out, the cohort was excluded because the scheme followed a parliamentary motion limited to 2014–2016, and a briefing and an investigation into pre-2014 cases were promised.
1169 people applied for this compensation scheme, which was limited to persons harmed in 2014, 2015 and 2016.
Er hebben 1169 personen een beroep gedaan op deze compensatieregeling die beperkt was tot personen die in de jaren 2014, 2015 en 2016 gedupeerd waren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts en Van Weyenberg over instroom in de WIA van mensen met ME/CVS

MPs Van Beukering-Huijbregts and Van Weyenberg asked whether people with ME/CVS who cannot work are not classed as fully incapacitated, whether WIA reassessments rely on outdated assessments, and about appeals, regional inflow and the Raemakers motion. Minister Koolmees answered that UWV assesses earning capacity case by case, that a fresh WIA claim assessment is always done by an occupational physician, that the Raemakers motion is being implemented, and gave appeal and regional inflow figures.
An insured person with ME/CVS may be eligible for a reassessment if the occupational physician found at the previous assessment that the insured person had not done enough to recover.

Een verzekerde met ME/CVS komt mogelijk in aanmerking voor een herbeoordeling indien de verzekeringsarts bij de vorige beoordeling heeft vastgesteld dat de verzekerde niet voldoende gedaan had aan zijn herstel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts en Van Eijs over de pilot Speaksee

MPs from D66 asked whether the positive UWV pilot of the speech-to-text tool SpeakSee could be reimbursed for deaf and hard-of-hearing workers, since it is classed as a hearing aid and falls to health insurers rather than UWV. The minister agreed the tool is valuable, said the Zorginstituut indicated speech-recognition software may fall under the Zorgverzekeringswet, and promised to monitor and discuss access with representatives of people with disabilities.

As part of the one-counter approach from the cabinet response on POC KOT, I will discuss with VWS and representatives of people with disabilities whether they encounter obstacles when applying for these provisions.

Ik zal in het kader van de een loket gedachte uit de kabinetsreactie POC KOT, samen met VWS, met (vertegenwoordigers van) mensen met een beperking bespreken of zij bij het aanvragen van deze voorzieningen tegen belemmeringen aanlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Beukering-Huijbregts over het bericht 'Vrouw met bijstand krijgt boodschappen, 7.000 Euro teruggevorderd'

An MP from D66 asks the State Secretary for Social Affairs about a report that a welfare recipient received groceries from her parents and had 7,000 euros reclaimed, questioning whether the sanction is proportionate and whether municipalities could show more discretion. The State Secretary declines to comment on the individual case but acknowledges concerns about hardness in the Participatiewet, announces a review of gift rules and reclaim obligations with municipalities, and commits to a signalling team and round tables.
I understand these are strict rules. Rules that matter for public support for the system.
Ik begrijp dat dit strenge regels zijn. Regels die van belang zijn voor het draagvlak voor het stelsel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Van Beukering-Huijbregts over het bericht 'Scouting en jeugd- en jongerenwerk bestolen'

MPs Peters and Van Beukering-Huijbregts asked whether 7.3 million euros earmarked for youth organisations and playgrounds during COVID-19 is being spent as intended, after reports that municipalities were not using it for that purpose. The state secretary confirmed the funds were made available, said the signals had not reached him before, and will raise the issue with the VNG and report back to the House.
If it turns out that the funds are indeed not yet being used for the intended purpose, it is good that the VNG again brings this to the attention of municipalities.
Als blijkt dat de middelen inderdaad nog niet ingezet worden voor het beoogde doel, is het goed dat de VNG dit nogmaals onder de aandacht brengt van gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts en De Groot over het bericht dat er wensballonnen in omloop zijn die niet voldoen aan de veiligheidseisen.

Two D66 MPs asked ministers whether sales of wish balloons that fail safety rules are rising during the fireworks ban, and what enforcement and public information exist. The government replied that it has no data on rising sales, that the NVWA enforces product safety rules and that municipalities may ban releases, while placing responsibility for safe use on consumers.
I am not aware whether sales of these products are increasing, because the NVWA has not carried out any research into this.
Het is mij niet bekend of er een toename is in de verkoop van deze producten omdat daar door de NVWA geen onderzoek naar gedaan is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Van Beukering-Huijbregts over de inzet van diensthonden

MPs Groothuizen and Van Beukering-Huijbregts (D66) asked the Minister of Justice and Security about police dog deployment, prompted by a Zembla broadcast on dog bites, covering the rules, codification, registration, unit differences, certifications, complaints and evaluation of incidents. Minister Grapperhaus answered that dog use is governed by the force instruction and proportionality rules, that a draft amendment to the Ambtsinstructie tightens criteria, and that registration and evaluation procedures exist and were tightened.
It is not possible to break this down further, because other data on the deployment of the dog (including following commands or the number of bites) are not registered.
Het is niet mogelijk hier een verdere uitsplitsing in te maken, omdat andere gegevens over de inzet van de hond (waaronder het opvolgen van commando's of het aantal beten) niet worden geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts en Verhoeven over het gebruik van discriminerende algoritmes en massasurveillance door de politie

Two MPs asked the Justice Minister about predictive policing, the Roermond Sensing trial against mobile banditry, privacy and discrimination safeguards, and Amnesty's criticism. The minister replied that the trial is not predictive policing, that profiles and human officer decisions limit discrimination risks, and rejected stopping the project while noting it is now largely inactive.
The Roermond Operational Testing Ground (OPTR) does not use predictive policing.
De Operationele Proeftuin Roermond (OPTR) maakt geen gebruik van «predictive policing».

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Van Beukering-Huijbrechts over de berichten ‘Slachthuis mocht openblijven ondanks vele coronabesmettingen’ en ‘Dit is waarom slachthuis Vion open mocht blijven ondanks de vele

Two D66 MPs asked why slaughterhouses Vion and Rooi Meat were allowed to stay open despite many COVID-19 infections, including why the safety region did not intervene at Rooi Meat when staffing exceeded the agreed level and why the NVWA did not stop slaughter. The minister answered that the safety region weighed the case, issued a warning rather than a sanction, deemed the situation safe, and that NVWA had no reason to halt operations, while promising to inform parliament on sector talks and noting a new national coordination platform.
The chair of the safety region weighed the situation and decided to give the company a warning and impose no sanction.
De voorzitter van de veiligheidsregio heeft een afweging gemaakt en besloten het bedrijf een waarschuwing te geven en geen sanctie op te leggen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Van Beukering-Huijbregts over het bericht 'Politie en COA 'overtreden privacywet' met delen persoonlijke data asielzoekers'

MPs Verhoeven and Van Beukering-Huijbregts asked whether police use COA asylum-seeker data for proactive checks, predictive policing and incident enforcement, and about the legal basis and DPIA for the COA-police data sharing. The minister answered that the data are not used for proactive checks or CAS, that the sharing rests on article 107 Vreemdelingenwet, that COA suspended sharing pending an external review, and that the DPIA is being refreshed, while stating that DPIAs and AVG compliance by municipalities and agencies are primarily their own responsibility.
Pending the outcome of the external review, the COA board decided on 16 July to suspend immediately the sharing of personal data with the police.
In afwachting van de uitkomsten van de externe toetsing heeft het bestuur van het COA op 16 juli jl. besloten het delen van persoonsgegevens met de politie per direct op te schorten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts en Sneller over de gevaarlijke situaties als gevolg van ‘boerenprotesten’

MPs Van Beukering-Huijbregts and Sneller asked the ministers of Justice and Security and Interior about dangerous situations caused by farmers' tractor blockades of motorways and airports, including whether police acted and what risk assessments applied. Minister Grapperhaus answered that no counts of tractors are available, that protest rights are primarily assessed by local authorities, that police prioritised ending the blockade, and that the government does not see unequal treatment compared with climate protests.
No figures are available on this.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Van Beukering-Huijbregts over het bericht dat journalisten bedreigd zijn na berichtgeving over boerenprotesten

MPs Sneller and Van Beukering-Huijbregts asked the government how it views threats and blockades against journalists covering farmer protests, whether complaints were filed, and whether it will engage with the affected media. The Minister answered that threats against journalists are unacceptable, pointed to the PersVeilig initiative and prosecution protocols, reported no fines or known complaints for the Best incident, and said the government stands for a free press without committing to new talks.
Aggression and violence against journalists is unacceptable.
Agressie en geweld tegen journalisten is onacceptabel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Beukering-Huijbregts over geweldsaanwending door de politie

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about how police use of force is recorded, the neck-hold technique and its strawling risk, and implementation of a motion on periodic cross-case review of police force. The minister answered that force types are not separately recorded or automatically extractable, that the neck-hold control technique is taught while strangulation is not, and that cross-case review is being set up with first results expected in spring 2021.
Within the category of physical force, no distinction is made between the different forms of physical force.
Binnen de categorie fysiek geweld wordt geen onderscheid gemaakt tussen de verschillende vormen van fysiek geweld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Sneller over het bericht ‘Mondkapjesplicht in grote steden

Three D66 MPs asked whether local mask-wearing requirements in Amsterdam and Rotterdam, imposed via emergency ordinances, are compatible with Article 10 of the Constitution, their enforceability and sanctions, and why voluntary wearing was not chosen. The ministers answered that the experiments are a temporary, proportionate, locally motivated response to non-compliance with the 1.5-metre rule, that violations are punishable with a 95-euro fine, and that courts remain available for objections, while acknowledging the legal uncertainty and offering a temporary bill to shorten the emergency situation.
It is not for the government to intervene in any assessment of the sanction by the court.
Het is niet aan de regering om te treden in de eventuele beoordeling van de sanctie door de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Van Beukering-Huijbregts over “snelle toegang van zzp’ers tot het Besluit bijstandverlening zelfstandigen (Bbz)”

MPs from D66 asked the State Secretary how quickly self-employed people without staff can obtain Bbz benefits during the coronavirus crisis, including eligibility conditions, processing times, capacity, and tax deferral information. The State Secretary answered that eligibility conditions apply, that municipalities are responsible for processing and speed, and pointed to the temporary Tozo scheme as the faster route.
There is no data known about the actual average decision time by municipalities.
Er zijn geen gegevens bekend over de feitelijke, gemiddelde beslisduur door gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht ‘Schaf de zorgtoeslag af, zonder inkomenseffecten’

D66 MPs asked the government about a proposal to abolish the healthcare allowance (zorgtoeslag) and lower the nominal premium, covering income effects, costs, state-aid risk and premium competition. The minister answered at length, noting that roughly 3 million households would lose out without compensation, that the proposal is unclear on compensation and feasibility for the tax authority, and that a lower premium would require EU state-aid notification, while promising alternatives will be explored in the response to the IBO-toeslagen.
Regarding cost-awareness and the level of the nominal premium, two aspects play a role.

qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Özütok en Westerveld over de blijvende tekorten voor jeugdzorg bij gemeenten

MPs Kuiken, Özütok and Westerveld asked whether the government should have resolved the chronic youth care funding shortfall at municipalities earlier, and why no extra money was provided now. The State Secretary replied that the government granted temporary funds (over EUR 1 billion for 2021 and EUR 1.314 billion for 2022), agreed savings with municipalities, committed to a reform agenda, and that a new cabinet must decide on structural funding taking the Commission of Wise Men's ruling as a weighty input.
The cabinet makes available an additional EUR 1.314 billion to municipalities in 2022 for the youth care shortfalls.
Het kabinet stelt in 2022 € 1,314 miljard extra beschikbaar aan gemeenten voor de tekorten vanwege de jeugdzorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berge en Özütok over intimidaties door Vizier op Links

MPs Van den Berge and Özütok asked whether the government considers the intimidation of public figures by the anonymous group Vizier op Links at their home addresses unacceptable, whether it is criminal, whether AIVD is aware of it, and what measures will be taken. The minister condemned the conduct as intimidating, said he cannot comment on individual cases, reported ten complaints with six closed and four pending, and described existing police and local-triangle protection mechanisms.
The Public Prosecution Service is currently examining whether the conduct in question qualifies as criminal offences.
Het Openbaar Ministerie onderzoekt momenteel of de betreffende handelingen zich kwalificeren als strafbare feiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Özütok over het bericht ‘De anti-abortusbeweging haalt vrouwen over tot het nemen van gevaarlijke ‘spijtpil’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the health minister about reports that anti-abortion groups pressure women into taking a dangerous 'regret pill' (progesterone) and whether such groups should be restricted, including by buffer zones around clinics. The minister stated that dispensing these drugs is restricted to pharmacists and licensed doctors, that the inspectorate enforces this, that buffer zones are for mayors to decide under the Public Manifestations Act, and that the inspectorate is investigating a Urk practice without a criminal probe yet.
As is customary, the Inspectorate makes no statements while the investigation is ongoing.
Zoals gebruikelijk doet de Inspectie hangende het onderzoek geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over de mogelijke aanleg van een containerhaven op Bonaire

An MP from GroenLinks asked the ministers about reported plans for a container port near Hato on Bonaire, including environmental impacts, alternatives, coral reef protection and whether a planning study had been commissioned. The minister answered that the decision rests with the Bonaire executive board, that the ministry assists with further study, that no planning study has been commissioned yet, and that environmental assessment will follow later.
The decision whether a new cargo port (location) should actually be built, and if so where, rests with the Bonaire Executive Council.
Het besluit of er daadwerkelijk, en zo ja waar, een nieuwe vrachthaven(locatie) dient te komen is aan het Bestuurscollege van Bonaire.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over het bericht ‘Slechts voor genodigden, liefst anoniem: fondsenwerving bij de VVD’

An MP asked whether private sponsorship of VVD party events and advertising, reported as anonymous fundraising, constitutes a reportable in-kind donation under the Wfpp and what the consequences of non-compliance are. The minister said the rules treat in-kind gifts like cash gifts, that she cannot judge the cases from the article alone and has asked the VVD for information, and that sanctions range from an audit review to a fine of up to 25,000 euro per violation.

Whether the cases mentioned in the article must be classified as in-kind contributions I cannot assess based solely on the information in this article. I have therefore asked the VVD to inform me about this.

Of de in het artikel genoemde casussen als bijdrage in natura moeten worden aangemerkt kan ik op basis van enkel de informatie in dit artikel niet beoordelen. Ik heb daarom de VVD verzocht mij hierover te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over het bericht ‘Klein experiment met poststemmen in Den Haag’

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of the Interior about a small Den Haag postal-voting experiment that revealed problems for over-70 voters, including invalid ballots from incorrect forms or envelopes. The minister answered that the instructions are sent with the postal ballot documents, explained how the secrecy of the vote is safeguarded, stated she knows of no earlier experiments, and shared the instructions on request.
It is essential that voters put their voting pass and the postal ballot in the return envelope when voting by post.
Essentieel is dat de kiezers hun stempluspas en het briefstembiljet in de retour- envelop doen als ze per brief stemmen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet, Özütok, Kuiken en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Onverwacht zwanger door nieuw koperspiraaltje'

MPs asked the Minister of Medical Care about reports of unexpected pregnancies and expulsions linked to the Ballerine copper IUD, including how adverse events are reported, what risk assessment is underway, and how EU medical device rules and notified body oversight will protect patients. The Minister answered that the IGJ is analysing the reports, that a MEBI alert is planned, and that the EU MDR applying from May 2021 will tighten requirements, while acknowledging room for improvement.
Furthermore, I call on healthcare providers, manufacturers and patients to continue reporting their complaints and side effects related to medical devices through the available channels.
Verder roep ik zorgverleners, fabrikanten en patiënten op hun klachten en bijwerkingen met betrekking tot medische hulpmiddelen te blijven melden via de beschikbare kanalen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over het bericht 'burgemeester Sjors Fröhlich over schadevergoeding Niemans: Dit is een mokerslag'?

An MP asked the Interior Minister about the practical and legal consequences for the municipality of Vijfheerenlanden of a €90 million damages ruling tied to a 40-year-old case involving a predecessor municipality, and whether the government would support it. The minister answered that the municipality must pay from its own funds, that supervision and the Article 12 safety net exist but are not expected to be needed, and that BZK and the province will help map the consequences.

The conversation led to the agreement that the municipality of Vijfheerenlanden, with support from BZK and the province of Utrecht, will map out the consequences of the ruling for Vijfheerenlanden's ambitions in relation to its financial position.

Het gesprek heeft geleid tot de afspraak dat de gemeente Vijfheerenlanden met ondersteuning van BZK en de provincie Utrecht de gevolgen van de uitspraak voor de ambities van Vijfheerenlanden in relatie tot de financiële positie in kaart gaat brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Bergkamp en Özütok over het bericht ‘Geweld tegen transpersonen houdt aan: ‘We moeten dit niet accepteren’’

Three MPs asked the ministers of Education, Culture and Science and of Justice and Security how they will tackle violence against transgender people, whether police capacity via Roze in Blauw is adequate, and whether consultation with TNN will produce concrete measures. The minister acknowledged the problem, cited existing measures (equal treatment law, Actieplan Veiligheid LHBTI, a 2021 congress, police diversity networks) and said concrete new measures would be communicated to the House if warranted.
OCW has regular contact with Transgender Netwerk Nederland (TNN) to see how the position of transgender people can be improved in various areas.
Vanuit OCW is er geregeld contact met Transgender Netwerk Nederland (TNN) om te zien hoe de positie van transgender personen op verschillende vlakken verbeterd kan worden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok en Renkema over het bericht 'Vier op de tien vrouwen op de arbeidsmarkt benadeeld vanwege zwangerschap of pasgeboren kind: zwangerschapsdiscriminatie nog steeds onverminderd groot p

MPs Özütok and Renkema asked about a College voor de Rechten van de Mens report finding that 43% of people active on the labour market who had a child in the past four years experienced pregnancy discrimination, and about the government's response, unions, works councils and the Inspectie SZW. The Staatssecretaris agreed the problem is serious, pointed to the Actieplan Arbeidsmarktdiscriminatie, awareness campaigns, a planned stakeholder meeting, and the upcoming wetsvoorstel Toezicht gelijke kansen bij werving en selectie, while stating that the Inspectie SZW has extra capacity and held over 500 inspections this year.
I will work on providing employers with tools.
Ik zal inzetten op het bieden van handvatten aan werkgevers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over gesprekken met jongeren in Caribisch Nederland

MP Özütok asked whether the government will involve young people from Caribbean Netherlands in decision-making on the covid-19 crisis, citing the citizens' initiative 'Betrek jongeren'. State Secretary Knops says he knows the initiative, has spoken with young people on his visits, and will hold an online conversation with young people on 23 November, bringing their ideas to the cabinet.
On 23 November I have planned a first conversation with young people from Caribbean Netherlands to speak online about the themes that concern them.
Op 23 november a.s. heb ik een eerste gesprek gepland met jongeren uit Caribisch Nederland om via een online verbinding te spreken over de thema’s die bij hen leven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over het uitblijven van een covid-19-bonus voor zorgprofessionals in Caribisch Nederland

An MP asked why healthcare workers in Caribbean Netherlands were excluded from the covid-19 bonus paid in European Netherlands and whether they would be given it. The state secretary said the bonus scheme does not apply there, but a $1,000 net bonus for March to December 2020 is being arranged, with the payment mechanism still to be worked out.
Therefore, work is currently underway on a method to make a care bonus of $1,000 net for healthcare professionals in Caribbean Netherlands possible.
Daarom wordt er op dit moment gewerkt aan een werkwijze om een zorgbonus van $ 1.000 netto voor zorgprofessionals in Caribisch Nederland mogelijk te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp, Van den Hul en Özütok over het artikel 'Helft minder slachtoffers moord en doodslag in 20 jaar'

Three MPs asked the Ministers of Justice and of Health about a CBS report showing that over half of women killed in 2015-2019 were killed by a partner or ex-partner, and whether prior police contact existed and how police respond. The government confirmed the figures, said police and prosecution systems cannot provide case-level data on prior contact, and described existing protective measures and COVID-related steps without committing to new concrete action.

No, unfortunately I cannot. The police and the Public Prosecution Service cannot, based on the records in their systems, provide insight into the cases involving (ex-)partner violence with fatal outcomes in the period 2015 through 2019.

Nee, dat kan ik helaas niet. De politie en het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) kunnen op basis van de registraties in hun systemen geen inzicht geven in de gevallen waarbij sprake was van (ex-)partnergeweld met dodelijke afloop in de periode 2015 tot en met 2019.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Bergkamp, Özütok, Bouali en Van den Nieuwenhuijzen over aandacht voor de kwetsbare positie van oa. LHBTI’s in de nationale en internationale COVID-19 respons

MPs asked the government about the vulnerable position of LHBTI people during the COVID-19 pandemic in the Netherlands and internationally, including healthcare access for transgender people and UN recommendations. The Minister answered that impacts are being studied (Movisie survey due in autumn), referred healthcare questions to another minister, said the UN refugee camp reports were not confirmed, and described Dutch advocacy at the UN.
This question falls under the policy area of the Minister for Medical Care and Sport (MZS).
Deze vraag ligt op het beleidsterrein van de Minister voor Medische Zorg en Sport (MZS).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Özütok en Bergkamp over het voortbestaan van het Roze in Blauw politieteam

MPs Van den Hul, Özütok and Bergkamp asked whether police agents' workload threatens the Roze in Blauw LHBTI network, and what the government will do to protect it. Minister Grapperhaus replied that the Amsterdam unit is in talks with the network, that the government will monitor developments and stay in consultation with the police leadership, and that the network's expertise is secured through the Netwerk Divers Vakmanschap.
I consider it of great importance that the work of RiB continues in a meaningful way.
Ik acht het van groot belang dat het werk van RiB op een zinvolle wijze wordt voortgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over het bericht ‘Stadskanaal geeft sleutel aan provincie: ‘Je kunt alles wel kapotbezuinigen’

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about Stadskanaal's council warning that severe budget cuts endanger local amenities, and whether the government shares concern that municipal finances force closures. The minister acknowledged the concerns, pointed to extra funds and compensation measures and a study into the effects of financial strain on local services, and said long-term options will be discussed with municipalities.
Anticipating the results of this research, the series of temporary additional funds for youth care of €300 million has been extended to 2022.
Vooruitlopend op de resultaten van dit onderzoek is de reeks van de tijdelijke extra middelen voor jeugdzorg ad € 300 mln. verlengd naar 2022.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok en Buitenweg over het bericht ‘Hoe beveiligers van Thierry Baudet met geweld een demonstrant onschadelijk maken’

MPs Özütok and Buitenweg asked whether private security guards of Thierry Baudet used physical force to stop a lone demonstrator, whether demonstration freedom may only be restricted by authorities under the Wom, and whether measures would be taken against repeat offending security firms. The Minister replied that private guards have no force powers beyond any citizen, that the complainant filed a police report, that such incidents are not separately registered, and that the Wpbr allows fines and licence withdrawal.
Private security guards, like any other citizen, have no authority to use force.
Particuliere beveiligers hebben, net als iedere andere burger, geen bevoegdheid tot het aanwenden van geweld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp, Van den Hul en Özütok over psychische mishandeling

Three MPs (Bergkamp, Van den Hul, Özütok) asked the ministers about how the government addresses psychological abuse, its criminal-law treatment, registration, and compliance with the Istanbul Convention and children's rights treaty. Minister De Jonge replied that existing law and the GHNT programme already allow action, that police and courts do not register psychological abuse separately, and that no specific problems are reported in prosecution.
It therefore cannot be determined from police registration how often a report of psychological abuse has been filed, whether or not combined with other forms of abuse.
Het is daarom niet uit de politieregistratie te halen hoe vaak aangifte is gedaan van psychische mishandeling, al dan niet in combinatie met andere vormen van mishandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Özütok over het bericht ‘Parlement, maak een einde aan deze uitzonderingstoestand’

Two MPs asked the government to clarify how many people gathering at 1.5 metres constitutes a breach of the emergency ordinances, and why the Prime Minister's statements on group size, and the definition of an event, seemed inconsistent with fines and enforcement practice. The minister explained the successive rules for public spaces and gatherings, said the definition of event and the distinction with gatherings is clarified in an ordinance, and noted that a bill in preparation will address gathering norms.
In general, an emergency ordinance must contain sufficiently precise provisions to be complied with and enforced.
In zijn algemeenheid geldt dat een noodverordening voldoende bepaalde voorschriften moet bevatten om te kunnen worden nageleefd en gehandhaafd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over de schommelingen in het gemeentefonds

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the government agrees that municipalities need at least 2 billion euros extra, whether the surcharge for scaling up should be dropped, how large the social-domain deficits are, what the balanced-budget picture is and how COVID costs are being compensated. The minister acknowledged the pressures, pointed to additional funds and ongoing studies and deferred the surcharge decision to a new cabinet.
That is why the cabinet is having research done on youth care and is monitoring the Wmo subscription tariff.
Daarom laat het kabinet onderzoek doen naar de jeugdzorg en monitort het kabinet het Wmo-abonnementstarief.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Özütok over het bericht van EenVandaag ‘Verbod streekmarkten drijft boeren tot wanhoop: Onbegrijpelijk, omdat weekmarkten wél open mogen'

Two GroenLinks MPs asked why regional farmers' markets were banned under COVID-19 emergency rules while weekly markets stayed open, and whether municipalities could re-permit them. The minister explained that markets are excluded from the event ban only when they are ordinary markets, that whether a regional market counts as an event is decided case by case by the safety region chair, and that organising markets remains a municipal matter, while stating sympathy for short supply chains.
Whether a regional market falls within this definition depends on the concrete circumstances and organisation of that market and is for the chair of the safety region to assess.
Of een streekmarkt binnen deze definitie valt, zal afhankelijk zijn van de concrete omstandigheden en inrichting van die markt en is ter beoordeling van de voorzitter van de veiligheidsregio.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over uitzetting van ongedocumenteerde Venezolanen

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that three undocumented Venezuelans on Bonaire were detained for deportation, and about safeguards given the risks in Venezuela. The government said it could not find the report, stressed that deportations are assessed under Article 3 ECHR, declined to comment on individual cases, and refused to monitor deportees after return.
As previously communicated to the House, I do not make statements about individual cases.
Zoals eerder aan de Kamer is bericht, doe ik geen uitspraken over individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over watertekort op Sint Eustatius

An MP asked the ministers about water shortages on Sint Eustatius, including how long the drinking water supply problems were known, whether pipeline materials were unsuitable, rationing information and storage, and financial relief during COVID-19. The government answered that subsidies and new pipelines and storage are being put in place, rationing has been eased, and water tariffs were set to zero for eight months, though it did not fully answer several historical questions.
From 8 June 2020 rationing has been eased and drinking water comes from the tap from 5 a.m. to 8 p.m.
Met ingang van 8 juni 2020 is de rantsoenering versoepeld en komt er van 5 uur ’s ochtends tot 20 uur ’s avonds drinkwater uit de kraan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Özütok over het bericht ‘Parlement, maak een einde aan deze uitzonderingstoestand’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the Justice and Interior Ministers about legal objections that COVID-19 emergency ordinances (noodverordeningen) based on the Public Health Act lack basis, bypass the constitutional state-of-emergency regime, restrict constitutional rights without grounds, and lack democratic control. The government defended the ordinances as lawful, pointed to Ministerial instructions as subject to parliamentary oversight and to council information duties, and announced temporary specific legislation with consultation of local bodies.
The cabinet nonetheless considers it desirable that the measures to be taken after the acute crisis phase be developed in consultation with parliament.
Wel acht het kabinet het gewenst dat de maatregelen die moeten worden getroffen na de fase van acute crisisbeheersing in samenspraak met het parlement tot stand worden gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf, Van der Molen en Özütok over de coronacrisis en bewonersinitiatieven

Three MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether non-commercial citizen initiatives hit by COVID-19 revenue losses can access support schemes, and whether the ministry will coordinate emergency funding with municipalities and national funds. The minister answered that such bodies only qualify for some schemes if they count as enterprises, expressed willingness to consider case-by-case help with municipalities, but saw no need for a general additional support measure.
Beyond the cabinet-wide support package and support through the multi-year Democracy in Action programme, I see no reason at present to take additional initiative for a general support measure.

Naast het kabinetsbrede ondersteuningspakket en de ondersteuning via het meerjarige samenwerkingsprogramma Democratie in Actie zie ik vooralsnog geen aanleiding om op dit moment extra initiatief te nemen voor een algemene ondersteuningsmaatregel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Boer, Özütok en Van Raak over het bericht ‘Van 2 uitvaarten per week naar 2 per dag: uitvaartondernemer Marjan Damen draait overuren’

MPs asked the ministers about reports that funeral directors were overstretched by rising COVID-19 deaths, including capacity in mortuaries, the role of Defence and coordination, protective equipment, coffin supply and Islamic and Jewish burial rights. The minister answered that the sector is coping, that a coordination point and Defence support can be arranged if needed, that mortuary and coffin capacity is sufficient with contingency plans, and that burial options exist.
I indeed receive questions from the funeral sector about the Corona crisis, including about the cabinet's measures and RIVM guidelines.
Ik ontvang inderdaad vragen uit de uitvaartsector over de Corona-crisis, waaronder ook over de maatregelen van het kabinet en de richtlijnen van het RIVM.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp, Van den Hul en Özütok over het bericht ‘Amsterdams homokoppel uitgescholden en bespuugd’

MPs Bergkamp, Van den Hul and Özütok asked the Justice Minister about a reported homophobic attack in Amsterdam, underreporting of hate crime, the use of specialised discrimination detectives, and the training of police officers on discrimination. Minister Grapperhaus said such discrimination is unacceptable, announced a publicity campaign and a national police coordination function, but rejected creating specialised hate crime units and left the police training curriculum largely unchanged.
I intend to conclude this process with a public campaign aimed at the willingness of LHBTI people to report and file complaints.
Ik ben voornemens dit traject af te ronden met een publiekscampagne gericht op de meldings- en aangiftebereidheid van LHBTI.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over watertekorten op Sint Eustatius

An MP asked the state secretary about water shortages on Sint Eustatius, where residents get drinking water only in three-hour blocks, and why rationing was not prevented earlier. The minister acknowledged the rationing, attributed it to rising demand and a leaking transport pipeline, and promised three projects due by end 2020 and 2021 plus information via STUCO channels.
That is of course an undesirable situation.
Dat is uiteraard een onwenselijke situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak en Özütok over de beknotting van de persvrijheid op Aruba

MPs Van Raak and Özütok asked whether journalists on Aruba may be barred from working during the COVID-19 curfew, how a journalist was arrested, and whether aid conditions should protect press freedom. The State Secretary replied that journalists were not an exempt category under the curfew regulation, that three journalists were later allowed out during curfew, and that no aid conditions on press freedom were warranted.
No exemption ground has been included for journalists.
Voor journalisten is er geen uitzonderingsgrond opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over digitaal beraadslagen

An MP asked whether live-stream glitches at supplier NotuBiz, which disrupted some digital council meetings, were understood, how many bodies were affected, and how public access can be guaranteed. The minister confirmed the glitches, said about 25 meetings were affected and some suspended, explained the capacity cause, stated that meetings must be public and suspended during faults, and said ICT responsibility lies primarily with local authorities.
Meetings of decentralised representative bodies under the Temporary digital deliberation and decision-making act are by definition public.
Vergaderingen van decentrale volksvertegenwoordigende organen op grond van de Tijdelijke wet digitale beraadslaging en besluitvorming zijn per definitie openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Van Weyenberg, Özütok en Snels over de opschorting van het Wob-verzoek van Pieter Klein

MPs from D66, GroenLinks asked the Health Minister why he suspended a Wob freedom-of-information request from journalist Pieter Klein on coronavirus matters and whether this undermines oversight and press freedom. The minister answered that the request was suspended for force majeure due to crisis work, that only coronavirus-related Wob requests are paused with a plan to resume by 1 June, and that alternative channels and appeal routes remain open.
Only in a very exceptional situation can an administrative body invoke force majeure to suspend the decision period for Wob requests.
Uitsluitend in geval van een zeer uitzonderlijke situatie kan een bestuursorgaan met een beroep op overmacht de beslistermijn voor Wob-verzoeken opschorten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Ellemeet, Van Ojik , Van der Lee, Özütok, Van den Berge, Buitenweg en Westerveld over de coronacrisis

MPs from GroenLinks asked the government about COVID-19 measures, including drug shortages, ventilator procurement, religious gatherings, Hungary's emergency law and EU funds, tourism in the Wadden area, sex workers' access to support, and charity funding. The government answered most questions substantively, declining to ban religious gatherings in non-public places for lack of legal basis and deferring some matters to EU or regional bodies.
The cabinet emphasises that there is currently no reason to ban religious gatherings of fewer than thirty people.
Het kabinet stelt voorop dat er thans geen aanleiding is voor een verbod op religieuze bijeenkomsten van minder dan dertig personen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok en Van den Berge over het bericht 'Transgender eist excuses overheid: ‘Om vrouw te worden, moest ik me laten steriliseren’'

Two GroenLinks MPs asked whether the government acknowledges the harm caused by the pre-2014 sterilisation requirement for legal gender change, whether it will apologise, how other countries handled redress, and whether it will meet the complainants. The minister acknowledged the harm and the requirement's damage, said a response to the Transgender Collective's letter requesting apology and compensation talks is still under consideration, described Sweden's compensation and noted no other countries have apologised, and declined to commit to a meeting for now.
I am aware that this condition for sterilisation caused suffering and I also acknowledge this suffering.
Ik ben er mee bekend dat deze voorwaarde tot sterilisatie leed heeft veroorzaakt en erken dit leed ook.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok, Kröger en Buitenweg over geweld en seksuele intimidatie in de trein en op het spoor

MPs asked the Justice and Security and Infrastructure ministers about sexual harassment in trains and on platforms, including the number of incidents, advice to travellers, cooperation with international carriers and use of expertise from the national sexual violence centre. The government answered that about 200 incidents were registered by carriers in 2019 but figures may be incomplete, that there is no specific traveller advice beyond general reporting channels, and that NS cooperates internationally and with specialist organisations, with no specific new commitments.
The police currently have no additional figures on sexual harassment specifically in trains and on platforms.
De politie heeft op dit moment geen aanvullende cijfers met betrekking tot seksuele intimidatie specifiek in de trein en op het perron.
Antwoord de vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Özütok over veel transgenders gaan zelf aan de slag met hormonen, met alle risico's van dien

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the Minister of Medical Care about transgender people self-administering hormones because of long waiting lists, including advice, support, waiting-list reduction and data on complications. The Minister advised against self-medication, pointed to GP and support organisations, reported new endocrine care capacity and a planned 2021 follow-up study, and said GPs can take on part of the hormone follow-up.
I do not have figures on the number of medical complications among transgender persons as a result of self-medication.
Ik beschik niet over cijfers over het aantal medische complicaties bij transgender personen ten gevolge van zelfmedicatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Renkema, Smeulders, Westerveld en Özütok over het coronavirus (COVID-19)

MPs from GroenLinks asked the government about its whole-of-government approach to COVID-19, equipment and ICU capacity, school decisions, Caribbean Netherlands coordination, economic measures like part-time unemployment benefit, accessibility of public communication, and intensified publicity. The minister answered that broad measures are in place, outlined capacity expansions and procurement steps, and committed to letters on decision-making and a school decision framework.
During the debate of Thursday 5 March I committed to inform you about this by letter.
Ik heb tijdens het debat van donderdag 5 maart toegezegd u hierover per brief te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over gedetineerde asielzoekers in hongerstaking op Curaçao

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about twelve Venezuelan asylum seekers on hunger strike in immigration detention on Curaçao, their medical care, whether their long detention among convicts breaches human rights, and whether the Netherlands will press Curaçao and offer help. The minister answered that Curaçao reports the group has received medical care and is in good health, that Curaçao and its judiciary are responsible for assessing detention conditions and lawfulness, and that the Netherlands supports Curaçao on the migration chain and detention conditions.

It is up to the authorities and the judiciary of Curaçao to assess, in any cases that may arise, the extent to which the conditions of detained foreigners conflict with national and/or international obligations.

Het is aan de autoriteiten en de rechterlijke macht van Curaçao om in eventueel voorkomende gevallen te beoordelen in hoeverre de omstandigheden van vreemdelingen in bewaring op gespannen voet staan met nationale en/of internationale verplichtingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj en Sneller, Ellemeet en Özütok over het bericht 'Rutte informeert Tweede Kamer onjuist over kunstverkoop Oranjes'

MPs from D66 and GroenLinks asked the Prime Minister about reports that the Munnicks van Cleeff atlas, a Raden Saleh painting and other art from Princess Juliana's estate were sold or kept out of museums against advice, and about the handling of the estate and the tax-credit scheme. The government answered that legal constraints on privacy and tax confidentiality limit disclosure of the estate settlement, that the atlas sale was not subject to a binding guarantee of staying in the Netherlands, and that the policy on displaying art acquired via the scheme is not legally binding but policy-based, with a commitment to follow the advisory committee's report.
As I noted in answer to question 2, various statutory provisions prevent a full account of the concrete settlement of the estate among the various private heirs and other parties.

Zoals ik in antwoord op vraag 2 heb opgemerkt staan verschillende wettelijke voorschriften er aan in de weg volledig in te gaan op de concrete afwikkeling van de nalatenschap tussen de verschillende particuliere erfgenamen en andere betrokkenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over de stand van zaken met betrekking tot transgenderzorg

MPs Ellemeet and Özütok asked the Minister of Medical Care about long waiting times in transgender care, the limits of the quartermaster's approach, cross-border lessons, insurer information, a new patient survey, and underuse of the breast augmentation subsidy. The Minister acknowledged long waits, said he cannot give a date for meeting the Treek norms, and listed steps such as extending the quartermaster's mandate, asking insurers to report, and planning a new patient survey in 2021.
I share your concern that waiting times in transgender care are still very long.
Ik deel uw zorgen over het feit dat de wachttijden in de transgenderzorg nog steeds erg lang zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Gijs van Dijk, Paternotte, Groothuizen, Van den Berge en Özütok over geweld tegen de actiegroep Kick Out Zwarte Piet

MPs from several parties asked the Prime Minister and the Justice and Interior ministers how violence against the Kick Out Zwarte Piet congress was allowed, whether local authorities knew in advance, and how demonstrations and the Sinterklaas processions will be protected. The ministers condemned intimidation and violence, said police and prosecutors are investigating, and said local authorities (mayor, police, prosecutor) decide within legal limits, with a handreiking offered to municipalities; several answers were evasive about advance knowledge.
In our constitutional state it is unacceptable that (groups of) individual citizens disrupt a gathering of other citizens with violence and intimidation.
Het is in onze rechtsstaat ontoelaatbaar dat (groepen van) individuele burgers een bijeenkomst van andere burgers verstoren met geweld en intimidatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok en Renkema over het rapport ‘Beleidsscan VN-Verdrag handicap’ van de NVRR?

MPs Özütok and Renkema asked ministers about the NVRR report on municipal implementation of the UN Disability Convention, including why most municipalities lag, the lack of attention to women with disabilities, national implementation steps, and the convention's status in the Caribbean and Kingdom countries. The minister answered that municipalities face challenges, that the VNG project 'Iedereen doet mee' and the 'Onbeperkt Meedoen!' programme are underway, that the NVRR did not investigate the cause regarding women, and that the convention awaits implementing legislation in Caribbean Netherlands and has not been ratified by the other Kingdom countries.
The NVRR did not investigate the cause of why municipalities pay no particular attention to the position of women with disabilities.
De NVRR heeft niet onderzocht wat de oorzaak is waarom gemeenten geen bijzondere aandacht besteden aan de positie van vrouwen met een beperking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Özütok over het rapport 'FC Twente, Feyenoord en de Europese regels voor staatssteun'

MPs Westerveld and Özütok asked the ministers about a report claiming state aid to professional football clubs (FC Twente, Feyenoord) is unlawful and that municipalities are pressured into paying, and whether the EU Commission and national rules adequately police this. The Minister rejects the claims of coercion and unfair advantage, says anyone can complain to the Commission and that the Commission can act ex officio, and explains that municipalities are primarily responsible for state-aid compliance, with the Rijk supporting this through a knowledge centre, but commits to no new action.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok, Van den Berge en Buitenweg over het bericht Gedwongen uitgehuwelijkte Fatima: ‘Meisjes zoals ik worden verkocht als golden tickets’ van Hart van Nederland

MPs asked the ministers how forced marriage of young women with a non-Western migrant background is measured, what protection and legal tools exist, and how the vrouwenopvang shortage affects victims. The government answered that reliable figures are lacking, pointed to existing reporting channels, laws and an action agenda due end 2019, and said it would evaluate the Wet tegengaan huwelijksdwang and study the shelter capacity problem.
Precise and reliable figures on the scale of forced marriage in the Netherlands are lacking.
Precieze en betrouwbare cijfers over de omvang van huwelijksdwang in Nederland ontbreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders en Özütok over het bericht ‘Wildgroei flexmakelaars baart zzp'ers zorgen’

Two MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about press reports that flex intermediaries are multiplying and may be used to shift risk and cut rates, and about the central government's own use of such intermediaries. The minister acknowledges misuse risks, says procurement emphasises quality over price, and says the government does not track how many people work via intermediaries, while promising further research into triangular relationships.
How many people per year work via flex intermediaries at the ministries cannot therefore be derived from these figures.
Hoeveel mensen per jaar via flexbemiddelaars bij de ministeries werken is derhalve niet uit deze cijfers af te leiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over de financiële problemen die Curaçaose oud-studenten ondervinden bij het aflossen van studieschulden

An MP asked whether DUO's repayment and collection practices put former students on Curaçao in financial trouble, and whether repayment schemes reflect local income conditions. The minister denied DUO obstructs repayment, explained the income-based draagkracht procedure and the staged collection steps, and promised DUO staff visits to Curaçao and a review of concrete cases.
If the further information from the Minister of OWCS shows that things have gone wrong there, I will certainly take measures.
Als uit de nadere informatie van de Minister van OWCS blijkt dat daar zaken mis zijn gegaan, zal ik zeker maatregelen nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over het bericht dat het COC veel Friese scholen niet meer binnenkomt

An MP asked the ministers whether the reduction in COC guest lessons on LHBTI acceptance in Friesland, and the shift of LHBTI policy from province to municipalities, was of concern and what the government would do to keep attention on LHBTI acceptance nationwide. The minister answered that schools are free to choose how to address sexual diversity, that the government supports municipalities through the Regenboogsteden programme, and that the sexuality core objectives are being revised.
I am not aware of agreements on the transfer of LHBTI policy from provinces to municipalities.
Ik ben niet op de hoogte van afspraken over de overdracht van lhbti-beleid van provincies naar gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over de opvang van Venezolaanse migranten

An MP asked whether the 23.8 million euro Dutch funding for Aruba and Curaçao concerning Venezuelan migrants is mainly spent on deterrence and detention, how much goes to asylum procedure and reception, and whether a share should fund fair treatment. The State Secretary answered that 7.2 million is reserved for optimising the migration chain and that migration policy is an autonomous matter of the Caribbean countries, with reception funded for vulnerable groups such as trafficking victims.
The starting point for Dutch support to the countries is that, in line with the constitutional relations within the Kingdom, responsibility for migration policy is an autonomous matter.

Uitgangspunt voor de Nederlandse ondersteuning aan de landen is dat conform de staatsrechtelijke verhoudingen binnen het Koninkrijk de verantwoordelijkheid voor het migratiebeleid een autonome aangelegenheid betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok en Kuiken over het bericht 'Limburg absolute koploper in verstrekken betaalde klussen aan oud-politici'

MPs Özütok and Kuiken asked the Interior Minister about reports that Limburg province awarded paid assignments to former politicians more than all other provinces combined, and about procurement, integrity and transparency concerns. The minister answered that the province reports no violation of EU or internal procurement rules beyond one 2017 internal-rule deviation, that the commissioner of the King's ambtsbericht was requested, and that the minister will review integrity rules for former office-holders with the provincial associations and advise more careful procurement practice.
I will inform the college of provincial executive of this finding in a letter.
Ik zal het college van gedeputeerde staten van deze bevinding in een brief op de hoogte stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Bergkamp en Özütok over een  slachtoffer van homofobe bedreigingen dat  zelf de dader moest opsporen

MPs asked the Justice Minister how police could ignore long-running homophobic threats even after the victim supplied the offender's details, and what policy will raise reporting and prosecution of discrimination and strengthen the Roze in Blauw network and LHBTI training. The minister agreed the case should have been handled more carefully, said he cannot comment on individual cases, and listed an action plan, a WODC study on hate crime, and planned police training measures.
I am of the view that this case should have been handled more carefully; the police share this view.
Ik ben van mening dat deze zaak zorgvuldiger had moeten worden behandeld, de politie deelt deze mening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok, Diks en Van Ojik over Venezolaans conflictgoud dat via Curaçao en Aruba wordt verhandeld

Three GroenLinks MPs asked the government about Venezuelan conflict gold being traded via Curaçao and Aruba, and how this fits with Dutch recognition of Guaidó and the gold covenant. The State Secretary answered that Curaçao and Aruba have banned Venezuelan gold trade, that no Venezuelan gold import was declared in Caribbean Netherlands in five years, and that the EU conflict minerals regulation applies from 2021, with the gold covenant and due diligence as the main tools.
Regarding the nature and scale of gold trade on Sint Maarten, despite inquiries with the Sint Maarten government, I currently have no figures available.
Van de aard en omvang van de handel in goud op Sint Maarten zijn mij, ondanks navraag bij de regering van Sint Maarten, op dit moment geen cijfers bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Özütok over het recht tot zelfbeschikking van intersekse baby’s en kinderen

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers about UN Committee against Torture recommendations on intersex children's bodily autonomy, prevalence, unnecessary surgery, and parental consent. Minister Bruins answered that medical decisions rest with professionals, that no IGJ reports of non-consensual procedures are known, that research is insufficient, and that a quality standard for intersex/DSD care is being developed.
I therefore cannot confirm that there are intersex babies and children in the Netherlands who have undergone a non-medically necessary procedure without informed consent.
Ik kan dan ook niet bevestigen dat er intersekse baby's en kinderen zijn in Nederland die zonder dat er sprake is van informed consent een niet-medisch noodzakelijke ingreep hebben ondergaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over het bericht ‘Burgemeester moet slapende rekenkamer wekken’

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether dormant municipal audit committees (slapende rekenkamers) violate the Municipalities Act, how many exist, and what sanctions or powers apply. The minister confirmed that a dormant audit committee breaches the law, named no municipalities, said there is currently no power to intervene, and pointed to a planned bill and a working group's recommendations.
There is currently no possibility to intervene when municipal councils fail to perform a task that the Municipalities Act requires of them.
