An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that hundreds of old murder and sex cases could be solved using about 20,000 blood samples held by the NFI, including samples from convicted offenders, and whether consent could be sought to extract DNA. The minister said about 26,000 samples are held, that many were taken without a DNA-testing legal basis, and that the legal and practical feasibility of asking consent is still being examined, with no concrete action yet.
I understand the wish to use the blood samples in question for DNA research after all, and in this way possibly to contribute further to the investigation of serious violent or sexual offences.

Ik begrijp de wens om de betreffende bloedmonsters alsnog voor DNA-onderzoek te benutten en deze op die manier mogelijk verder bij te laten dragen aan de opsporing van ernstige geweld- of zedenmisdrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Groothuizen over het artikel dat zestig moordzaken zouden zijn besmet door NFI-ruzie

MPs Van Oosten and Groothuizen asked whether about sixty murder cases were tainted by irregularities and internal conflict at the Netherlands Forensic Institute (NFI). The Minister replied that the figure was not confirmed, that an independent commission found six reports not or partly reviewed with no consequences for cases, and that corrective measures and a culture-change programme were underway.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Azmani over het bericht ‘Verblijfsvergunning brengt verantwoordelijkheid met zich mee’

MPs Van Oosten and Azmani asked whether courts weigh the loss of a residence permit when sentencing offenders, and whether revocation should follow automatically after serious convictions. The minister answered that judges weigh all circumstances without binding guidelines on this point, that IND revocation uses a sliding scale with individual assessment reviewable by the administrative court, and that no change of policy is planned though signals will be monitored.
It is for the independent judge to weigh all facts and circumstances in the individual case and reach a judgment.
Het is aan de onafhankelijke rechter om in het individuele geval alle feiten en omstandigheden te wegen en tot een oordeel te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer en Van Oosten over het tegengaan van winkeldiefstal

MPs Wörsdörfer and Van Oosten asked about the scale of shop theft, use of collective shop bans, and whether filing a police report is required for civil settlements and information sharing. The minister said reliable damage figures cannot yet be given and a follow-up study is underway, that bans are used with few obstacles, that police are improving the reporting process, and that a report is needed for the standard civil charge but not for sharing information within the ban system.
A follow-up study is currently being carried out to answer whether it is possible to achieve proper registration and reliable data.
Op dit moment wordt een vervolgonderzoek uitgevoerd dat antwoord moet geven op de vraag of het mogelijk is tot een goede registratie en betrouwbare gegevens te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Wiersma over het bericht van RTL Nieuws dat tientallen criminelen een uitkering ontvangen ondanks een openstaande celstraf

Two MPs asked why convicts evading an open prison sentence still receive benefits, and whether the state can recover them and tighten the law. The minister says the practice is unjustifiable, describes a CJIB-UWV data-matching process and a pilot letter scheme to meet Centrale Raad van Beroep rulings, and sees no need for a law change.
For this small remaining group, I am therefore, together with my colleague at SZW, taking an additional step to stop the benefit.
Voor deze kleine resterende groep zet ik daarom samen met mijn ambtsgenoot van SZW nog een extra stap om de uitkering stop te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Yesilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht 'Openbaar Ministerie luistert journalist af in moordzaak broer kroongetuige'

MPs Van Oosten and Yesilgöz-Zegerius asked whether the Public Prosecution Service secretly recorded a journalist in the murder investigation of a crown witness's brother, and what safeguards exist. The Minister acknowledged the recording was ordered with rechter-commissaris authorisation, was never listened to, and was destroyed, admitting internal review was missed; he pointed to the press source-protection bill and revised directive as reforms.

Prior to the order concerning this measure, the required internal review did not take place, and the OM considered that in this specific case the recording was an impermissible infringement on journalists' source protection.

Voorafgaand aan het bevel ten aanzien van dit middel heeft niet de vereiste interne toetsing plaatsgevonden en het OM was van oordeel dat in dit specifieke geval de opname een ontoelaatbare inbreuk was op de bronbescherming van journalisten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Arno Rutte over cold case teams

MPs Van Oosten and Arno Rutte (VVD) asked the Minister of Justice and Security about variation in cold case team capacity across police units, OM coordination, involvement of families and outsiders, and the use of new DNA techniques on old blood samples. Minister Grapperhaus answered that each unit has at least 3 fte for cold cases, that the Public Prosecution Service and police coordinate through portfolio holders without central direction, that families are kept informed on request, and that DNA-linking old samples requires consent under the law, with an evaluation due in spring 2019.
The decision to set up a cold case investigation is taken regionally by the competent authority.
Het besluit tot instelling van een cold case onderzoek wordt regionaal genomen door het bevoegd gezag.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam, Van Oosten en Van der Graaf over de verklaring (nr. 2) van het bestuur van de Stichting Vliegramp MH17 inzake meldingen en publiciteit over lichamelijke resten op MH17-crashsite

MPs asked whether recent YouTube videos and a foundation statement about bone fragments found at the MH17 crash site show that remains were planted to undermine the JIT investigation, and what action the government has taken. The minister answered that remains may still be found but the claimed location is unlikely, that no reports of new finds came in to official contacts, that the JIT has no concrete evidence of planting, and that Nederland has asked the OVSE and Grieving Nations to press the de facto authorities to hand over remains.
Contact will be made with the journalist with an urgent request to hand over all bone fragments to the authorities.
Er zal contact met de journalist worden opgenomen met het dringende verzoek alle botfragmenten aan de autoriteiten over te dragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Oosten over het bericht ‘Het no cure no pay-verbod binnen de advocatuur moet worden opgeheven’

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a report calling for lifting the ban on no-cure-no-pay arrangements in the legal profession, and about the effects and future of the ongoing pilot in injury and fatal-damage cases. The minister answered that the pilot aims to widen access to justice, that the Dutch Bar (NOvA) is evaluating it and will decide before year-end on continuation, and that other countries and other legal fields are not yet assessed.
I do not have an overview of other European countries without a ban on no cure no pay, nor of the effects in those countries on the costs of the legal profession and access to justice.
Ik heb geen overzicht van andere Europese landen die geen verbod op «no cure no pay» hebben, noch van de effecten in die landen op de kosten van de advocatuur en de toegang tot het recht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten, Remco Dijkstra, Jasper van Dijk en Laçin over het bericht 'Nederlands rijbewijs online te koop via Poolse website'

MPs from VVD and SP asked whether fake Dutch driving licences sold via a Polish website endanger road safety, how often forgeries are found and prosecuted, what is being done to take the site down, and whether employers check licences. The minister answered that forgeries are rare and prosecuted under existing law, that Poland lacks a legal basis to act against the site until a pending bill takes effect, and that the site's removal depends on Polish authorities.
The Polish Ministry said the relevant Polish authorities are aware of the site's activities, but without a legal expansion there is no basis to act against these practices.

Het Poolse Ministerie liet weten dat de relevante Poolse autoriteiten aandacht hebben voor de activiteiten van de bewuste site, maar dat zonder wettelijke verruiming er geen grond is voor optreden tegen deze praktijken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Arno Rutte over het bericht ‘Gemeenten gaan huurders van boerenschuren screenen’

MPs Van Oosten and Rutte asked whether the government supports municipalities screening tenants of farm barns for criminal records to prevent drug labs or cannabis grow sites, and about reviving the 'stoplight model' for police advice to private landlords. The minister welcomed local initiatives against undermining crime, said the stoplight model lacked a legal basis and was stopped, and that the government is studying the problem.
Data protection law provides no room to restart the implementation of the stoplight model.
Het gegevensbeschermingsrecht biedt geen ruimte om een doorstart te maken met de uitvoering van het stoplichtmodel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Arno Rutte over het stilleggen van een strafzaak omdat de voortgang door toedoen van het openbaar ministerie te traag verliep

MPs Van Oosten and Arno Rutte asked why a criminal case was halted because prosecution delays, and what measures prevent repetition. The Minister acknowledged backlog at two prosecution offices, attributed it partly to a court-room shortage, and pointed to a joint review and planned measures, while the court itself ruled the delay violated due process.
The court ruled that the public prosecution service acted contrary to the principles of due process, so the suspect faced an unreasonably long period of uncertainty about the outcome of his case.
De rechtbank heeft hierop geoordeeld dat het openbaar ministerie in strijd heeft gehandeld met de beginselen van een behoorlijke procesorde
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Arno Rutte over een vonnis waarbij een taakstraf wordt opgelegd na (poging tot) mishandeling van een agent

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Justice whether a community sentence after an assault (or attempted assault) on a police officer adequately reflects the seriousness of attacks on public servants, and what steps would ensure custodial sentences and higher arrest rates. The Minister declined to comment on the judge's sentence, stated that violence against public servants is aggravating under sentencing guidelines, pointed to an evaluation of the 2012 restriction on community sentences with a policy response to come, and said the ELA enforcement agreements remain in force with no known signs of low arrest rates.
It is for the judge to decide on the finding of guilt, and on a finding of guilt, on the sanction to be imposed.
Het is aan de rechter om te oordelen over de schuldigverklaring, en bij een schuldigverklaring over de op te leggen sanctie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Oosten over ontbrekende DNA-profielen van veroordeelde criminelen

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that tens of thousands of convicted criminals lack DNA profiles in the databank, and whether the backlog harms case solving and the ministry's legal compliance. The minister denied breaking the law, said the backlog clean-up is complete with 268,230 profiles stored, and announced plans to end mandatory DNA collection for juveniles given a 40-hour community service sentence following a UN Human Rights Committee ruling, via a law amendment to be put to consultation.
The Ministry complies with the law.
Het Ministerie houdt zich aan de wet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Van Oosten en Van Toorenburg over het bericht dat de vader van een ontvoerd kind alimentatie moet betalen

MPs Van Nispen, Van Oosten and Van Toorenburg asked whether the Dutch collection agency LBIO may enforce foreign alimony orders against a parent whose child was abducted abroad. The minister acknowledged the harshness, said the treaties offer limited grounds to refuse, and announced practical improvements such as LBIO summarising the left-behind parent's objections and checking for abduction cases in court requests.

As also promised during the General Consultation on Personal and Family Law on 16 May, I have engaged with the LBIO to examine how current practice can be improved, within the limited possibilities the treaties allow.

Zoals ook toegezegd tijdens het Algemeen Overleg Personen- en familierecht van 16 mei jongstleden ben ik met het LBIO in gesprek gegaan om te bekijken op welke wijze de huidige praktijk verbeterd kan worden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en De Lange over veiligheidshuizen en het delen van informatie tussen de ketenpartners

Two VVD MPs asked whether safety houses (veiligheidshuizen) lack a legal basis to share information needed for decisions on compulsory care, whether they will create one, and how medical confidentiality and the GDPR affect information sharing. The minister and state secretary answered that partners rely on their own legal bases, the Wvggz from 2020 provides sharing grounds, a bill on joint data processing is coming, and existing guidance and conflict-of-duties rules apply.
Soon the bill on data processing by cooperative partnerships will go into consultation.
Binnenkort gaat het wetsvoorstel gegevensverwerking door samenwerkingsverbanden in consultatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Oosten over het bericht 'Gevaarlijk pedohandboek ongestoord verspreid via internet'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether a dangerous paedophile handbook circulating on the internet could be prosecuted, whether possession should be criminalised as in the UK, and what measures exist. The minister answered that the Darkweb makes perpetrators hard to trace, that the Netherlands' general criminal provisions already cover such material, and that a new law is not needed, while promising a progress letter in September.
Dutch criminal law therefore currently offers sufficient possibilities to act against the distribution or production of handbooks with criminal content on the internet.
Het Nederlandse strafrecht biedt vooralsnog dan ook voldoende mogelijkheden om te kunnen optreden tegen de verspreiding of vervaardiging van handboeken met strafbare inhoud op het internet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Wiersma over meer arbeidsslaven in Europa dan sekswerkers

Two VVD MPs asked the government about reports of more labour exploitation than sex trafficking in Europe, the claimed halving of registered trafficking cases in the Netherlands, prosecution and sentencing statistics, and progress on the coalition agreement's plans to strengthen the fight against trafficking. The Secretary of State answered that the rise in labour exploitation is worrying, that registered victims fell from 1,256 in 2014 to 952 in 2016 with a slight recovery in 2017, provided statistics on victims, prosecutions and sentences, and said a pimping ban and a broader interdepartmental plan are in preparation.
There is no question of a halving.
Er is geen sprake van een halvering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Oosten over het bericht 'Een database om miljardenfraudes te voorkomen: in het VK kan ’t wél’

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the UK fraud register (Cifas), the Dutch FraudeInfodesk and whether the Data Protection Authority blocks it. The government says it cannot direct the independent AP, that cross-sector data sharing remains possible under the GDPR subject to an AP permit, and that it will await experience with the permit application before considering new legislation.
It is not for the Minister of Justice and Security or for me to direct the AP on how it grants permits under Article 33(4)(c) and (5) of the UAVG after the implementing act takes effect.

Het is niet aan de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid of aan mij om de AP sturing te geven op de wijze waarop zij na de inwerkingtreding van de Uitvoeringswet Algemene verordening gegevensbescherming (UAVG) krachtens artikel 33, vierde lid, aanhef en onderdeel c, en vijfde lid van die wet vergunningen verleent.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Oosten over het bericht 'Aanhoudingsverzoeken, wraking, neerleggen verdediging - recht op een eerlijk proces versus misbruik van procesrecht’

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that wraking requests and withdrawal of defence counsel in criminal cases are increasingly used to delay trials, and whether rules against abuse of procedure are needed. The minister reported stable wraking figures, said withdrawal of defence is hard to sanction, and pointed to existing sanctions for abusive wraking requests, faster handling measures, and consultation on the new Code of Criminal Procedure.
Figures from the Council for the Judiciary show that the number of wraking requests filed each year is fairly stable.
Uit cijfers van de Raad voor de Rechtspraak blijkt dat het aantal wrakingsverzoeken dat jaarlijks wordt gedaan redelijk stabiel is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Tielen over de Nieuwsuurreportage 'Honderden Roma-kinderen in Nederland uitgebuit'

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Justice and Security and of Health, Welfare and Sport about a Nieuwsuur report on Roma children exploited in criminal activity, including what is being done about multi-problem families, information sharing between municipalities and abroad, and why some municipalities dropped recommended approaches. The state secretary answered that knowledge has been gathered, that a national adviser has been appointed, and that inter-ministerial and cross-border cooperation exists, but declined to give figures on exploited children and said RvdK does not register ethnicity.
Because children are not registered by ethnicity at the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming, I cannot say whether or how often Roma children have been placed out of home.
Omdat kinderen bij de RvdK niet worden geregistreerd op etniciteit, kan ik niet aangeven of en hoe vaak Roma kinderen uit huis zijn geplaatst
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Oosten over arresten van de Hoge Raad in de Valkenburgse zedenzaak

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about Supreme Court rulings allowing a one-day unconditional prison term alongside a community sentence for serious sex offences, and whether the law should be tightened. The minister declined to judge the individual sentence, noted the 2012 restriction on community sentences for serious sex and violent crimes, and said the evaluation's recommendation for changing the legal framework will be addressed in a policy response before summer 2018.
I aim to send my policy response to the report to the House of Representatives before the summer of 2018.
Ik streef ernaar mijn beleidsreactie op het rapport voor de zomer van 2018 aan de Tweede Kamer te zenden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Van Oosten over het artikel 'Opleggen van huisverbod moet vaker en sneller'

MPs Tielen and Van Oosten asked about a call by The Hague's mayor to impose household bans more often and faster, and about hulpverlening follow-up, extensions, and information sharing in domestic violence cases. The minister defends the household ban as an effective tool within a broader safety plan, acknowledges problems organising aid, says extensions are only legal when danger persists, and points to ongoing programmes and existing reporting code.
There are therefore no figures available on this.
Er zijn hierover daarom geen cijfers beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Wörsdörfer over de verhaalspositie van het MKB bij onbetwiste geldvorderingen

MPs Van Oosten and Wörsdörfer asked whether Belgium's 2016 out-of-court debt collection procedure for undisputed claims between businesses should be introduced in the Netherlands to strengthen small and medium-sized firms' position. The minister answered that its added value is unclear, that rule-of-law safeguards and cost questions need study, and that a further exploration will follow once the Belgian law's effects are clearer.

The rule-of-law safeguard of out-of-court dispute resolution methods such as arbitration and binding advice lies, as a recently published report on this subject also showed, among other things in the fact that one must go to the judge for an enforceable title.

De rechtsstatelijke waarborging van buitengerechtelijke geschiloplossingsmethoden zoals arbitrage en bindend advies, is – zo bleek ook in een recentelijk gepubliceerd rapport over dit onderwerp – onder meer gelegen in het gegeven dat men voor een titel voor tenuitvoerlegging naar de rechter moet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Oosten over het bericht 'Bajesbewaker bedreigd'

The MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about an anonymous threat on 17 January 2018 to shoot staff with an automatic machine gun at the Alphen prison, and what measures would prevent recurrence and detect smuggling. The Minister answered that police and DJI responded adequately, staff safety was never at risk, all prisoners were locked in, and a study of new detection technology will be sent to parliament before summer 2018.
I will send this exploration to your House before summer 2018.
Ik zal uw Kamer voor de zomer 2018 deze verkenning doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Oosten over de strijd tegen seksuele uitbuiting van minderjarigen

Member Van Oosten (VVD) asked the Justice and Security ministers about combating sexual exploitation of minors, including boys, information sharing by youth care with police, the use of decoy operations by Terre des Hommes, and specialised victim care. The government answered that boys' victimisation is under-recognised, that an interdepartmental action plan is in preparation, that decoy use by private parties faces legal limits, and that the sexual offences law modernisation consultation is expected around summer 2018.
As announced in the answer to questions 2 and 4, an interdepartmental action plan is currently being developed.
Zoals aangekondigd in het antwoord op vraag 2 en 4, wordt er momenteel gewerkt aan de ontwikkeling van een interdepartementaal plan van aanpak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Arno Rutte over het bericht 'Lage straf door trage rechtsgang'

VVD MPs asked the Justice and Rechtsbescherming ministers about reports that sentences were reduced because criminal cases took too long, and what causes the delays and what will be done. The ministers acknowledged that reasonable-term breaches can reduce sentences, cited capacity shortages and reported measures such as ZSM, the Verkeerstoren and extra judges in the north, while stating that no registration of such overruns exists.
The court and the Public Prosecution Service do not keep records of exceedances of the reasonable time limit and the consequences attached to them.
De rechtbank en het OM houden geen registratie bij van overschrijdingen van de redelijke termijn en welke gevolgen daaraan zijn verbonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Van den Bosch over het bericht ‘Kwetsbaarheid voor omkoping een reëel risico’

MPs Van Oosten and Van den Bosch asked whether municipalities can adequately screen risk-sensitive officials for criminal antecedents, given reports of vulnerability to bribery and infiltration. The minister answered that VOG screening exists with a ten-year lookback for political office holders, that a study and a Netwerk Weerbaar Bestuur are underway, and that a bill extending VOG refusals to police data is in preparation, while the Bibob bureau's role would require further study.

As known to your House, I am preparing a bill under which, for certain vulnerable functions in the security domain, a VOG can be refused not only on the basis of judicial documentation but also on the basis of police data.

Zoals bij uw Kamer bekend, bereid ik een wetsvoorstel voor waarbij voor bepaalde kwetsbare functies binnen het veiligheidsdomein de VOG niet alleen kan worden geweigerd op basis van justitiële documentatie, maar ook op basis van politiegegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Oosten over de controle op drank- c.q. drugsgebruik bij de overleden veroorzaker van een gruwelijk ongeval

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether the deceased driver in a fatal crash was tested for alcohol or drugs, whether relatives can obtain this information, and whether the law should allow post-mortem blood or drug tests. The minister said the question fell outside the taskforce's scope, that relatives can ask the prosecutor for case outcomes, and that modernising the Criminal Procedure Code is examining post-mortem examinations, without committing to a concrete change.
It has turned out, however, that this question falls outside the scope of the Taskforce.
Gebleken is echter dat deze vraag de scope van de Taskforce te buiten gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Van Oosten over vrijspraak van de heer Poch in Argentinië

MPs Ten Broeke and Van Oosten asked the ministers about the Argentine acquittal of Mr Poch, the state's role in facilitating his prosecution, an anonymous prosecutor's remark, and the adequacy of consular assistance. The government answered that legal aid was given within the existing framework, that the state does not interfere in foreign criminal cases, that consular support was provided throughout detention, and that Mr Poch returned to the Netherlands on 7 December 2017.
The State refrains from substantive involvement in criminal cases that are before the (foreign) judge.
De Staat onthoudt zich van inhoudelijke bemoeienis met strafzaken die onder de (buitenlandse) rechter zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Azmani over het bericht 'criminele Albanezen zijn de opkomende groep in de drugshandel'

MPs Van Oosten and Azmani asked the Justice Minister about reports that Albanian criminals are an emerging group in drug trafficking, and whether visa liberalisation for Albania should be reversed. The minister confirmed a rise in Albanian suspects, described ongoing enforcement and EU monitoring, and said the government will await the Commission's monitor before deciding on the emergency brake, while stating it has no reason to doubt Albanian authorities' cooperation.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Oosten over de mogelijkheid tot het opleggen van tbs bij weigerachtige verdachten

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether courts can impose tbs (compulsory psychiatric treatment) on suspects who refuse psychiatric observation, and how refusing or non-cooperating tbs patients are managed. The Minister answered that courts can impose tbs without a pJ-report using other sources, that a legislative regulation on refusing observandi is pending, and that the government is examining further measures and will inform parliament in early 2018.
That is why I am currently examining in full breadth which measures can contribute to a solution, alongside the interventions already taken and being introduced.
Daarom onderzoek ik op dit moment in de volle breedte welke maatregelen aan een oplossing kunnen bijdragen, naast de interventies die al zijn getroffen en worden ingevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam, Van Oosten, Groothuizen en Segers over het bericht ‘Grote strafzaken verhuizen van rechtbank Almelo naar Zwolle’

MPs asked whether the move of multi-judge Functioneel Parket criminal cases from Almelo to Zwolle follows from the Herziening Gerechtelijke Kaart and whether Almelo keeps enough work. The minister confirmed the move follows from 2012 agreements, that Almelo remains a main location, and gave hour figures showing fewer multi-judge hearings in Almelo in 2018.
The shift of multi-judge Functioneel Parket criminal cases to Zwolle from 1 January 2018 flows directly from agreements made in 2012 within the framework of the Judicial Map Revision Act (HGK).

De verschuiving van meervoudige strafzaken van het Functioneel Parket per 1 januari 2018 naar Zwolle, zijnde de vestigingsplaats van het Functioneel Parket in Overijssel, vloeit direct voort uit afspraken die in 2012 het kader van de Wet Herziening Gerechtelijke Kaart (HGK) zijn gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Oosten over het bericht “Vloggen in de bajes”

An MP asked the minister about a report of prison staff being filmed and corrupt staff smuggling mobile phones, and about the use of private security staff in prisons. The minister said mobile phones are banned, staff are screened and checked, disciplinary measures apply, and an improvement study with DJI is under way.

As you may have read in my policy response to the Inspectorate report 'Binnen de muren niet toegestaan', I am examining together with DJI the options to improve policy and the current approach to smuggling contraband into prisons.

Zoals u in mijn beleidsreactie op het Inspectierapport «Binnen de muren niet toegestaan 2 » heeft kunnen lezen, onderzoek ik samen met DJI de mogelijkheden om het beleid en de huidige aanpak tegen het binnenbrengen van contrabande te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht 'Oostenrijk hekelt Nederlandse aanpak drugsproducenten'

MPs Van Oosten and Dijkstra asked whether Austria's criticism that the Netherlands does too little against underground drug labs is justified, and about clean-up costs, cofinancing of drug-waste dumping and post-related drug trafficking. The minister rejected the claim of Dutch laxity, said the cooperation with Austria functions well, described the dismantling and cost-recovery arrangements, and reported underspending and an ongoing evaluation of the cofinancing scheme.
It has not become clear to the Dutch authorities which requests Austria is referring to in the reporting.
Het is de Nederlandse autoriteiten niet duidelijk geworden op welke verzoeken Oostenrijk in de berichtgeving duidt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Oosten over het bericht 'Voortvluchtige criminelen ontlopen gevangenisstraf'

An MP asked why criminals can escape prison sentences through execution limitation periods, whether limitation should be interrupted when offenders evade enforcement, and how those who ignore summons to report to prison are treated. The State Secretary defended the current limitation system, noting interruption rules and that most custodial enforcement occurs early in the period, and explained that non-reporting offenders are arrested and placed in a stricter regime.
I therefore consider the current limitation system valid and am currently focusing on improving enforcement of sentences.
Daarmee vind ik dat het stelsel van huidige verjaringstermijnen valide is en zet ik op dit moment in op de verbetering van de tenuitvoerlegging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer, Van Oosten en Van der Linde over de viersporigheid van het treinverkeer tussen Rotterdam en Schiedam n.a.v. een werkbezoek op 23 januari jl.

Three VVD MPs asked the State Secretary about keeping intercity stops at Schiedam Centrum and the four-track option between Rotterdam and Schiedam after a site visit. The State Secretary answered that the intercity stop may be kept only if four tracks are built and a study is ongoing, with no negotiations started and no Schiedam Kethel study reopened.
The study commissioned by the MRDH and carried out by ProRail shows that with PHS the existing Intercity stop by the Amsterdam-The Hague-Rotterdam-Dordrecht/Vlissingen service cannot be maintained.

Uit het onderzoek, dat in opdracht van de MRDH door ProRail is uitgevoerd, blijkt dat met PHS de bestaande Intercity-stop door de Intercitydienst Amsterdam-Den Haag-Rotterdam-Dordrecht/Vlissingen niet kan worden gehandhaafd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Oosten over het Nederlandse wapenbeleid

An MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security whether Dutch firearms policy is failing, given UK concerns about illegal guns smuggled through the Netherlands and the tougher UK sentencing and enforcement. The minister rejects the claim that policy is failing, points to intensified enforcement and new coordination structures, and says capacity and prioritisation are under continuous review without committing to a specific new step.
I do not agree with the claim that Dutch firearms policy is failing.
Ik ben het niet eens met de stelling dat het Nederlandse wapenbeleid faalt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Recourt, Van Oosten, Kooiman en Van der Staaij over de documentaire ‘Grenzeloos misbruikt’

Five MPs asked the ministers of Justice, Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade about the documentary on child sex tourism and webcam abuse, including police capacity, investigative powers, Philippine cooperation, liaison staffing and funding. The government answered in detail, describing existing measures, the Plan van Aanpak, the Manila liaison extension and the Down to Zero programme, while declining to commit additional funds or expertise for Philippine police training due to scarce specialised capacity.

Because these efforts require scarce specialised operational police capacity, which would then not be available for investigation in the Netherlands, I am unfortunately forced to be restrained in this regard.

Omdat deze inspanningen de inzet vereisen van schaarse gespecialiseerde operationele capaciteit van de politie, die daardoor niet voor de opsporing in Nederland beschikbaar is, ben ik helaas gedwongen hiermee terughoudend om te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Van Oosten over het bericht ‘Aantal dumpingen drugsafval afgelopen jaren gestegen’

MPs Dijkstra and Van Oosten asked the Minister of Justice and Security about rising drug-waste dumping and whether many incidents go unreported and unpunished. The Minister acknowledges unreported cases, points to integrated regional approaches and the LFO specialist unit, and says cost recovery from offenders cannot be fully reported from existing systems.
No complete overview of cases in which suspects were convicted for dumping drug waste, and of the costs recovered from them, can be generated from the registration systems of the OM and the police.

Uit de registratiesystemen van het OM en de politie is geen volledig overzicht te genereren van zaken waarin verdachten zijn veroordeeld voor het dumpen van drugsafval en de eventueel op hen verhaalde kosten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Miltenburg en Van Oosten over het bericht 'OM kan aangiften discriminatie niet aan, slechts kwart behandeld'

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice and Interior ministers about a report that prosecutors cannot handle discrimination complaints and only a quarter are processed, and how this fits the government's call to report discrimination. The minister confirmed the figures, said police must record all discrimination complaints under the Aanwijzing Discriminatie, admitted no verified explanation exists for the decline, and pledged to keep discrimination prosecution a priority while noting measures to raise reporting rates.
Yes, I share that view and I have also expressed my concerns about this to the Chair of the College of Procurators-General.
Ja, die mening deel ik en ik heb hierover ook mijn zorgen geuit aan de voorzitter van het College van Procureurs-Generaal.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Oosten over de kwaliteit van forensische artsen

MPs Van Nispen and Van Oosten asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the quality of forensic doctors, citing claims that non-natural deaths and abuse are often missed by treating doctors and that forensic work is done on the side. The minister acknowledged the knowledge gap among treating doctors, said the profession is primarily responsible for quality, and pointed to ongoing steps including a NFI review of lijkschouw and the Hoes committee report due at year end.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Van Oosten over moleculaire drugs die niet onder de Opiumwet vallen

MPs Ziengs and Van Oosten (VVD) asked about reports that new molecular drugs fall outside the Opium Act, the online trade in such drugs, and related research. The state secretary answered that existing procedures (CAM, EMCDDA, WHO risk assessments) can place substances under the Opium Act, that current enforcement against online drug trade is adequate, and that pending WODC and Trimbos studies will be sent to parliament.
I consider the current effort adequate.
Ik acht de huidige inzet afdoende.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Oosten over het artikel “Cipier met mes aangevallen”

An MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about reports of guards being attacked with knives and smuggling in prisons, including Alphen aan den Rijn, and about integrity, contraband controls and staff complaint channels. The State Secretary answered that the incidents occurred, that the Inspectorate was asked to speed up its integrity investigation, and that existing measures (screening, searches, complaint channels, sanctions) are considered sufficient, with no new measures planned.
Although the claims made in these articles are not recognised within my organisation, I nonetheless asked the Inspectorate of Security and Justice to bring forward its integrity investigation.
Hoewel de in deze artikelen geuite beweringen niet worden herkend in mijn organisatie, heb ik de Inspectie Veiligheid en Justitie (IVenJ) toch gevraagd haar onderzoek naar integriteit te vervroegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Van der Burg over sexting

MPs Van Oosten and Van der Burg asked the Minister of Security and Justice about sexting, police and prosecution policy on sexual images of minors, and whether current prevention is adequate. The minister answered that case-by-case judgment applies under the existing child pornography law, that the framework allows enough room for tailored prosecution, and that a review of more tailored sentencing for juvenile offenders is planned, while listing existing awareness campaigns.
According to all organisations in the criminal justice chain, the current legal framework on child pornography offers sufficient room for tailored prosecution.
Volgens alle organisaties in de strafrechtketen biedt het huidige wettelijk kader met betrekking tot kinderpornografie voldoende ruimte voor maatwerk bij de vervolging.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Van Oosten en Van der Linde over het boek ““Wat niet mag, kan nog steeds”; kraakhandleiding 2015/2016”

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether a squatting handbook with tips on illegal occupation should be tolerated, whether its publication is punishable, and whether a Hogeschool van Amsterdam staff member's study time was misused to write it. The minister said the book is inappropriate but that judging free speech limits is not for him, referred the criminal question to the Public Prosecution Service, pointed to local administrative enforcement powers, and said the college's work was an 1 individual student's responsibility after checking that the original paper concerned legal policy.
As the title suggests, the authors of the book are aware that squatting is a punishable offence.
Zoals uit de titel valt af te leiden, zijn de schrijvers van het boek ermee bekend dat kraken een strafbare handeling is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Oosten over een ex-tbs’er die in Leeuwarden een vrouw doodde

An MP asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice whether legal means exist to protect society from a former TBS patient known as dangerous, the limits the ECHR Van der Velden ruling places on extending TBS, and whether the mayor's powers could be widened. The answer refers the MP to a separate letter responding to the same news report, without answering the questions on substance.
The written questions from MP Van Oosten (VVD), question number 2015Z19655, have been answered by means of the letter 'Response to report Dangerous TBS patient should not have been released'.
De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Van Oosten (VVD) vraagnummer 2015Z19655 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Reactie op bericht «Gevaarlijke tbs'er had niet vrij hoeven komen»»
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en De Caluwé over de meerjarenplannen van de Raad voor de Rechtspraak

Two MPs asked the Justice and Interior ministers how access to justice at reasonable distance is guaranteed under the judiciary's multi-year plans, and about regional employment effects and coordination with other government relocations. The minister answered that the 32 court locations remain legally fixed, that the relocation may shift jobs locally but not reduce total judiciary employment, and that the housing minister will report in autumn on regional employment effects.
The proposed location policy, as described in the proposed multi-year plan, leads to a shift of jobs within a number of courts.
Het voorgenomen locatiebeleid, zoals beschreven in het voorgenomen MJP, leidt tot een verschuiving van arbeidsplaatsen binnen een aantal gerechten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Oosten over de open brief van de regioburgemeesters inzake het afpakken van crimineel vermogen

MP Van Oosten (VVD) asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a letter from regional mayors urging stronger confiscation of criminal assets, including a revolving fund, the budgeting obstacles, and the claimed EUR 9.3 billion in criminal wealth. The Minister welcomed the proposals, pointed to funding already provided and EUR 3 million structurally added, said a business case needs more evidence, and called the EUR 9.3 billion estimate unsubstantiated.

The ministries of Finance and of Security and Justice will therefore take the initiative to jointly examine with the relevant chain partners whether and how a sufficiently robust business case can be drawn up.

De ministeries van Financiën en van Veiligheid en Justitie nemen daarom het initiatief om gezamenlijk met betrokken ketenpartners te bezien of en hoe een voldoende harde business case kan worden opgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers, Van Oosten, Rebel, Oskam, Van Tongeren en Van der Staaij over de inzet van de Koninklijke Marechaussee bij de bestrijding van mensenhandel

MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the Royal Marechaussee's role in combating human trafficking, its legal basis in the Police Act, and more sniffer dogs for searching lorries. The minister confirmed the KMar's frequent involvement and stated that its trafficking-combating task is covered by existing police tasks, with a review of possible legal changes ongoing and some capacity measures taken.
Consultations are currently taking place between my department, the Public Prosecution Service, the police and the KMar to further improve cooperation in combating human trafficking.

Momenteel vindt er overleg plaats tussen mijn departement, het Openbaar Ministerie, de politie en de KMar om de samenwerking op het gebied van de bestrijding van mensenhandel nog verder te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Visser over diverse berichten in de media de afgelopen maanden omtrent het innen van financiële sancties

MPs Van Oosten and Visser asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about media reports on collecting financial penalties, including payment arrangements, detention orders, and enforcement measures such as vehicle impoundment and licence seizure. The State Secretary answered that all penalties must be collected, outlined existing payment and enforcement instruments with statistics, and announced an interim payment-instalment measure, a follow-up study on coercive instruments, and administrative improvements.
The starting point is and remains that all financial penalties must be paid in full.
Het uitgangspunt is en blijft dat alle financiële sancties geheel moeten worden voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Oosten over frauderen met rijkssubsidies

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether it is really easy to commit subsidy fraud with government funds, how subsidy applicants are screened, and whether government IT systems can recognise applicants previously caught for fraud. The minister acknowledged the press report, said risks are being examined and will be reported this autumn, and described existing screening rules, departmental registration of abusers, and the Bibob instrument, without committing to specific new measures yet.
Whether and how subsidy fraud can be committed, and what additional measures could be taken to limit possible fraud risks as far as possible, is currently being examined further.

Of en hoe fraude met overheidssubsidies kan worden gepleegd en welke aanvullende maatregelen mogelijk kunnen worden ondernomen om eventuele frauderisico's zoveel mogelijk te beperken, wordt thans nader onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Oosten over de aanwezigheid van verdachten van zware geweldsdelicten bij rechterlijke uitspraken

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether suspects of serious violent crimes should be required to attend court judgments, citing a 2015 Assen sentencing and arguments about accountability and victims' sense of justice. The Minister answered that there is no attendance obligation for judgments, that a court can order transport of the suspect only in exceptional cases, and that victim-related arrangements can be handled case by case.
Whether a judge decides to do so I would like to leave to the judge.
Of een rechter hiertoe besluit wil ik graag aan de rechter overlaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Oosten over het artikel ‘Nederland knooppunt wapensmokkel’

An MP asked the Justice and Defence ministers whether large shipments of machine pistols were regularly entering the Netherlands for onward distribution, how the smuggling is tackled, and how a Defence employee's involvement was possible. The minister said Europol could not confirm regular large shipments, that police had intervened in one acute case with ongoing prosecution, and that Defence runs security checks and opens investigations when information arises.
Beyond that, I cannot comment on this ongoing criminal case.
Voor het overige kan ik over deze lopende strafzaak geen uitlatingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Aukje De Vries over het bericht dat justitiebanen verdwijnen in Leeuwarden en dat uitholling dreigt voor het Leeuwarder Gerechtshof

MPs Van Oosten and Aukje de Vries asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether reports that justice jobs and services will leave Leeuwarden, weakening the Arnhem-Leeuwarden Court of Appeal, are accurate, and whether they would consult the Council for the Judiciary. The minister answered that he understands local concerns, but no decision has yet been made on the court's future accommodation, and the Council for the Judiciary will inform him soon.
However, there is currently no decision-making regarding the future accommodation needs of the court's organisational units.
Er is echter op dit moment geen sprake van besluitvorming over de toekomstige huisvestingsbehoefte van de organisatieonderdelen van het gerechtshof.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Van Toorenburg over hogere rentepercentages bij gemeentelijke samenwerkingsverbanden ten opzichte van rentepercentages bij individuele gemeenten

Two MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether the reported finding that municipal joint arrangements pay higher interest rates than individual municipalities warrants measures. The minister saw no reason for measures, noting the difference is small (4%), and said he would raise the matter in updated treasury guidance.
I see no reason to take measures now.
Ik zie geen reden om nu maatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde, Neppérus en Van Oosten over het bericht dat de gemeenten de macronorm voor OZB-stijging weer overschrijden

MPs Van der Linde, Neppérus and Van Oosten asked whether municipalities again exceed the 3% macro norm on OZB property tax increases and how this can be prevented. Minister Plasterk answered that the figures are not yet confirmed (COELO data due end March), that the norm was exceeded in four of the past seven years with limited cumulative effect, and that the matter is a shared municipal responsibility discussed in the annual Bofv consultation without committing to new measures.
Whether or not the macro norm is exceeded is a responsibility of the municipalities together.
Het al of niet overschrijden van de macronorm is een verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeenten tezamen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Steur en Van Oosten over het artikel ‘Geheimen mee in het graf’ dat oproept onder omstandigheden DNA-onderzoek te doen na een niet natuurlijke dood en omtrent een landelijk protoco

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice and Interior ministers whether DNA of deceased persons who died unnaturally should be compared with the police DNA database and whether a national autopsy protocol is needed. The minister said such DNA sampling is not generally justified, that sampling from a deceased suspect is limited by article 69 Sr, and that the legal basis will be addressed in the Criminal Procedure Code modernisation, plus a working group on a national protocol.

In setting the rules for taking cell material for DNA research from a deceased suspect or victim, the fundamental right to bodily integrity is currently insufficiently taken into account, and an intrusion on that right must be provided for by or under law.

Bij de normering voor het afnemen van celmateriaal voor DNA-onderzoek bij een overleden verdachte of slachtoffer van een strafbaar feit is op dit moment onvoldoende verdisconteerd dat het grondrecht op de onaantastbaarheid van het lichaam daarbij een rol speelt
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Taverne en Van Oosten over een nieuwe vorm van paspoort-fraude gepleegd door Oost-Europeanen

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about a newly discovered form of passport fraud by Eastern Europeans, including its mechanics, scale, damage, when the government learned of the police report, and measures taken. The government referred to its separate letter on the report on legal identity changes in the Balkans and Eastern Europe, which is the answer to these questions.

The written questions from MPs Taverne and Van Oosten (both VVD), question number 2014Z19791, have been answered by means of the letter 'Response to the report legal identity changes in the Balkans and Eastern Europe'.

Mededeling De schriftelijke vragen de leden Taverne en Van Oosten (beiden VVD), vraagnummer 2014Z19791 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Reactie op het rapport «legale identiteitswisselingen in de Balkan en Oost-Europa»» (Kamerstuk 17 050, nr.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Van der Steur over het bericht dat de rechtspraak een commercial court wil

MPs Van Oosten and Van der Steur asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the judiciary's proposal for a commercial court for large international trade disputes, including its effects on the business climate, comparisons with other countries, expected speed, and costs. The minister replied that he awaits the Council for the judiciary's exploratory study, cites the UK Commercial Court and existing specialised commercial jurisdiction, and declines to anticipate the outcome or give cost and speed estimates.
I await the outcomes of that exploration and do not consider it desirable to anticipate those outcomes.
Ik wacht de uitkomsten van die verkenning af en acht het niet wenselijk op de uitkomsten daarvan vooruit te lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schut-Welkzijn, Moors en Van Oosten over het bericht “Tweetal steelt AOW via DigiD-fraude”

MPs from the VVD asked the government about a report that two people stole old-age pensions via DigiD phishing fraud, and how victims were compensated and future fraud prevented. The state secretary answered that a criminal investigation found about 5,000 possibly misused DigiD accounts and total losses of about 50,000 euro, that victims were fully compensated, and that the government will try to recover the money and promote safer DigiD use, with a promised overview of further measures.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Van der Steur over de uitzending van Brandpunt over lijkschouwers

MPs Van Oosten and Van der Steur asked about a Brandpunt broadcast claiming forensic doctors miss crimes, and about standard protocols for death inspections (lijkschouw) including blood and urine testing. The minister replied that forensic doctors must be registered, that a national guideline exists requiring blood and urine sampling, that deviations are permitted if documented, and that no data on deviations is available.
There is no information available on whether, and if so how often, the guideline is deviated from.
Er is geen informatie beschikbaar over de vraag of, en zo ja, hoe vaak wordt afgeweken van de richtlijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Dijkhoff over ftp-servers die onvoldoende beveiligd zijn waardoor privégegevens van burgers te zien zijn

MPs Van Oosten and Dijkhoff asked whether privacy-sensitive data on insecure FTP servers could be misused, whether cases were known, what safeguards exist, and what the ministry and NCSC do to protect citizens and businesses. Minister Opstelten answered that information security is primarily the responsibility of citizens, businesses and government, that the Wbp applies, that no reported cases of misuse were received by the NCSC, and that awareness campaigns and the NCSS-2 strategy address the issue.
It should be borne in mind that information security is primarily the own responsibility of citizens, businesses and governments.
Hierbij dient te worden bedacht dat informatiebeveiliging primair een eigen verantwoordelijkheid van burgers, bedrijven en overheden is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen, Segers, Kooiman, Van der Steur, Van Oosten, Oskam, Rebel, Van Laar, Bontes en Jadnanansingover mensenhandel

MPs from several parties asked the Minister of Security and Justice about cooperation with Romania and Bulgaria on human trafficking, including police results, victim reception and return programmes, liaison posts, Roma victims, EU funds and border controls. The minister answered in detail on operational cooperation, joint investigation teams, return and reintegration projects, and border checks, giving substantive answers while noting that some data is unavailable.
There are no figures available on the number of people travelling from countries such as Bulgaria and Romania to other European countries, including the Netherlands.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal personen dat vanuit landen als Bulgarije en Roemenië naar andere Europese landen, waaronder Nederland, reist.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moors en van Oosten over een trust framework en eID

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about trust frameworks and personal data stores that give citizens control over their data, and about the government's role in e-identity initiatives. The minister answered that the government follows and partly supports such initiatives, that supervision is still being studied, and that legislation may be needed depending on the framework.
The cabinet set out in its e-privacy letter of 24 May 2013 several conditions for protecting personal data in the customer-business relationship.
Het kabinet heeft in haar e-privacybrief van 24 mei 2013 4 een aantal randvoorwaarden gesteld voor de bescherming van persoonsgegevens in de relatie klant-bedrijf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Potters over de gevolgen van het hebben van schulden voor zzp’ers

Two VVD MPs asked whether self-employed people (zzp'ers) with debts are effectively excluded from debt relief, since minnelijke trajecten are often unavailable and the Wsnp generally requires ending the business. The State Secretary answered that the Bbz scheme is the first route for viable businesses, that continuation under the Wsnp is possible with judicial permission but judges are cautious, and that municipalities decide how debt assistance is organised.
Municipalities are responsible for implementing the Bbz.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoering van het Bbz.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Van Oosten over het bericht "ING geeft adverteerder inzicht in klantgedrag

Two MPs asked the Finance Minister about ING's plan to give advertisers insight into customers' payment behaviour and whether it fits privacy rules and the Dutch banks' data code. The minister answered that consent and purpose-limitation rules apply, that the plan's scope is unclear and banks must demonstrate compliance, and that the privacy regulator may investigate but no ruling was given.
It is not for me, nor for the State Secretary of Security and Justice, to rule on compatibility with the Code of Conduct or the Wbp.
Het is niet aan mij noch aan de Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie om een uitspraak te doen over de verenigbaarheid met de Gedragscode of de Wbp.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Ziengs over de flexibilisering van huurcontracten

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers whether the fixed terms of commercial lease contracts make shop premises inflexible and whether Dutch lease law allows short leases. The minister replied that the Civil Code balances landlord and tenant interests, that 5-year terms can be shortened to 2 years or less, and that a stakeholder platform (Winkeltop) is working on the vacancy problem.
All in all, a considerable degree of flexibility is provided.
Er wordt al met al de nodige flexibiliteit gegeven.

Vragen van de leden Dijkhoff en Van Oosten (beiden VVD) aan de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie en de Staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de politie die regelmatig gebruik zou maken van ov-chipkaartgege

MPs Dijkhoff and Van Oosten ask whether police routinely request OV-chipcard travel data from Translink Systems and parking data from SHPV, under what conditions, and what privacy safeguards apply. The minister confirms requests occur only under Article 126nd Sv or Article 3 Politiewet with Public Prosecution Service review, gives counts for 2012 and 2013 for TLS, and points to legal criteria and data protection law as safeguards.
I do not have figures of this kind available for SHPV.
Ik heb geen beschikking over dergelijke cijfers met betrekking tot SHPV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leegte en Van Oosten over het artikel waarin de International Chamber of Commerce, ICC, wijst op de risico’s van corruptie voor bedrijven

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Trade and Justice about an ICC warning that corruption risks for companies are underestimated, including the effects of US and UK anti-bribery law on Dutch SMEs and support for firms acting in good faith. The government rejected the ICC's picture, pointed to outreach measures, the 2012 OECD evaluation and planned integrated policy response, but gave no new commitments beyond ongoing talks with the ICC.
The cabinet does not recognise the picture that the ICC paints.
Het kabinet herkent zich niet in het beeld dat de ICC schetst.
Antwoord op Vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Vuijk over het zelden vooraf bekend maken van dronevluchten

Two VVD MPs asked why only 9 percent of drone flights were announced in advance in 2013 compared with 87 percent in 2011, and why flights were announced afterwards rather than beforehand, including how this relates to privacy rules. The minister explained the drop by a 2012 decision removing the separate airspace application for training flights, said civil authorities decide on pre- or post-flight publication, and stated the camera footage does not show identifiable persons.
With a view to the confidentiality and effectiveness of criminal investigations, it is generally not desirable to announce flights in advance.
Met het oog op de vertrouwelijkheid en effectiviteit van strafrechtelijke onderzoeken is het doorgaans niet wenselijk om vluchten van te voren aan te kondigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Oosten over de gevolgen van het legaliseren van de online kansspelen

An MP asked whether legalising online gambling would substantially reduce payouts to good-cause lotteries and how good causes could benefit from online regulation. The minister rejected the fear of substitution, citing research and growth figures, but admitted no guarantee exists, and said the bill allows mandatory contributions while primary aims remain player protection.
The purpose of regulating gambling is to protect players against the risks of addiction, deception and crime.
Het doel van de regulering van kansspelen is om spelers te beschermen tegen de risico's op verslaving, misleiding en criminaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Van Veen over een uitzending waarin aandacht wordt besteed aan het beoordelen van de wilsbekwaamheid door een notaris bij dementie

MPs Van Oosten and Van Veen asked about a broadcast on notaries assessing testamentary capacity in dementia cases, and whether notaries should be released from absolute professional secrecy to report suspected abuse. The government answered that notaries already have a duty to investigate such suspicions under professional rules and case law, can use a KNB reporting protocol, and that pilots on preventing financial exploitation of the elderly run until end 2014.
It is the notary's natural task to provide legal protection to his clients regarding the content and legal consequences of an intended legal act.
Het is de natuurlijke taak van de notaris om aan zijn cliënten rechtsbescherming te bieden ten aanzien van de inhoud en de rechtsgevolgen van een voorgenomen rechtshandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Van Oosten en Van der Steur over de civiele aansprakelijkheid van de Staat der Nederlanden bij militaire uitzendingen

Three VVD MPs asked whether the Supreme Court's 6 September 2013 rulings on State civil liability for the Srebrenica deployment affect future military deployments, local staff, command structures, the Bakker commission framework, and whether such liability can be excluded. The government answered that the rulings rest on Srebrenica-specific facts, do not change current practice, command or the assessment framework, and that excluding liability is not possible.

In future military deployments other facts and circumstances will be at issue. It is therefore not possible to make statements in advance about the possible liability of the State in future deployments.

Bij toekomstige militaire uitzendingen zullen andere feiten en omstandigheden aan de orde zijn. Het is dan ook niet mogelijk op voorhand uitspraken te doen over de eventuele aansprakelijkheid van de Staat bij toekomstige uitzendingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veen en Van Oosten over de aanbevelingen in de dissertatie van mr.dr. R.P. Wijne

Two VVD MPs asked the health and justice ministers about recommendations in a dissertation by R.P. Wijne on easing patients' civil claims for avoidable harm, including reversing the burden of proof and presuming consent violations. The minister replied that the pending Wet kwaliteit, klachten en geschillen zorg already offers a low-threshold compensation route and incident-disclosure duty, and that the government will first assess its effects before considering further changes to the patient's evidentiary position.

We first want to see what the effects of the Wet kwaliteit, klachten en geschillen zorg bill are, before considering whether, and if so which, further improvement of the patient's evidentiary position is necessary.

Wij willen eerst bezien wat de effecten zijn van het wetsvoorstel Wet kwaliteit, klachten en geschillen zorg, alvorens te beschouwen of – en zo ja welke – verdere verbetering van de bewijspositie van de patiënt noodzakelijk is.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Oosten, Recourt en De Wit over een ontslagen notaris die als kandidaat op zijn eigen kantoor verder werkt

MPs asked why a notary struck from the office could re-register as a candidate notary and continue working at his own firm, and whether the law should be amended to close this gap. The minister answered that the candidate notary works under a notary's responsibility, that disciplinary and supervisory tools already address such cases, and that amending the law is not warranted given pending appeal proceedings.
Supervision and disciplinary law are therefore effective instruments to intervene in situations like this.
Het toezicht en het tuchtrecht zijn dus effectieve instrumenten om in situaties als deze in te grijpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Caluwé en Van Oosten over interlandelijke adopties uit Ethiopië

Two VVD MPs asked whether Wereldkinderen, which receives MFS-II development funds, financed intercountry adoptions in Ethiopia exposed by Brandpunt, and what the government will do about adoption procedures and the legal status of adoptions obtained irregularly. The state secretary answered that the adoptions predate MFS-II funding, that adoption agencies receive no government money, and that existing safeguards suffice, with no new action planned.
In view of these measures, it is not necessary to take action now.
Gelet op deze maatregelen is het niet noodzakelijk om nu actie te ondernemen.

Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Ziengs over het vonnis van de Rechtbank Noord-Nederland d.d. 20 februari 2013 en daaropvolgende publicaties op de website van VNO-NCW d.d. 21 februari 2013 inzake acquisitiefrau

MPs Van Oosten and Ziengs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a court ruling on acquisition fraud and VNO-NCW's call for political action, including whether legislation should protect small businesses as consumers are protected. The minister reported the damage figures, outlined preventive and enforcement measures, declined comment on the pending case, and said EU-wide action is preferred over national legislation, with alternatives still being explored.
Since the period for appeal in this court case is still running, I refrain from substantive comment on this ruling.
Aangezien de termijn voor hoger beroep in deze rechtszaak nog loopt, onthoud ik mij van inhoudelijk commentaar op deze uitspraak.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van der Burg, Van Oosten en Tellegen over de opening van een babyhuis met vondelingenkamer te Dordrecht

MPs from the VVD asked the state secretaries about a baby house with a foundling chamber in Dordrecht, including whether leaving a newborn there is punishable, whether the initiator could be prosecuted for incitement, quality and supervision criteria, and comparisons with other countries. The government answered that leaving a newborn in such a chamber is punishable, that the baby house conflicts with the Criminal Code and children's rights, and that existing confidential-birth and temporary-care options remain the proper route.
Answering the question about quality criteria and supervision for such a baby house is therefore not relevant.
Beantwoording van de vraag naar kwaliteitscriteria en toezicht voor een dergelijk babyhuis is daarom niet aan de orde.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Karabulut over de uitwerking van amendement 32418, nr. 15 over de samenvoeging van vorderingen ter berekening van de vergoeding van buitengerechtelijke incassokosten

MPs Van Oosten and Karabulut asked whether the amendment on combining claims for extrajudicial collection costs leads to higher costs for consumers than intended, and whether repair is needed. The minister denies this, arguing the amendment means one reminder for multiple claims, lowering costs in the example given, and that the current rules balance creditor and debtor interests.
The image that the amendment leads to higher collection costs is therefore not correct.
Het beeld derhalve dat het amendement tot hogere incassokosten leidt, is niet juist.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Oosten over aanpassing faillissementsrecht

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether Dutch insolvency law unduly protects creditors, harming competitiveness and allowing minority creditors to block rescue plans, and whether the law should change. The minister acknowledged the concern, announced a broad insolvency law reform programme including forced binding settlements against holdout creditors, and said Parliament would be informed in spring.

I recognise that picture and have therefore announced in the aforementioned letter that legislation will come that provides for the possibility of a settlement that can be imposed on obstructive individual creditors.

Ik herken dat beeld en heb daarom in de voornoemde brief aangekondigd dat er wetgeving komt die voorziet in de mogelijkheid van een akkoord dat dwingend opgelegd kan worden aan dwarsliggende individuele schuldeisers.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Oosten over de oude economische eigendomsrechten

An MP asked the ministers of Justice and Finance about problems with old economic property transfers (koop without levering), including revocable powers of attorney lapsing on bankruptcy, the cost of the art. 2:23c BW procedure, and possible remedies. The government answered that buyers bear the risks of this chosen form, that the procedure is a deliberate safeguard, and that it opposes an amnesty for these fiscal constructions.
I am therefore not in favour of an amnesty scheme, as advocated by the KNB.
Ik ben daarom ook geen voorstander van een amnestieregeling, zoals bepleit door de KNB.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Potters en Van Oosten over het te laag vaststellen van de beslagvrije voet door onder andere deurwaarders

MPs Potters and Van Oosten asked the state secretary for Justice and Security about the National Ombudsman's view that bailiffs and government bodies set the protected minimum (beslagvrije voet) too low, and what measures would be taken. The secretary acknowledged the ombudsman's report, placed the duty to supply information mainly on debtors, and said talks with the ministry of Social Affairs and the bailiffs' association on a debt-register feasibility study would be reported early next year.
The outcomes of this consultation will presumably be reported to your House early next year as part of the cabinet response to the aforementioned report.
Over de uitkomsten van dit overleg zal uw Kamer naar verwachting begin volgend jaar worden bericht in het kader van de kabinetsreactie op het genoemde rapport.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van der Steur en Van Oosten over de straf- en civielrechtelijke verjaringstermijnen bij diefstal in het algemeen en kunstroof in het bijzonder

MPs Van der Steur and Van Oosten asked the Minister of Security and Justice about criminal and civil limitation periods for theft in general and art theft in particular, following the Kunsthal and Noortman thefts. The minister explained the 12-to-24-year criminal limitation periods, the 20-year civil acquisitive prescription that does not run in favour of a concealing thief, and comparisons with other EU states and US states, and said he does not intend to change the rules.
Since the answers to questions under 2 show that neither the thief nor the receiver becomes owner of the stolen item, I do not intend to change the rules on limitation periods.
Nu uit de beantwoording van de vragen onder 2 blijkt dat de dief noch de heler eigenaar wordt van de gestolen zaak, ben ik niet voornemens de regels met betrekking tot verjaring te wijzigen.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Patijn over criminele netwerken en arbeidsuitbuiting

An MP asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers about criminal family networks in Zaanstad, mortgage and property fraud, labour exploitation of migrants, and related regulation. The government answered that it cannot disclose ongoing police matters, points to RIEC support, a fenomeentafel, planned legal changes and studies, and says existing tools for overcrowding and labour-exploitation enforcement are adequate, while promising further briefings in 2026.
Due to the confidentiality of ongoing police cases, it is not possible to address whether there are more municipalities where one or a small number of persons lead criminal pyramid structures.

Wegens de vertrouwelijkheid van lopende politiezaken kan er niet worden ingegaan op de vraag of er meer gemeenten zijn waar één of een klein aantal personen aan het hoofd staat van criminele piramidestructuren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over de overname van Zivver door een Amerikaans bedrijf

An MP asks the government about the acquisition of Dutch encrypted email provider Zivver by a US company, raising concerns about US surveillance law, data sovereignty and whether overheid use should continue. The government answers that US law could apply and risks must be reassessed under DPIA procedures, but it cannot fully exclude data reaching US or Israeli hands, leaves the decision on continued use to individual departments, and says existing investment screening laws do not cover Zivver, while promising no specific new oversight measure beyond reviewing risk analyses and exploring a sovereign cloud.
The cabinet currently has no indications that data held by the government ends up in the US or Israel in breach of data protection law, but it cannot fully rule this out with complete certainty.

Het kabinet heeft op dit moment geen aanwijzingen dat gegevens in strijd met het gegevensbeschermingsrecht in handen van de overheid in de VS of Israël terechtkomen, maar kan het ook niet met volledige zekerheid uitsluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over het artikel 'Drie dagen in dienst, 19.000 euro na ontslag wegens geloof

An MP asked three ministers about a court ruling that an employer unlawfully dismissed a worker during probation over religious grounds, and about its consequences for employers and the labour market. The Minister of Social Affairs answered that courts' rulings cannot be commented on, that existing law gives employers enough room, and that no legislative change is currently considered necessary.
In view of the answers given, we currently see no reason to amend laws and regulations.
Met inachtneming van de geformuleerde antwoorden, zien wij op dit moment geen reden om wet- en regelgeving aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de inzet van sport en bewegen in de aanpak preventie en weerbaarheid jongeren

An SP MP asked the Justice and Security and VWS ministers how sport and exercise can be used in preventing youth crime and strengthening resilience, and whether VWS and sport programmes will be involved. The minister answered that sport is a supporting element rather than a proven standalone intervention, that AJB is the proven example, and that no further intensification is planned.
I therefore see no reason to intensify this further.
Ik zie nu dan ook geen reden om dit verder te intensiveren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over het uitblijven van actie bij seksadvertentiewebsites met ernstige vermoedens van uitbuiting

MPs Bikker and others asked why no action has been taken against sex-advertising websites with serious suspicions of exploitation, including the lack of a legal age-verification obligation despite an adopted motion. The Minister says a working group and a WODC study are underway, a plan of action will follow in 2026, and no national age-verification law is planned yet, while acknowledging the platforms' shortcomings.
For this reason I want to complete the process with the police, the Public Prosecution Service and the G4 municipalities and await the results of the WODC study mentioned above.
Om deze reden wil ik het traject met de politie, het OM en de G4-gemeenten doorlopen en de resultaten van het hierboven genoemde WODC onderzoek afwachten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Krul  en Diederik van Dijk over het bericht 'Coöperatie Laatste Wil komt met nieuwe  levenseindemethode'

MPs Bikker, Krul and Diederik van Dijk asked the State Secretary for Health and the Minister of Justice about the Coöperatie Laatste Wil's new assisted-dying method, its risks for vulnerable people, and possible legal action. The government called the dissemination of suicide methods undesirable, said it is checking whether the activities are criminal under article 294 Sr, declined to confirm any ongoing investigations, and said the prosecutor would act if criminal limits are crossed while the minister sees no reason to use a special instruction power.
In general, the Minister of Justice and Security can neither confirm nor deny whether criminal investigations are ongoing against certain natural or legal persons.
In zijn algemeenheid geldt dat de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid kan bevestigen noch ontkennen of tegen bepaalde natuurlijke of rechtspersonen strafrechtelijke onderzoeken lopen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Abassi over racisme en geweld na duel tussen Spakenburg en Kozakken Boys El Azzouti en familie belaagd door fans

An MP asked the Justice Minister about racist abuse and violence against a footballer's family after a match, whether police acted, the number of discrimination reports in sport, and whether minimum sanctions, stadium bans, cameras, an independent reporting point and structural funding should be pursued with the KNVB. The minister condemned the incidents, declined to comment on the police investigation, pointed to existing programmes (OVIVI, ADV reporting, the planned ISN integrity centre) and said reporting is already available but gave no new sanctions framework or structural funding commitment.
As usual, I make no statements on the content or progress of individual criminal investigations.
Zoals gebruikelijk doe ik geen uitspraken over de inhoud of voortgang van individuele opsporingsonderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krul en Straatman over het bericht 'Tabakssmokkel en nepsigaretten schaden Nederlandse verkopers'

MPs Krul and Straatman (CDA) asked about reports of rising illegal cigarette trade, smuggling, illegal production, online sales and excise policy. The government answered with survey data, enforcement measures and EU excise harmonisation plans, but made no firm commitments on new accijns increases.
It is up to the next cabinet to decide on changes to the excise duty.
Het is aan het volgende kabinet om te besluiten over te gaan tot wijzigingen ten aanzien van de accijns.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over de berichten ‘Leider sadistisch onlinenetwerk vast op verdenking van terrorisme’ en ‘Sadistische online chatgroepen actief, verdachte vast op terrorisme-afdeling’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security how the government responds to reports of sadistic online networks such as '764' and whether the detection, prosecution and victim support frameworks are adequate.
