The minister condemned the networks, said their scale in the Netherlands cannot be reliably estimated, and pointed to existing tools (TOI regulation, DSA, ATKM, Versterkte Aanpak Online), possible EU-level measures and victim support, promising a further letter on online extremism before year-end.
Before the end of the year I will go into further developments in the approach to online extremism and terrorism in the progress letter on the Versterkte Aanpak Online.
Nog voor het einde van het jaar zal ik in de voortgangsbrief Versterkte Aanpak Online nader ingaan op de verdere ontwikkelingen in de aanpak van online extremisme en terrorisme.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller, Van Nispen en Ceder over het Nederlandse beleid inzake strafoverdracht en rechtsbescherming van gedetineerden in het buitenland en meer in het bijzonder de zaak van de heer Singh

MPs Sneller, Van Nispen and Ceder asked about the Dutch transfer-of-sentenced-persons policy and the case of Mr Singh, a detainee in the US with a court-ordered transfer request. The Minister (Staatssecretaris Rutte) defended the binding-requirement policy, said a cassation appeal was lodged, and rejected calls to reform the WOTS framework or move decisions to an independent judge.
Pending this cassation procedure, I will continue to work unabatedly to ensure compliance with the order pronounced by the court.
Ik zal mij, hangende deze cassatieprocedure, onverminderd blijven inzetten voor de naleving van het door het hof uitgesproken gebod.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over TikTok- algoritmes en extremisme

An MP asked the government about TikTok recommendation algorithms favouring far-right content, their role in radicalisation and extremism, election interference via donations to online creators, and possible national regulation. The government answered that platforms are responsible under the DSA, that the Commission supervises VLOPs, that national regulation is not currently needed beyond the DSA and TOI regulation, and that it will pursue dialogue, a pilot with Meta, and evaluation in 2027.
The cabinet therefore believes the priority should lie with effective and uniform application and enforcement of the DSA.
Het kabinet is daarom van mening dat de prioriteit moet liggen bij de effectieve en uniforme toepassing en handhaving van de DSA.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over van het artikel 'Tweede Kamer zaait twijfel over abortuszorg met twee aangenomen moties'

Dutch MP Podt asked the government about the Dutch position in EU Council negotiations on the victims' rights directive, especially whether abortion care for victims of sexual violence should be explicitly mentioned. The Staatssecretaris answered that the Netherlands supports access to sexual and reproductive health care including abortion care, backs referencing national law, denies having opposed this at official level, and sees no need to change its position.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over het bericht ‘Nederland bezit grootste hoeveelheid kinderporno in Europa

An MP asked the Justice and Security minister about a report that the Netherlands hosts the largest share of child sexual abuse material in Europe, and about the legal duties, enforcement capacity, cooperation and reporting relevant to it. The minister answered that the existing framework (DSA, the ATKM's administrative powers, a 24-hour removal norm with about 59% compliance, and EU proposals still under negotiation) is robust, while acknowledging the problem and pointing to police investment and ongoing work on 'bad hosters'.
The cabinet finds it very worrying that large amounts of child sexual abuse imagery are still hosted in the Netherlands.
Het kabinet vindt het zeer zorgwekkend dat in Nederland nog altijd veel beeldmateriaal van seksueel kindermisbruik wordt gehost.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutlüer over de structurele overlast van groepen jongeren in Heemskerk en Beverwijk

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about structural youth nuisance in Heemskerk and Beverwijk, including whether a wider socio-economic approach and national programme support should be extended to these IJmond municipalities. The minister answered that police registrations of youth nuisance have fallen significantly in both municipalities, that local triangles are responsible, and pointed to existing national programmes without committing to additional funding or designation.
Besides the municipalities with an urban focus area, the National Programme for Liveability and Safety also provides support to other municipalities.
Naast de gemeenten met een stedelijk focusgebied wordt op basis van het Nationaal Programma Leefbaarheid en Veiligheid ook ondersteuning geboden aan andere gemeenten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over het bericht dat een beruchte moordmakelaar betrapt in cel met telefoon: ’Jomairo D. regelde extreem gewelddadige delicten’

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports that a notorious contract-killing broker kept giving violent orders from a smuggled phone in prison, and why such inmates are not placed in stricter regimes and phone smuggling persists. The State Secretary said he will not discuss individual inmates, described layered controls and detection measures, promised a report in September 2026 on intensified checks, and said prosecution decisions rest with the Public Prosecution Service.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid lid Mutluer over huisverboden voor plegers van huiselijk geweld

An MP asked the Justice Minister about temporary home bans for perpetrators of domestic violence, including whether perpetrators rather than victims should leave the home, longer cooling-off periods, mandatory help, and why bans cannot be imposed earlier after Veilig Thuis reports. The state secretary answered that perpetrators should leave in principle but case-by-case assessment is needed, and announced a review with municipalities and four pilots starting January 2026 to use home bans earlier.
I am currently examining, together with municipalities (mayors and aldermen, including the G4) and involved implementing organisations, how the use of the temporary home ban can be improved.
Momenteel onderzoek ik samen met gemeenten (burgemeesters en wethouders, o.a. van de G4) en betrokken uitvoeringsorganisaties hoe de inzet van het tijdelijk huisverbod beter kan
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schilder en Van Meetelen over het bericht 'Uit huis geplaatste kinderen uit Noord-Nederland jarenlang ernstig mishandeld'

MPs Schilder and Van Meetelen asked the government about abuse of children placed in a Northern Netherlands foster home, possible supervisory failures, the William Schrikker Stichting's repeated involvement in serious incidents, and whether dismissal, prosecution and tougher sanctions would be introduced. The State Secretary answered that inspectorates are investigating and that enforcement and sanctions are for inspectorates, employers, the Public Prosecution Service and courts, declining to pre-empt the outcome and refusing new legislation on dismissal or prosecution.
We will inform your House about the outcomes of the investigation.
Wij zullen uw Kamer over de uitkomsten van het onderzoek informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over de geestelijke verzorging bij de politie

MPs Boswijk (CDA) asked the Minister of Justice and Security about moral formation of police officers, structural pastoral care for police, the confidentiality and independence of police chaplains compared with the military, and long-term planning for police pastoral care. The minister replied that police training builds professional identity, that a broad support package including chaplains exists, that chaplains are bound by confidentiality and can be consulted without hierarchy approval, and that police chaplaincy capacity was expanded to 15 fte under a 2018–2020 agreement.
Every police officer can make an appointment with a chaplain without needing permission or intervention from anyone else, such as a line manager.
Iedere politiemedewerker kan een afspraak maken met een geestelijk verzorger zonder dat hiervoor toestemming of tussenkomst van een ander, zoals een leidinggevende, nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over meer meldingen van minderjarige slachtoffers van criminele uitbuiting

MP Bikker asked the Justice Minister about the rise in reported minor victims of criminal exploitation, the low number of police investigations into sexual exploitation, police capacity, and cooperation with Latin American countries. The minister answered that awareness campaigns, the BUIT e-learning, the Keerpunt portal and police and international cooperation are being pursued, but that more reports do not automatically mean more investigations and that capacity constraints apply.
The number of police investigations into national and international sexual exploitation has fallen.
Het aantal politieonderzoeken naar nationale en internationale seksuele uitbuiting is gedaald
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over het bericht ‘Forse schade aan Paleis op de Dam door bekladding met rode verf: “Fuck Israël”’

An SGP MP asked the Justice Minister about red paint vandalism on the Royal Palace on Dam Square reading 'Fuck Israël', including whether it constitutes hate speech, the damage and costs, suspects, and NCTV threat analysis. The minister condemned the vandalism, declined to comment on individual case investigations, outlined camera surveillance and compensation options, and said the NCTV will report on relevant developments in its threat assessments.
As Minister of Justice and Security I cannot go into the substance of individual cases.
Ik kan als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid niet inhoudelijk ingaan op individuele casuïstiek.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Krul over het artikel ‘Jongerengeweld zoals in Beverwijk speelt in het hele land: Vechtpartijen zijn van alle tijden maar er is een nieuwe dimensie bij gekomen’

MPs Boswijk and Krul asked the Minister of Justice and Security about rivalry between youth groups in the IJmond, the role of social media, cooperation between police, municipalities and prosecutors, and whether pilots, information to the House, and a criminal ban on posting victim images are warranted. The minister answered that online factors act as catalysts, described existing multi-party youth-group approaches and digital neighbourhood officers, declined a pilot for smaller municipalities but pointed to ongoing programmes, promised to inform the House on the approach, and noted a pending research report and an initiative bill that the cabinet will assess later.
It is explicitly the intention to inform other municipalities with comparable problems about the approach and results achieved.
Het is uitdrukkelijk het voornemen om andere gemeenten met vergelijkbare problemen te informeren over de werkwijze en resultaten die hierin bereikt zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over illegale gokaanbieders die zich richten op jongeren

MP Bikker asked the Justice Minister about illegal online gambling operators targeting young people, including minors being able to register, deposit money and see gambling ads, and rising youth gambling. The State Secretary answered that illegal offers are unacceptable and that the Gambling Authority (Ksa) is pursuing an alliance, prevention measures, fines enforcement, and new legislation to allow faster takedown of illegal sites, while rejecting reversing legalisation.
I find it very worrying that minors have such easy access to illegal online gambling.
Ik vind het heel zorgelijk dat minderjarigen zo makkelijk toegang hebben tot illegale online kansspelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het voornemen om ‘Antifa’ als terroristische organisatie aan te merken

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a parliamentary motion to designate 'antifa' as a terrorist organisation and whether this is legally feasible, given expert criticism about the rule of law and risks of radicalisation. The minister replied that terrorist designation rests on criminal court rulings, EU/UN lists or AIVD reports, that the motion is being examined case by case against legal criteria, and that the government will inform parliament before the Christmas recess.
I will inform your House by letter about the outcomes before the Christmas recess.
Over de uitkomsten hiervan zal ik uw Kamer voor het kerstreces per brief informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Becker over het bericht ‘Islamisering van het Westen’

An MP asked the government about a Turkish religious authority's call for a worldwide jihad, whether mosque organisations linked to it should distance themselves, and whether government support should be withdrawn if they do not. The government condemned the calls, said ISN assured it rejects them, and stated that organisations inciting violence should not receive state support, while promising further information on a foreign-funding ban and an investigation into organisations threatening the democratic legal order.

Organisations that act in violation of the law or generally accepted social values, such as discriminatory conduct or expressing extremist and hate-inciting calls, should under no circumstances receive government support.

Organisaties die in strijd handelen met de wet of algemeen maatschappelijk aanvaarde waarden, zoals discriminerend handelen of het uiten van extremistische en haat zaaiende oproepen, horen onder geen beding overheidssteun te ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over de effectiviteit en handhaafbaarheid van contact- en locatieverboden, met name in digitale context

An MP asked the Justice Minister about the effectiveness and enforceability of contact and location bans in digital contexts, including whether police can identify anonymous accounts used to evade bans. The government confirmed digital harassment reports, said it lacks data on digital violations, outlined existing powers to request account data, and committed to exploring whether further policy or legislative measures are needed.

Therefore the Minister of Justice and Security will explore in the coming period, in consultation with the organisations involved, whether the powers described are sufficient or whether additional policy or legislative measures are needed.

Daarom zal de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid de komende periode in afstemming met de betrokken organisaties verkennen of de hiervoor beschreven bevoegdheden daarvoor volstaan of dat aanvullende beleidsmatige of wetgevende maatregelen nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over het bericht 'Jongeren verslaafd aan online gokken kloppen massaal aan voor hulp: 'Soms al vanaf 16 jaar’

An MP asks the Justice and Health ministers about reports that young people, some from age 16, are seeking help for online gambling addiction, including in regions outside the Randstad, and what is being done. The government answers that minors' online gambling has risen sharply in 2025, that the Ksa is investigating minors' participation at legal operators, that regional treatment figures are noted with caution, and that the gambling-policy measures and a multi-year prevention agenda are being prepared.
The Gaming Authority (Ksa) is currently conducting in-depth research into minors' participation in online gambling at legal providers.
Momenteel doet de Kansspelautoriteit (Ksa) verdiepend onderzoek naar deelname van minderjarigen aan online kansspelen bij legale aanbieders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over het voorkomen van een terroristische aanslag met een drone op politici in België

An MP asked whether a drone-borne jihadist plot against Belgian Prime Minister De Wever signals similar threats in the Netherlands, whether monitoring and counter-drone measures exist, and whether regulation and EU cooperation are adequate. The Minister says the threat of drone attacks has not increased, that counter-drone measures and protocols exist but will not be detailed publicly, that the AIVD cannot confirm ongoing investigations, and that the matter was raised at the October JBZ Council.
For security reasons I never make public statements about this.
Vanwege veiligheidsoverwegingen doe ik hier in het openbaar nooit uitspraken over.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mohandis over burgermotorverkeersregelaars bij wielerkoersen

MP Mohandis asks the State Secretary of VWS and the Justice Minister about capacity pressures on police motorcycle escorts for cycling races, whether government should structurally fund civilian traffic controllers, the status of the national guideline and the local allocation of police. The government answers that event organisers and the competent local authority are responsible, that structural funding is not a national responsibility, that the guideline subsidy was only recently paid, and that local allocation is deliberately kept with the competent authority.
Responsibility for the safe and orderly conduct of cycling races lies with the organiser of the event.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor een veilig en ordelijk verloop van wielerwedstrijden ligt bij de organisator van het evenement.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over de gevolgen van de hack bij het OM op de bedrijfsvoering

An MP asked the Justice Minister about the effects of the hack at the Public Prosecution Service (OM) on its operations, including remote-work limits, backlogs, past cuts to ICT funding, and a possible further 40 million euro saving. The minister said remote work resumed on 16 October, backlogs are being worked off without a timeline, ICT was heavily funded in recent years, and the OM has signalled a future financial gap that is still being assessed.
At this moment I cannot yet make statements about the period within which the backlogs will be cleared.
Op dit moment kan ik nog geen uitspraken doen over de termijn waarbinnen de achterstanden zijn weggewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koops over het krantenartikel 'Hoe minister Yeşilgöz in 2022 KPMG inschakelde en interne juristen omzeild werden in de crisis rond Ter Apel'

An MP asks the Justice Minister about a newspaper report that KPMG was hired in 2022 and that the legal directorate DWJZ was bypassed in the Ter Apel asylum crisis, questioning whether the letter of 26 August 2022 and proposed measures were properly prepared and legally sound. The government answers that DWJZ was not involved in drafting the letter due to the speed of the process but had regular contact, denies that Parliament was misinformed, explains KPMG's role was limited to process support on a measures list, and provides the requested documents.
Due to the speed of the process, DWJZ was not involved in drafting the letter of 26 August 2022.
In de snelheid van het proces is DWJZ niet betrokken geweest bij het opstellen van de brief van 26 augustus 2022.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over onveilige plekken voor vrouwen

Mutluer asks why reports and complaints by women about unsafe places often go unaddressed by police and municipalities, what will be done, and whether capacity and funding are sufficient. Minister Van Oosten answers that municipalities and police take these seriously, that the VNG will examine bottlenecks, that police capacity in sex-crime teams is 46 fte short, and that CPTED support and programmes like Veilige Steden exist, with reporting promised through existing channels.
I will keep your House informed of progress on the various tracks through several channels.
Ik zal uw Kamer via verschillende wegen op de hoogte houden van de voortgang van de verschillende trajecten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over Europese ontwikkelingen rondom chatcontrole

An MP asked the Justice Minister about the EU CSAM regulation (chat control) discussed in the Law Enforcement Working Party, whether it excludes mandatory detection, what the Netherlands' position is, and whether AIVD advice was sought. The minister answered that mandatory detection is removed and an explicit recital added, that voluntary detection would be made permanent, that the Netherlands will abstain, and that AIVD assessed the digital-resilience risks as very high.
To protect the Dutch negotiating position and diplomatic relations, I cannot share these with the House.
Om de Nederlandse onderhandelingspositie en de diplomatieke betrekkingen te beschermen kan ik deze niet met de Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Flach over de brandbrief van burgemeesters inzake de wolf

MP Flach (SGP) asks the state secretary about a letter from Gelderland mayors on increasing wolf encounters with humans and dogs, and whether mayors have enough emergency powers and whether provinces and the EU wolf population framework justify earlier intervention. The state secretary acknowledges the concerns, points to pending national rules defining problem wolves and a planned additional study on Dutch habitat suitability, but says the powers of mayors are considered sufficient for now and no extension is planned.

In consultations with the relevant ministries and the Association of Dutch Municipalities and the Dutch Association of Mayors on possible additional emergency powers, it emerged that the powers of provincial executives and mayors in principle suffice, and that extending mayoral powers in cases no longer acute would cut across the statutory responsibilities of provincial executives.

In de overleggen tussen de betrokken ministeries en met Vereniging van Nederlandse Gemeenten en het Nederlands Genootschap van Burgemeesters over mogelijk aanvullende noodbevoegdheden is naar voren gekomen dat de bevoegdheden van gedeputeerde staten en burgemeesters in beginsel volstaan
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oostenbrink en Wijen-Nass over het artikel ‘Middelbare scholen in Beverwijk en Heemskerk dicht vanwege jongerengeweld'

MPs Oostenbrink and Wijen-Nass asked the Justice and Education ministers about school closures in Beverwijk and Heemskerk due to youth violence, online intimidation, AI deepfakes, the role of social media, and prevention support for schools and municipalities. The minister answered that investigations are ongoing, that local authorities and existing prevention programmes handle these issues, and that a school safety bill and a planned increase in maximum penalties are underway, without committing to new structural funding.
The use of AI or deepfakes is not automatically a form of digital subversion; for that, AI would have to be used by criminals as a means to disrupt society in order to commit criminal acts.

Het gebruik van AI of deepfakes is niet automatisch een vorm van digitale ondermijning, hiervoor moet AI als middel worden gebruikt door criminelen om de samenleving te ontwrichten om criminele handelingen uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Olger van Dijk over demonstraties op het spoor

An MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management, together with the Justice Minister, about Extinction Rebellion activists occupying railway tracks at Amsterdam Centraal, how the government prepared for and responded to the announced action, and how it will prevent future disruption of transport hubs. The government answered that it condemns track occupation, describes contacts with police, municipal authorities, NS and ProRail, notes that pre-emptive arrest requires a suspicion of a criminal offence, and points to a handling framework and a pending research study on the legal basis for restricting demonstrations.
Completely preventing demonstrators from entering the track proves extremely complex in practice.
Het volledig voorkomen dat demonstranten het spoor betreden blijkt in de praktijk uiterst complex.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Vos over de reactie van links-extremisten op de moord op Charlie Kirk

An MP from FVD asked the Minister of Justice and Security about left-wing extremist reactions to the killing of Charlie Kirk, including celebrations in the Netherlands, a Radboud lecturer, Bob Vylan's Paradiso concert, and whether to expel foreign students or ban the concert. The Minister answered that glorifying political violence is unacceptable but generally not criminal, that prosecution and assessment are for the OM and courts, that no new monitoring or research is planned, and that tackling all forms of extremism is a government priority.
Glorifying a murder is in principle not punishable.
Het verheerlijken van een moord is in beginsel niet strafbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ergin over het bericht ‘Palestijnse journalist Mustafa Ayash aangehouden op Schiphol’

An MP from DENK asked the Justice and Education ministers whether Netherlands should refuse extradition of journalists, whether extradition to Israel is possible, and how press freedom and detentions of people suspected of international crimes are handled. The minister answered that he cannot comment on pending surrender requests, explained the European Arrest Warrant grounds for refusal assessed by the court, noted PersVeilig funding and that the Marechaussee found no detentions for suspected Israeli international crimes since 7 October 2023.
I cannot make statements about any pending surrender requests.
Over eventuele lopende overleveringsverzoeken kan ik geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Abassi over de onterechte aanhouding en de gevolgen voor een Marokkaans-Nederlands gezin in Urk

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the wrongful arrest of a 14-year-old on Urk, the handling of the case by police and the public prosecution service (OM), the lack of protection and redress for the family, and whether independent investigation and national guidelines are needed. The minister declined to comment on the individual case, stated that arrests require concrete suspicion, said no investigation or guidelines are planned, and pointed to compensation, complaint and ombudsman routes.
It does not befit me as Minister of Justice and Security to intervene in the decision-making of the Public Prosecution Service in individual cases.
Het past mij als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid niet om te treden in de besluitvorming van het Openbaar Ministerie in individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de slachtoffers van persoonsverwisseling door identiteitsfraude en de grote gevolgen voor hun leven en hun behandeling door de overheid

MPs Van Nispen (SP) asked the Minister of Justice and Security about victims of mistaken identity caused by identity fraud, including unlawful detention, the 867 cases where names on final judgments are known to be wrong, unclear compensation and redress, the integrity of the criminal justice chain, and whether Justid wrongly corrected judgments. The State Secretary answered that a plan of action, a new review framework, a simpler review procedure and an Auditdienst Rijk evaluation are underway, that some wrongly detained persons have been identified and released, and that Justid's past unauthorised corrections ended in 2017.
For all future reviews, the review and handling framework mentioned in the answer to question 3 will determine in which cases Justid may correct the incorrect name in the systems.

Voor alle toekomstige toetsingen wordt in het, in het antwoord op vraag 3 genoemde, toetsings- en handelingskader bepaald in welke gevallen Justid de foutieve tenaamstelling in de systemen mag corrigeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het niet publiceren van een kritisch onderzoek naar corruptiebestrijding

An SP MP asks why the ministry did not publish a critical exploratory study on anti-corruption policy, which it allegedly judged as substandard, and questions the ministry's claims about factual errors, missing information and the lack of progress since 2005. The Minister answers that the document is an internal record of interviews rather than a finished report, cites specific alleged inaccuracies and omissions, defends the redactions, and declines to criminalise trading in influence for now while pointing to the forthcoming EU corruption directive.
Although the document, because of its layout and title, looks like a finished report, it is an internal record of conversations held.
Hoewel het document vanwege de aangebrachte opmaak en titel oogt als een afgerond rapport, is het een interne verslaglegging van gevoerde gesprekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Abassi over de berichtgeving omtrent uitlatingen van de heer Wilders die door de politie zijn weersproken

An MP asked the Justice Minister about police publicly disputing Wilders' claim of a mistreated garbage collector in Utrecht, asking whether this was misleading the Chamber, whether politicians should be held to accuracy, and whether police guidelines are needed. The minister answered that MPs choose their own words and are responsible for them, that no police information was involved, and declined to comment on the individual case.
MPs are free to choose their own words.
Het staat Kamerleden vrij om hun eigen woorden te kiezen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krul over de gevolgen van het gebruik van lachgas en de handhaving van het lachgasverbod

An MP from the CDA asked the Justice and Security and Health ministers how they will respond to a Radar broadcast on nitrous oxide harms, including care pressure, enforcement of the ban, online sales and European coordination. The minister answered that there are no signals of rising pressure on care, that enforcement appears adequate, and committed to raising a European ban in EU drug working groups.
There are no signals that the enforceability of the ban is in question.
Er zijn geen signalen dat de handhaafbaarheid van het verbod in het geding is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Abassi over haatbrieven aan moskeeën

The MP El Abassi asked the Minister of Justice and Security about threatening letters, some smeared with blood and containing hateful or blasphemous content, sent to mosques in several Dutch cities, and about security measures, a possible mosque security fund, and anti-Muslim incident trends. The minister condemned the letters, declined to detail police and judicial measures or ongoing investigations, said no mosque security fund is planned and that local authorities decide on protection, and pointed to existing prevention initiatives and a forthcoming policy response on Muslim discrimination.
I do not go into the specific measures taken by police and justice, as this often concerns confidential information
Ik treed niet in de specifieke maatregelen die door politie en justitie worden genomen, aangezien dit vaak vertrouwelijke informatie betreft
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over het VN-rapport dat oproept tot wereldwijde afschaffing van draagmoederschap

An MP asked the government to respond to a UN report calling for a global ban on surrogacy, citing harms such as trafficking, financial coercion and forced abortion. The Staatssecretaris acknowledged the risks and pointed to existing criminal law, a forthcoming trafficking-law amendment and the pending Kind, draagmoederschap en afstamming bill, but rejected a ban as ineffective.
I do not consider a ban on surrogacy to be meaningful.
Ik acht een verbod op draagmoederschap niet zinvol.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Ceder over het bericht ‘Is er geen vervolging in Nederland?’ Yerani werd zondag ruw over de straat gesleurd wegens evangelieprediking

MPs Bikker and Ceder asked the Justice Minister about a reported assault on an evangelist in Amsterdam, how widespread violence against street preachers is, and whether the government will act to protect them and engage municipalities. The minister condemned such violence, said police arrested a suspect, stated no data on attacks against street preachers are kept, and said there are no signals requiring a guidance document, noting police maintain public order under the mayor.
The police do not keep data on violence against specifically evangelists or street preachers.
Gegevens over geweld tegen specifiek evangelisten of straatpredikers houdt de politie niet bij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het artikel ‘Maaike (31) werd door indringer Walid K. thuis verkracht en wil niet langer zwijgen: ‘Ik vrees dat andere vrouwen het slachtoffer worden.‘

An MP asked the Minister of Justice about a victim's account of a rape by a man whose residence status, early leave from detention and victim notification were questioned. The State Secretary answered that residence status is reviewed after convictions, early leave is granted case by case with victim protection considered, victims are informed about first leave, and access to psychiatric reports is still being explored.
Access to such reports, however, constitutes an infringement of the right to protection of personal privacy, not only of the suspect but also of third parties.
Inzage in dergelijke rapportages vormt evenwel een inbreuk op het recht op bescherming van de persoonlijke levenssfeer, niet alleen van de verdachte, maar ook van derden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ‘Geen mobiel bereik in grensstreek: 77-jarige man ligt na val machteloos half uur op de grond’

An MP asked about a report of a 77-year-old man lying helpless for half an hour in a border area with no mobile coverage, and whether poor coverage poses a safety risk and what the government will do. The minister says coverage is generally good, points to existing measures (WiFi calling, roaming redirection, the 112 NL app), reports 46 complaints with only 5 from border municipalities, and sees no reason for additional measures such as emergency poles.
I currently see no reason to take additional measures in addition to this.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om in aanvulling hierop maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over het bericht 'Bij drie gevangenbewaarders thuis een explosief geplaatst, één bewaarder afgetuigd met honkbalknuppel: ’Ernstige agressie en geweld’'

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Justice and Security about attacks, including a bomb and a baseball-bat assault, on prison guards at their homes, and asked about frequency, victim support and protection measures. The State Secretary answered that such incidents are unacceptable, that long-term trends cannot yet be established, that DJI provides aftercare and that the police are investigating, while describing existing protection measures and the anti-explosives programme.
The incidents in August in which four DJI employees were confronted with serious aggression and violence outside the prison walls are shocking and completely unacceptable.
De incidenten in augustus waarbij vier DJI-medewerkers buiten de gevangenismuren geconfronteerd zijn met ernstige agressie en geweld zijn schokkend en volstrekt onacceptabel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hertzberger en Bruyning over de onderzoeksjournalistiek van Zembla naar de toename van illegale THC-vapes onder scholieren

Two Nieuw Sociaal Contract MPs asked the State Secretary for Health and the Minister of Justice about rising use of illegal THC and synthetic-cannabinoid (spice) vapes among pupils, including health harms, enforcement, penalties, social media liability and possible bans. The government acknowledges serious concern, reports limited structured data and some local incidents, outlines penalties and enforcement responsibilities, and promises a meldpunt and further EU-level work, but declines a general vape ban as contrary to EU law and gives no answer splitting the questions separately.
This means that a general ban on vapes is in breach of European law.
Dit betekent dat het verbieden van vapes in zijn algemeenheid in strijd is met Europees recht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het artikel 'De onwaarschijnlijke val van een burgemeester'

An MP asked why the mayor of Schuiling was allegedly offered honourable dismissal conditional on withdrawing his appeal against a criminal penalty order, and how this fits with the earlier claim that no pressure was applied. The Minister denied tying honourable dismissal to withdrawing the appeal, noted the dismissal was granted even though the appeal was maintained, and declined a broader reflection while the appeal is pending.
No. The granting of honourable dismissal is not linked by me, as Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations, to everyone's fundamental right of access to the courts.
Nee. De verlening van eervol ontslag wordt door mij als Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties niet gekoppeld aan ieders fundamentele aanspraak op toegang tot de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Abassi over de programmamanager bij de politie en de betrokkenheid bij NTA-onderzoek

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the police anti-racism programme manager who also directs NTA, the agency found by courts and the Amsterdam Ombudsman to have unlawfully surveilled mosques, and whether the dual role is compatible with the programme's credibility. The minister confirmed awareness of the dual role but declined to intervene, stating that the police decides on its own staffing.
The police itself decides on the appointment of its personnel. Therefore I will not intervene in employment arrangements with individuals.
De politie gaat zelf over de aanstelling van haar personeel. Derhalve zal ik niet interveniëren in arbeidsafspraken met individuen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen, Van der Burg en Ellian over oproepen tot geweld tijdens het concert van Bob Vylan in Paradiso Amsterdam

VVD MPs asked the Justice and Culture ministers whether Bob Vylan's concert calls for violence (including cheering the killing of Charlie Kirk and calling for hunting Zionists) should be treated as criminal, how the concert was permitted, whether the UK prosecution affects visas or entry bans, and whether local authorities can prevent further calls to violence. The government answered that police and the Public Prosecution Service must establish what was said, that bans on performances require concrete serious disorder, that entry refusal is possible under the Schengen Borders Code on public order grounds, and that local mayors make their own assessments without commenting on individual cases.
Which statements Bob Vylan made will have to emerge from the police and Public Prosecution Service investigation.
Welke uitingen zijn gedaan door Bob Vylan zal uit het onderzoek van politie en het Openbaar Ministerie moeten blijken.

Legally fixing the library's function should enable the library to modernise and innovate
Het wettelijk vastleggen van de functie van de bibliotheek moet er toe leiden dat de bibliotheek kan moderniseren en innoveren
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Rutte ter vervanging van nr. 15 dat regelt dat bij het vaststellen van de bestuursrechtelijke premie een bandbreedte wordt gehanteerd
Sets a band of 110% to 130% of the average premium for the administrative-law health insurance premium, with ministerial regulation determining the calculation.
administrative-law premium of at least 110% and at most 130% of the average premium owed
bestuursrechtelijke premie van ten minste 110% en ten hoogste 130% van de gemiddelde premie verschuldigd
Amendement van het lid Rutte dat regelt dat bij het vaststellen van de bestuursrechtelijke premie een bandbreedte gehanteerd wordt
Sets the administrative-law premium for uninsured or defaulting policyholders within a band of 110% to 130% of the average premium, with differentiation by group set by general administrative order.
an administrative-law premium to be set by ministerial regulation of at least 110% and at most 130% of the average premium
een bij ministeriële regeling te bepalen, bestuursrechtelijke premie van ten minste 110% en ten hoogste 130% van de gemiddelde premie verschuldigd
Motie van het lid Rutte over beëindiging van subsidies voor buitenlandse reizen van popartiesten
Asks the government to end all subsidies for foreign tours of pop artists, arguing culture subsidy should only fund what the market cannot.
requests the government to end all subsidies for foreign trips of pop artists
verzoekt de regering, een einde te maken aan alle subsidies voor buitenlandse reizen van popartiesten
Motie van het lid Rutte over financiering van de cultuurkaart
Asks the government to pay the culture card from the transition costs of 'Meer dan kwaliteit' only until 2017 rather than ten years.
not to pay the culture card from the friction costs of Meer dan kwaliteit longer than until 2017
de cultuurkaart niet langer dan tot 2017 te betalen uit de frictiekosten van «Meer dan kwaliteit»
Motie van het lid Van Der Staaij c.s. over hoogwaardige ondersteuning van mantelzorgers

Asks the government to use extra care-support money for 2014 to fund innovative collaboration, hospital support for temporary admissions, municipal support upgrades, and projects combining informal care with work.
requests the government to use the extra money in 2014 to financially support
verzoekt de regering, het extra geld in 2014 in te zetten voor het financieel ondersteunen van
Amendement van het lid Rutte over een extra sanctiemogelijkheid wanneer blijkt dat verstrekkers van tabaksproducten meerdere keren de wet overtreden
Lets the minister revoke a tobacco seller's right to sell for one to twelve weeks after three violations of the minimum-age rule in twelve months.
The Minister may deprive the natural or legal person who supplies tobacco products to individuals of the authority to sell tobacco products
Onze Minister kan de natuurlijke persoon of de rechtspersoon die bedrijfsmatig of anders dan om niet tabaksproducten verstrekt aan particulieren
Motie van de leden Bergkamp en Rutte over de evaluatie van de Drank- en Horecawet
Asks that the evaluation of the Drink and Catering Act address the effectiveness of the raised age limit, municipal enforcement and compliance by alcohol sellers.
requests the government to explicitly pay attention in the evaluation of the Drink and Catering Act to
verzoekt de regering, bij de evaluatie van de Drank- en Horecawet expliciet aandacht te besteden aan
Motie van de leden Bouwmeester en Rutte over alternatieven voor de eigen bijdrage
Asks the government to consult mental health providers on alternatives to the planned co-payment for mental health care for 2014.
requests the government to consult mental health providers on alternatives to the co-payment for 2014
verzoekt de regering, ten behoeve van 2014 in overleg te gaan met zorgaanbieders in eerste- en tweedelijns-ggz over alternatieven voor de eigen bijdrage
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vondeling over het bericht dat 10 procent van de gevangenen ongewenst vreemdeling is

An MP asked the State Secretary and Minister why foreign offenders without residence status can enter the Netherlands but are hard to deport after crimes, whether free-roaming offenders exist, the cost per detainee, the origin and asylum background of these prisoners, and whether borders should close to asylum seekers and migrants from Islamic countries. The government answered that VRIS offenders are prioritised for return, that some tbs-passants and self-reporters are not detained and their status is not registered, that costs are estimated at 125-130 million euro per year, that origin and asylum background are not recorded, and that closing borders to groups is not a realistic solution.
It is not registered whether detainees come from an Islamic country.
Er wordt niet geregistreerd of gedetineerden uit een islamitisch land komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Koekkoek over de beschietingen van humanitaire reddingsschepen door de Libische kustwacht

MPs Teunissen and Koekkoek asked the government about Libyan coast guard shootings at humanitarian rescue ships (Ocean Viking and Sea-Watch 5), Dutch involvement, EU funding of the Libyan coast guard, and Dutch steps on accountability, rules of engagement and NGO criminalisation. The minister answered that the government has no independent information, condemned the violence, urged Libyan authorities to investigate through the embassy and EU delegation, and said it would inform parliament on request.
The cabinet does not have independent information about this.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over eigenstandige informatie hierover.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arno Rutte en Hermans over het bericht 'Vrouwen hebben genoeg aan veel lagere dosis medicijn tegen hartfalen'

MPs Rutte and Hermans asked the minister about a report that women may need a much lower dose of a heart failure drug, and whether guidelines, personalised medicine, clinical trials and the Gender and Health knowledge agenda will address sex differences. The minister replied that guidelines are the responsibility of professional groups, outlined how sex differences matter in drug development, and gave a progress update on the ZonMw programme with no new binding commitments.
Drawing up and observing treatment guidelines is the responsibility of the relevant professional groups.
Het opstellen en naleven van behandelrichtlijnen behoort tot de verantwoordelijkheid van de betreffende beroepsgroepen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arno Rutte en Hermans over het artikel ‘Zorgfraudeurs hebben vaak al een strafblad’

MPs Rutte and Hermans (VVD) asked the Health Minister about a report linking healthcare fraud to prior criminal records, including how criminal records of care managers are handled in licensing, PGB fraud enforcement, Bibob checks and vetting of managers. The minister says the IKZ findings are valuable, that licensing under the Wtza already allows refusal or revocation based on VOG and Bibob, that the Wtza need not be tightened now, and that the licensing requirement will be extended in a separate future bill.
As indicated in the letter of 9 July 2019, we will in the future further extend the licensing requirement in the Wtza.
Zoals aangegeven in de brief van 9 juli 2019 2 zullen we de vergunningplicht in de Wtza in de toekomst wel verder uitbreiden.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rutte over de berichten ‘Waarom is bekostiging e-health zo complex, het kan zoveel simpeler’ en ‘Dankzij een app hebben hartpatiënten minder vaak spoedeisende hulp nodig’

An MP asks the Minister of Medical Care about the complexity of funding e-health and whether a heart-patient app reduces emergency visits, and about why effective smart home-care solutions are scaled up only sporadically. The minister acknowledges the complexity, outlines actions such as transformation funds, a request to insurers, and a uniform-financing ambition, while declining to make the equipment a basic-insurance benefit.

I will also enter into talks with health insurers, care providers, professionals, patients and informal carers in the coming period to sharpen what would further help make smart home care a regular part of care within a few years.

Ook ga ik de komende tijd in gesprek met zorgverzekeraars, zorgaanbieders, professionals en patiënten en mantelzorgers om scherp te krijgen wat hen nog meer kan helpen om over enkele jaren slimme zorg thuis regulier onderdeel van «zorg van nu» te laten zijn.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling, Lodders en Rutte Arno over het bericht ‘Bijkleuren van tonijn brengt risico voor de volksgezondheid met zich mee’ en de uitzending van het televisieprogramma Kassa

Two VVD MPs asked whether coloring of yellowfin tuna is banned, how it can be detected, and whether histamine risks are being controlled. The Minister of Medical Care confirmed that tuna coloring is prohibited under EU additive and food safety law, described NVWA inspections and sampling plans, and reported low histamine incident numbers.
The NVWA carries out checks on compliance with additives legislation through inspections.
De NVWA voert controles uit op de naleving van de additievenwetgeving door middel van inspecties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Lange, Ziengs en Arno Rutte over automatische externe defibrillators (AED’s) in treinen en op stations

MPs De Lange, Ziengs and Rutte asked whether AEDs should be installed in trains and at all stations, whether theft or vandalism justifies not placing them, and whether tender conditions could require them. The State Secretary answered that NS and ProRail are talking with the Hartstichting about 24/7 access at the 50 largest stations, that operators decide their own first-aid mix, and that a rail concession provision on AEDs in trains is under consideration.
I will have NS inform me about the considerations it makes for providing first aid on moving trains.
Ik zal mij door NS laten informeren over de afwegingen die zij maken voor het verlenen van eerste hulp op de rijdende treinen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Arno Rutte over het adverteren voor en meewerken aan maagdenvliesherstel in Nederland

The MPs Becker and Arno Rutte (VVD) asked whether the government would raise with Dutch gynaecologists the option of no longer issuing certificates of virginity, following a Belgian medical council ruling. Minister De Jonge answered that he is willing to raise it in his meeting with gynaecologists and will report on it in the next progress letter on the Geweld hoort nergens thuis programme.
Yes, I am willing to raise this during my conversation with gynaecologists in the Netherlands.
Ja, ik ben bereid om tijdens mijn gesprek met de gynaecologen in Nederland dit aan de orde te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Arno Rutte over het adverteren voor en het meewerken aan maagdenvliesherstel in Nederland

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about hymen reconstruction clinics, medical practice and whether doctors should still cooperate, given WHO opposition and risks of coercion linked to honour-related pressure. The minister condemns the practice when driven by fear, says the NVOG 2004 guidance still advises against the operation unless counselling leaves no alternative, and commits to talks with doctors and the NVOG, reporting back later.
I will therefore enter into discussion with the doctors concerned and the Dutch Society for Obstetrics & Gynaecology (NVOG) about preventing hymen reconstruction in women.
Ik ga daarom met de betreffende artsen en de Nederlandse Vereniging voor Obstetrie & Gynaecologie (NVOG) in gesprek over het voorkomen van maagdenvliesherstel bij vrouwen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arno Rutte en Van Gent over het bericht ‘Wantrouwen: het verkeerde uitgangspunt’

Two VVD MPs asked why patients must give separate consent forms before treating doctors can share medical records, and whether opt-out or broader one-time consent is possible. The minister replied that the GDPR requires explicit consent, ruling out opt-out and blanket consent, and that the GTS programme is exploring a registered-consent scenario, to be discussed with parliament.

The medical professional confidentiality (laid down in the WGBO) guarantees that everyone can freely seek help from a healthcare provider and that patients can be fully open with their treating physician.
Het medisch beroepsgeheim (vastgelegd in de WGBO) garandeert dat iedereen vrijelijk voor hulp bij een zorgverlener kan aankloppen en dat patiënten volledig open naar hun behandelaar kunnen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arno Rutte over het bericht 'Doktersdienst zet mes in huisartsenposten'

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care how the duty of care for GP out-of-hours services is ensured after Groningen GPs proposed closing the Hoogezand post and reducing others, and whether the ACM should review this. The minister answered that GPs organise out-of-hours care themselves, that the NZa supervises the duty of care and sees no current signals of risk, and that the plan is pending in regional consultation.
The Netherlands Competition and Healthcare Authority (NZa) supervises compliance with the duty of care.
De Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa) ziet toe op naleving van de zorgplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Arno Rutte over een levensgevaarlijk chloormiddel dat nog steeds te koop is

MPs Lodders and Rutte asked why the NVWA did not intervene against MMS chlorine products between 2010 and 2016, why warnings from the US and Canada were not reflected, and about the pace of the risk assessment, enforcement and inspection. Minister Bruins answered that enforcement was risk-prioritised and carried out under successive laws, explained the timeline of the risk assessment and inspections, and declined to commit to half-yearly reporting on inspection trajectories.
I am therefore not in favour of informing your House about this every half year.
Ik ben er daarom geen voorstander van om uw Kamer halfjaarlijks hierover te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arno Rutte en Becker over het bericht ‘IS-gangers welkom in El Tawheed-moskee’

MPs Rutte and Becker asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers about reports that jihadist-linked persons were welcome at the El Tawheed mosque in Amsterdam, and whether police access and enforcement could be ensured. Minister Grapperhaus answered that no criminal offences have been established, that police may enter a place of worship only in limited circumstances under the Constitution and the Algemene wet op het binnentreden, that seven travellers' Dutch nationality was revoked, and that Amsterdam will inform the council of any decisions.
During a religious service, the police may only enter a mosque upon discovery in the act (on the spot).
De politie mag tijdens een religieuze dienst alleen een moskee binnentreden bij ontdekking op heterdaad
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hermans over het fors toenemend aantal ZZP’ers in de zorg

An MP from the VVD asked the health minister about the rapid rise of self-employed (ZZP) workers in care and its effects on quality, continuity and staff workload. The minister answered that quality obligations and inspection apply equally to self-employed workers, and pointed to the workforce action programme and the regulatory-burden programme as responses.
The Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGJ) supervises the quality, safety and accessibility of care and does not distinguish by the type of employment relationship.
De Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd (IGJ) houdt toezicht op de kwaliteit, veiligheid en toegankelijkheid van de zorg en maakt daarbij geen onderscheid naar de aard van het dienstverband.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arno Rutte en Hermans over het bericht 'Haperende ICT in de Zorg: verkeerde medicatie, foute beslissingen'

MPs Rutte and Hermans asked the health minister about NOS reports of faulty ICT in healthcare causing dangerous medication errors, asking who is responsible and whether the Inspectorate can oversee it. The minister said information exchange agreements are a shared responsibility of care providers coordinated through the Informatieberaad, that the Inspectorate has carried out exploratory inspections and publishes findings, and that the VIPP programme deadlines are being pursued with a possible deadline extension for some clinics.
On the question of whether government should take more control on this point, I will return to it in the letter you receive at the end of this year on electronic data exchange.
Over de vraag of de overheid op dit punt meer regie zou moeten voeren kom ik terug in de brief die u aan het eind van dit jaar ontvangt over elektronische gegevensuitwisseling
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Arno Rutte over het bericht 'Jongerenreis naar radicale prediker'

MPs Becker and Rutte asked whether Milli Görüs organised trips of young people to a radical preacher in Turkey, who funds them, whether security services are aware, and whether mosque financing and imam training should be supervised. The government says such trips are lawful and not monitored, that it is unacceptable to radicalise youth but no concrete action on the trips is announced, and that the imam training falls outside higher education supervision.
If persons or organisations, through their aims or activities, give rise to a serious suspicion that they pose a threat to national security, the AIVD can conduct an investigation.

Indien personen of organisaties door de doelen die zij nastreven, dan wel door hun activiteiten aanleiding geven tot het ernstige vermoeden dat dat zij een gevaar vormen voor de nationale veiligheid, dan kan de AIVD onderzoek doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arno Rutte over het artikel ‘New defense bill bans the U.S. government from using Huawei and ZTE tech’

MP Arno Rutte asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether the Netherlands would follow the US ban on Chinese Huawei/ZTE equipment and Hytera technology, and how national security of the C2000 emergency communications network is guaranteed. The minister answered that the Netherlands assesses risks case by case with its own balance, that C2000 traffic is encrypted with security audits and AIVD advice underway, and that no future measures are being speculated on.
Given the national security interests and the interests of the business sector, no anticipation or speculation is made about possible future measures.
Gezien de nationale veiligheidsbelangen en de belangen van het bedrijfsleven wordt niet vooruitgelopen of gespeculeerd over al dan niet mogelijke toekomstige maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arno Rutte en Becker over het bericht ‘'Duitse inlichtingendienst getipt dat Jawed S. radicaliseerde'

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice and Security and Social Affairs ministers whether German intelligence had warned about the radicalisation of an asylum seeker, whether information sharing with foreign services is adequate, how Dutch and German authorities cooperate on asylum radicalisation, and whether such information reaches municipalities. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the person did not appear in German threat systems, described existing international intelligence-sharing channels and migration-chain reporting structures, and said information can be shared with municipalities as permitted by the WIV 2017.
In the context of counterterrorism, information is shared internationally fully and quickly.
In het kader van contraterrorisme wordt informatie internationaal volledig en snel gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Arno Rutte over cold case teams

MPs Van Oosten and Arno Rutte (VVD) asked the Minister of Justice and Security about variation in cold case team capacity across police units, OM coordination, involvement of families and outsiders, and the use of new DNA techniques on old blood samples. Minister Grapperhaus answered that each unit has at least 3 fte for cold cases, that the Public Prosecution Service and police coordinate through portfolio holders without central direction, that families are kept informed on request, and that DNA-linking old samples requires consent under the law, with an evaluation due in spring 2019.
The decision to set up a cold case investigation is taken regionally by the competent authority.
Het besluit tot instelling van een cold case onderzoek wordt regionaal genomen door het bevoegd gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam, Arno Rutte en Bisschop over het bericht ‘Leren van geweld’

MPs Van Dam, Rutte and Bisschop asked whether police officers acquitted of criminal charges for use of force can be denied a VOG certificate and travel to the US, whether the new use-of-force rules apply retroactively, and whether protections can be introduced. Minister Grapperhaus said he does not recognise the described case, received no other signals of such problems, and that the new investigation framework could in principle apply to earlier cases while no change to VOG rules is planned.
I have received no other signals indicating that police officers face obstacles in obtaining a VOG because of a previous use of force.
Mij hebben geen andere signalen bereikt waaruit blijkt dat politieambtenaren vanwege een eerdere geweldsaanwending hinder ondervinden bij het verkrijgen van een VOG.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Van Dam, Ten Broeke en Arno Rutte over terreurvlaggen Hezbollah bij de Tweede Kamer

MPs asked whether Hezbollah flags shown at a June 2018 Quds Day demonstration outside parliament were punishable and why police did not act, and whether the OM enforcement framework or local coordination should change. The minister answers that the flag is punishable under article 131 Sr (incitement) in principle, that no arrest was made for lack of hard investigative indications, and that current frameworks suffice, with each case judged on its own.
Displaying the Hezbollah flag would in principle constitute a punishable offence under article 131 of the Criminal Code, incitement, an offence against public order.
Het tonen van de Hezbollah-vlag zal in beginsel strafbaarheid op grond van artikel 131 Sr, opruiing, opleveren, een misdrijf tegen de openbare orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arno Rutte en Yesilgöz-Zegerius  over het bericht 'Wijkagent: 'Haal dat bord met Joodse huizen weg''

MPs Rutte and Yesilgöz asked whether a neighbourhood police officer in Amsterdam asked a business to remove a sign reading 'Open Joodse huizen', how police advise on Jewish and other religious symbols, and how they tackle antisemitism. The minister says police discussed security scenarios with the business, including removal of the sign as one option, outlines existing anti-discrimination screening and networks, and sees no current growth in antisemitism.
In this case the police considered security with the business, discussing various scenarios openly.
In onderhavige casus heeft de politie meegedacht met de ondernemer over de veiligheid, waarbij verschillende scenario's in openheid zijn besproken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Arno Rutte over het bericht ‘Gemeenten gaan huurders van boerenschuren screenen’

MPs Van Oosten and Rutte asked whether the government supports municipalities screening tenants of farm barns for criminal records to prevent drug labs or cannabis grow sites, and about reviving the 'stoplight model' for police advice to private landlords. The minister welcomed local initiatives against undermining crime, said the stoplight model lacked a legal basis and was stopped, and that the government is studying the problem.
Data protection law provides no room to restart the implementation of the stoplight model.
Het gegevensbeschermingsrecht biedt geen ruimte om een doorstart te maken met de uitvoering van het stoplichtmodel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Arno Rutte over het stilleggen van een strafzaak omdat de voortgang door toedoen van het openbaar ministerie te traag verliep

MPs Van Oosten and Arno Rutte asked why a criminal case was halted because prosecution delays, and what measures prevent repetition. The Minister acknowledged backlog at two prosecution offices, attributed it partly to a court-room shortage, and pointed to a joint review and planned measures, while the court itself ruled the delay violated due process.
The court ruled that the public prosecution service acted contrary to the principles of due process, so the suspect faced an unreasonably long period of uncertainty about the outcome of his case.
De rechtbank heeft hierop geoordeeld dat het openbaar ministerie in strijd heeft gehandeld met de beginselen van een behoorlijke procesorde
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Arno Rutte over een vonnis waarbij een taakstraf wordt opgelegd na (poging tot) mishandeling van een agent

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Justice whether a community sentence after an assault (or attempted assault) on a police officer adequately reflects the seriousness of attacks on public servants, and what steps would ensure custodial sentences and higher arrest rates. The Minister declined to comment on the judge's sentence, stated that violence against public servants is aggravating under sentencing guidelines, pointed to an evaluation of the 2012 restriction on community sentences with a policy response to come, and said the ELA enforcement agreements remain in force with no known signs of low arrest rates.
It is for the judge to decide on the finding of guilt, and on a finding of guilt, on the sanction to be imposed.
Het is aan de rechter om te oordelen over de schuldigverklaring, en bij een schuldigverklaring over de op te leggen sanctie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling, Arno Rutte, Middendorp en Wörsdörfer over het bericht ‘Agentschap Telecom slaat alarm over hackbare apparaten’

MPs from the VVD asked whether the government shares the Agentschap Telecom's call to hurry a security mark for 'smart' connected devices, how it is progressing, and related questions on consumer visibility, ISP involvement, company-led certification and innovation. The government answers that it supports a European CE-type mark with mandatory minimum digital security requirements under the Radio Equipment Directive, that it has proposed this in Europe, and that it is working with ISPs and on EU cybersecurity certification.

Together with the European Commission, the cabinet is examining how to give effect to the aforementioned possibility of extending the current CE mark of the RED with minimum digital security requirements for wireless devices.

Met de Europese Commissie onderzoekt het kabinet hoe invulling te gegeven aan voornoemde mogelijkheid om het huidige CE-keurmerk van de RED uit te breiden met minimale eisen aan de digitale veiligheid van draadloze apparaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arno Rutte over het bericht 'Niemand zo vaak ziek thuis als agent in Haagse regio'

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about police sick-leave in the Den Haag unit, which is above the national average, and whether the 10% reduction target is ambitious enough. The minister acknowledged the high absence, promised a unit-level analysis including PTSS-related absence, and said targets will be set per unit with extra support for the highest-absence units.
However, it is not known how many of the 493 officers sitting at home in the Den Haag unit have PTSS symptoms.
Het is echter niet bekend hoeveel van de 493 agenten die thuis zitten in de eenheid Den Haag kampen met PTSS-symptomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Arno Rutte over het bericht ‘Zorgen Staatsbosbeheer om veiligheid boswachters’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Agriculture and Justice about reported safety concerns for forest rangers (boswachters) and green enforcement officers, including incident numbers, whether rangers should receive handcuffs, batons and pepper spray, C2000 radio access, and a joint action plan with the police. The minister answered that no total incident figures exist because of a changed registration system, reported about 70 incidents at Staatsbosbeheer in 2017, said the equipment request is under advisory review, and promised an action plan to be shared around the budget debate.
No figures are available on the total number of incidents involving forest rangers and enforcement officers.
Over het totaal aantal incidenten van boswachters en boa’s zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer, Arno Rutte en Beckerman over het gijzelen van een huurster in Groningen

Three MPs asked the ministers about a Groningen landlord who allegedly locked a tenant in her room by screwing the door shut, and whether such practices occur more widely. The minister declined to comment on the specific case pending investigation, called such confinement unacceptable, outlined planned action against bad landlords including sector agreements and possible legal changes, and noted that exact figures on such offences are not registered.
As long as not all the facts are known, I refrain from commenting on this specific case.
Zolang niet alle feiten bekend zijn onthoud ik mij van een reactie over deze specifieke zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arno Rutte over het bericht ‘Jihadisten uit Syrië en Irak kunnen spil van nieuwe netwerken worden’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that jihadists returning from Syria and Iraq could become hubs of new networks, including whether detention and post-release monitoring prevent radicalisation and whether other countries share knowledge. The Minister confirms the threat persists, describes criminal investigations, terrorist-wing detention and risk assessment, and cooperation with EU and UN partners.
Both bilaterally and within the EU framework there is good contact with the surrounding countries about developments in the threat and approach, and such signals are not present now.
Zowel bilateraal als in EU-kader is sprake van goed contact met de omringende landen over ontwikkelingen in de dreiging en de aanpak en dit soort signalen zijn er nu niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yesilgöz-Zegerius en Arno Rutte over het bericht 'Joods restaurant weer belaagd'

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice Minister whether police found no anti-Jewish motive behind repeated vandalism of a Jewish restaurant in Amsterdam, how such cases are investigated and registered, and what protection is provided. The minister replied that the investigation is ongoing, no suspect has been arrested, the prosecutor (OM) decides whether discrimination is involved, and referred to existing anti-discrimination policy and protection measures.
As is known to your House, I cannot make statements about individual criminal cases during the investigation.
Zoals bij uw Kamer bekend, kan ik gedurende het onderzoek geen mededelingen doen over individuele strafzaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arno Rutte over het bericht 'Agent na geweld steeds vaker in de kou'

MP Arno Rutte asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether there are fewer case managers available to support police officers after work-related violence, whether this is sufficient, and whether it links to persistently high police sick leave. The minister acknowledges that case management capacity is insufficient in some cases, says temporary extra capacity is being used, and states that a structural solution is being worked on, while saying sick-leave causes cannot be recorded under privacy rules.
It has emerged that with the current capacity the desired support is not provided in all cases.
Gebleken is dat met de huidige capaciteit niet in alle gevallen de gewenste ondersteuning geboden wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Arno Rutte over het bericht ‘Nederland is niet up-to-date’

MPs Dijkstra and Rutte asked the Justice Minister whether Dutch critical infrastructure is adequately protected against cyberattacks, whether attacks are increasing, and how the government keeps pace and funds cybersecurity. Minister Grapperhaus answered that he does not recognise the claim that critical infrastructure is inadequately protected, pointed to the Cybersecurity Act, the NCSC's role and EUR 95 million in structural funding, and promised the national Cybersecurity Agenda by end of April.
At the end of April this year, the Dutch Cybersecurity Agenda (NCSA) will be presented to your House.
Eind april van dit jaar zal de Nederlandse Cybersecurityagenda (NCSA) aan uw Kamer worden aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arno Rutte over de berichten 'Rechercheur Den Haag lekte anderhalf jaar naar criminelen' en 'Foute agenten te vaak doodgezwegen'

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports of leaks by police officers in The Hague and whether there is a pattern of leaking and a taboo on discussing corrupt officers. The minister replied that the incidents are separate and no pattern can be established on current data, that a full overview of sanctions is not yet available, and that integrity efforts and a culture change process are ongoing.
On the basis of the available data, it cannot be said that there is a pattern.
Op basis van de beschikbare gegevens kan niet gezegd worden dat sprake is van een patroon.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Arno Rutte over het bericht 'Lage straf door trage rechtsgang'

VVD MPs asked the Justice and Rechtsbescherming ministers about reports that sentences were reduced because criminal cases took too long, and what causes the delays and what will be done. The ministers acknowledged that reasonable-term breaches can reduce sentences, cited capacity shortages and reported measures such as ZSM, the Verkeerstoren and extra judges in the north, while stating that no registration of such overruns exists.
The court and the Public Prosecution Service do not keep records of exceedances of the reasonable time limit and the consequences attached to them.
De rechtbank en het OM houden geen registratie bij van overschrijdingen van de redelijke termijn en welke gevolgen daaraan zijn verbonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arno Rutte over het bericht “Blunders Hoornse zedenzaak”

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether the Hoorn sex-crime case revealed structural problems in police handling of sex offences, whether understaffing and outdated ICT played a role, and how victims are supported. The minister answered that the Inspectorate's findings concern this case only, that staffing matched the 43 fte formation, and that a broader study on possible improvements will be commissioned.
As I promised your House, I will have a study carried out into which improvements in the police and further in the criminal process regarding sex offence cases are still desirable and feasible.
Zoals ik aan uw Kamer heb toegezegd, laat ik een onderzoek uitvoeren welke verbeteringen bij politie en verder in het strafproces met betrekking tot zedenzaken nog verder wenselijk en haalbaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arno Rutte en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Minieme pakkans drugsrijder’

MPs Rutte and Dijkstra asked why drug-impaired drivers can go unpunished because the NFI lacks capacity to analyse blood samples, and what will be done about the backlog. The minister acknowledges the capacity shortfall, says analysis capacity will be expanded at short notice, that the most serious cases are prioritised, and that further information will follow in a letter at the end of January.
The analysis capacity will be substantially expanded in the short term.
De analysecapaciteit zal op korte termijn fors worden uitgebreid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Arno Rutte over het bericht ‘Keuzevrijheid is in het geding’

MPs Aukje de Vries and Arno Rutte asked whether limited competition and entry barriers in the health insurance market threaten consumer choice, and whether the government will commission further study or reconsider regulation and a proposed profit ban. The minister agrees competition matters, cites the ACM report on entry barriers, finds current regulation proportionate, and declines additional research as the ACM study already covers the issue.
Additional research therefore currently has no added value.
Aanvullend onderzoek heeft daarom op dit moment geen meerwaarde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arno Rutte over het bericht 'Arts doet greep naar de macht'

MP Rutte asked the health minister about reports of a power struggle at Treant Zorggroep over admitting practising medical specialists to the board, and whether this threatens care quality and whether the IGZ and NZa are involved. The minister declined to judge the dispute, said the IGZ sees no care-quality signals, supports specialist board membership with safeguards against conflicts of interest, and noted that hospitals themselves are responsible for their governance structure.
Hospitals are private parties and therefore themselves responsible for governing their organisation. I do not decide on that.
Ziekenhuizen zijn private partijen en in dat kader zelf verantwoordelijk voor de besturing van hun organisatie. Ik ga daar niet over.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en Arno Rutte over het bericht ‘Na vijf jaar aardbevingsellende staat Jannie met lege handen’

MPs Bosman and Rutte asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that entrepreneurs affected by Groningen gas-extraction damage receive no compensation for lost income or property value. The minister explained that business damage and lost income are compensable via NAM's business desk if causation is proven, with no advance payments, and listed NCG support measures such as an advice point for businesses.
Compensation takes place only after agreement has been reached on the existence and amount of damage, causation and the amount of compensation.
Vergoeding vindt plaats nadat overeenstemming is bereikt over bestaan en hoogte van schade, causaliteit en de hoogte van de vergoeding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arno Rutte, Lodders en Aukje de Vries over de problemen van agrarische ondernemers in de Oudebildtdijk

MPs Rutte, Lodders and Aukje de Vries asked whether designating the Oude and Nieuwe Bildtdijken as a protected village landscape (beschermd dorpsgezicht), including about 2,500 hectares of farmland, would restrict farmers' operations, and whether the farmland should be excluded. Minister Bussemaker replied that the designation is based on cultural-historical values, does not aim to block farming, leaves the existing zoning plan in force, and that she sees no reason to reconsider or exclude farmland, while offering a protocol with the municipality and province and awaiting a pending Council of State appeal.

I have already indicated to the municipality of Het Bildt and the province of Fryslân that I am willing to draw up, together with them and the agricultural sector, a protocol on agricultural business operations in relation to the status of the protected village landscape.

Ik heb de gemeente Het Bildt en de provincie Fryslân al aangegeven bereid te zijn om samen met hen en de agrarische sector een protocol op te stellen over de agrarische bedrijfsvoering in relatie tot de status van het beschermd dorpsgezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Lange en Arno Rutte over het bericht ‘UMC blundert met zaad’

MPs De Lange and Rutte asked the Minister of Health about a reported mix-up of sperm cells in ICSI fertility treatment at UMC Utrecht affecting 26 couples, including causes, consequences, resumption of treatment and support for affected parents. The Minister said the incident is being investigated via a SIRE review reported to the Inspectorate, that affected couples were informed and offered paid paternity testing and psychosocial support, and that a broader Inspectorate investigation into patient safety at the hospital is due in March.
I want this to be thoroughly investigated, to ensure it cannot happen again, and for those affected to receive clarity as soon as possible.
Ik wil dat het goed wordt uitgezocht, dat ervoor wordt gezorgd dat het niet meer kan gebeuren en dat mensen die het betreft zo spoedig mogelijk duidelijkheid krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schut-Welkzijn en Arno Rutte over het bericht “Ook vrijgevestigde Zorgaanbieders aan WNT gehouden”

MPs Schut-Welkzijn and Rutte asked whether solo healthcare providers and independent professionals can fall under the WNT pay-cap law, whether the CIBG wrongly used WTZi admission as a criterion, and what consequences follow for providers who ignored its questionnaire. Minister Schippers answered that WTZi-admitted institutions fall under the WNT by law, that the CIBG's letter was within its supervisory role, and that the uitvraag has been halted with no follow-up this year, while promising a fuller answer later.
