The state secretary answered that he is open to proposals within the Birds and Habitats Directives but that the Zeeland study did not lead to a request to change the agreed package, and he declined to commit to the higher weighting.
I am open to proposals to seek room for manoeuvre within the framework of the Birds and Habitats Directives.
Ik sta open voor voorstellen om rek en ruimte te zoeken binnen de kaders van de Vogel- en Habitatrichtlijn.
Vragen van het lid Houwers (VVD) en Koppejan (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over visvriendelijke technieken (ingezonden 8 november 2011).

Two MPs asked the state secretary about a court ruling annulling a water permit for the Borgharen hydropower plant over fish mortality, and about fish-friendly turbines and pumps, asking whether owners and water boards could be urged to adopt them. The state secretary confirmed the ruling, said he appealed it, and agreed to ask water boards and implementing bodies to use fish-friendly techniques in replacements and new works, while leaving owners to adopt proven techniques.
As is known, I have lodged an appeal against the court's ruling, because I am of the opinion that the hydropower plant complies with the measures included in the permit.

Zoals bekend heb ik hoger beroep tegen de uitspraak van de rechtbank ingediend, omdat ik van mening ben dat de waterkrachtcentrale met het toepassen van de in de vergunning opgenomen maatregelen voldoet.

Vragen van het lid Koppejan (CDA) aan de staatssecretarissen van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het dumpen van zware stenen door Greenpeace op Klaverbank (ingezonden 22 juni

An MP asks the state secretaries whether Greenpeace's dumping of stones on the Klaverbank, a North Sea area, should be condemned as unlawful and undemocratic, and whether direct action and financial liability should follow. The government answers that the stone dumping breaches the Waterwet, that the Wet milieubeheer does not apply outside territorial waters, that the coast guard was deployed, a warning letter and an intended enforcement measure were issued, and that a penalty was imposed, while fishers may sue Greenpeace in civil court.
On 6 July 2011, in accordance with the General Administrative Law Act, the intention to take enforcement action was announced to Greenpeace.
Op 6 juli 2011 is conform de Algemene wet bestuursrecht het voornemen tot handhavend optreden aan Greenpeace bekend gemaakt.
Vragen van het lid Koppejan (CDA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over spookfacturen (ingezonden 19 augustus 2011).

An MP asked the government about 'phantom invoices' targeting trademark holders, including repeat fraudsters reappearing after civil proceedings and whether Dutch law should follow Belgium. The minister said the problem is known, pointed to warnings and prevention, criminal and planned civil administrative bans, and saw no need for Belgian-style legislation.
For now I assume these measures provide sufficient relief for the Dutch situation, and I see no reason to consider legislation like that in Belgium.
Vooralsnog ga ik ervan uit dat deze maatregelen voldoende soelaas bieden voor de Nederlandse situatie, en zie ik geen reden om wetgeving zoals die in België te overwegen.
Vragen van het lid Koppejan (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Innovatie en Landbouw over handelsbenamingen (ingezonden 18 augustus 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary about an Italian plan to allow Pacific rock sole and Japanese schar to be sold under the name Noordzeeschol, and whether this misleads consumers and whether he would press for uniform fish naming in the EU. The secretary replied that the Italian decree requires a Pacific origin qualifier, so consumers can distinguish the species, saw no reason for EU-wide harmonisation, and said he would urge Italy to notify the decree to the Commission.
However, I will argue that Italy should notify the aforementioned decree to the European Commission in accordance with the applicable agreements.
Wel zal ik bepleiten dat Italië voornoemd decreet conform de daarvoor geldende afspraken notificeert bij de Europese Commissie.
Vragen van het lid Koppejan (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over hoge toeristenbelasting (ingezonden 29 augustus 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary whether municipalities are misusing the tourist tax by raising it sharply and spending it on general budget gaps, and whether the government will act. The state secretary replied that municipalities are free to set the rate and decide on spending, that there is no misuse, and that no consultation with the VNG or new measures are needed.
As I explained in answer to question 1, there is no improper use of the tourist tax.
Zoals ik u in antwoord op vraag 1 heb toegelicht, is geen sprake van oneigenlijk gebruik van de toeristenbelasting.
Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Koppejan (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over vertraging verliesverrekening bedrijven (ingezonden 22 augustus 2011).

MPs Omtzigt and Koppejan asked the State Secretary of Finance about delays in corporate loss offset caused by a Belastingdienst system failure, and whether a 2009 relief decision should be revived. The State Secretary explained the processing delay was technical, said applications would be honoured once conditions are met, and declined to revive the relief scheme citing fiscal costs.
I am of the view that the Tax Authority must respond as quickly as possible to applications for loss offset.
Ik ben van oordeel dat de Belastingdienst zo snel mogelijk moet reageren op aanvragen van verrekening van verliezen.

Vragen van de leden Koppejan en Blanksma-van den Heuvel (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over risico’s voor het bedrijfsleven van stilvallen kredietverlening (ingezonden 11 august

CDA MPs asked the economy minister whether tightening bank credit and the risk of frozen lending to firms in the second half of 2011 is a problem requiring government action, and what the consequences for growth would be. The minister answered that it is too early to judge a significant credit squeeze, that bank acceptance criteria had eased in Q2, and announced an increase of the BMKB guarantee budget from 765 to 1,000 million euro plus a one-year extension of the Garantie Ondernemingsfinanciering instrument.
To further support credit provision, the cabinet will raise the guarantee budget for the BMKB guarantee scheme this year from 765 million to 1 billion euro.
Om de kredietverlening extra te ondersteunen zal het kabinet het garantiebudget voor de borgstellingsregeling BMKB voor dit jaar verhogen van € 765 mln naar € 1 mld.
Vragen van het lid Koppejan (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over aannames anti-verdrogingsbeleid (ingezonden 4 juli 2011).

MP Koppejan asked the state secretary whether flawed assumptions in groundwater-based models of drought (verdroging) undermine the anti-drying policy and related water, manure, pesticide and planning policies, and whether those assumptions should be reviewed. The state secretary answered that the scientific debate is not settled, that the anti-drying policy rests mainly on ecological observations rather than groundwater models, and that no additional review is planned for now.
Given the ongoing scientific discussion and the related research, and because I have received no signals that the assumptions are incorrect, I see no reason at this time to start additional research.

Gelet op de nog gaande wetenschappelijke discussie en het bijbehorende wetenschappelijk onderzoek en het feit dat ik geen signalen heb ontvangen over onjuistheid van de aannames zie ik op dit moment geen aanleiding voor het starten van aanvullend onderzoek.
Vragen van het lid Koppejan (CDA) aan de staatssecretarissen van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de Tweede Maasvlakte (ingezonden 3 maart 2011).

An MP asked the state secretaries about compensation and nature development for the Second Maasvlakte in Albrandswaard, including urban agriculture and the 2011 coalition agreement's call for local support. The government answered that the PKB PMR and implementation agreements are binding frameworks, the existing zoning plan is a given, and it will seek broad farmer support and may use Albrandswaard as an example of urban agriculture.
The PKB PMR and the implementation agreements are the binding frameworks for the transition of the area for me and the minister of IenM.
De PKB PMR en de uitwerkingsovereenkomsten zijn voor mij en de minister van IenM de harde kaders voor de transitie van het gebied.

Vragen van de leden Slob (ChristenUnie), Koppejan (CDA), Dijkgraaf (SGP) en Houwer (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over blokkades van Franse havens (ingezonden 7 april 2011).

MPs asked the state secretary about French blockades of ports that prevented Dutch fishermen from sailing and whether Dutch fishermen in the Channel had legal rights and protection from French authorities. The state secretary answered that French authorities advised temporarily avoiding landings in northern French ports, that this advice was later narrowed to landing in Boulogne sur Mer, and that blockades conflict with free movement and a consultation was planned.
I consider blockades of ports and obstruction of fishing activities to be contrary to European free movement.
Blokkades van havens en het hinderen van visserij activiteiten acht ik in strijd met het Europese vrije verkeer.

Vragen van de leden Koppejan en Verburg (CDA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht dat de kerncentrale van Borssele meermaals ontsnapt zou zijn aan een ramp (ingezonden 31 maart 2

MPs Koppejan and Verburg asked the minister whether past near-accident incidents at the Borssele nuclear plant were classified too low and what has been done since, and how the Chamber is informed about incidents. The minister answered that the 1986-87 incidents would at most be INES level 1, listed the safety upgrades made since, explained that annual reports go to Parliament, and promised to inform the Chamber immediately of level 2 or higher incidents.
I undertake to inform the Chamber immediately, separately from the annual incident reports, if irregularities of level 2 or higher occur.
Ik zeg de Kamer toe om los van de jaarlijkse storingsrapportages de Kamer onmiddellijk te informeren, als er zich onregelmatigheden van niveau 2 en hoger voordoen.

Vragen van het lid Koppejan (CDA) aan de minister en de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu en de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de afnemende toegankelijkheid van de havens v

An MP asked the government about silting of the Slijkgat channel that makes the Stellendam harbour hard to reach, asking whether it would enforce the 2002 Alders agreement and investigate causes including Maasvlakte 2. The minister answered that the Rijk only guarantees a depth of NAP -4.00 m, that the Havenbedrijf Rotterdam is responsible for the NAP -5.50 m depth under the agreement, and that the dredging is under way while the MER found no significant effect of Maasvlakte 2.
Rijkswaterstaat guarantees, as indicated above, only a depth down to NAP -4.00 metres.
Rijkswaterstaat garandeert, zoals hierboven is aangegeven, alleen een diepte tot NAP – 4,00 meter.

Vragen van het lid Koppejan (CDA) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu en de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over dat kostbare landbouwgrond niet moet worden omgezet in natte natuur

MP Koppejan (CDA) asked nine questions about the Deltanatuur nature areas, including whether farmland should be converted to wet nature, whether designations via provincial inpassingsplannen and expropriation are acceptable, and whether alternatives exist. State Secretary Bleker answered most questions by referring to earlier letters, and on expropriation said provinces should pursue voluntary realisation and limit expropriation to a final purchase.
I am of the view that the province should make maximum efforts to realise the projects on a voluntary basis and limit expropriation to a minimum.
Ik ben van mening dat de provincie zich maximaal moet inzetten om de projecten op basis van vrijwilligheid te realiseren en onteigening tot een minimum te beperken.
Vragen van het lid Koppejan (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de plannen voor de aanleg van de Natte As in Groningen (ingezonden 24 februari 2011).

An MP from the CDA asks the state secretary whether the planned Natte As wetland link in Groningen still fits the government's revised Ecological Main Structure policy and whether Rijk funding should be withdrawn. The state secretary answers that provinces are preparing revised proposals within the coalition agreement's financial frameworks, which he will assess, and that natural policy will be jointly financed by Rijk, provinces and third parties.
I have asked the provinces to come up with proposals for a revised EHS within the financial and substantive frameworks of the coalition agreement.
Ik heb de provincies gevraagd om te komen met voorstellen voor een herijkte EHS binnen de financiële en inhoudelijke kaders van het regeerakkoord.

Vragen van de leden Blanksma-van den Heuvel en Koppejan (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Financiën en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over een onderzoek naar verantwoord ondernemen (ingezonden 18 november 2

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers of Finance and Economic Affairs about a VBDO benchmark showing smaller insurers lag on responsible investment, whether the 2002 sector code on transparency has worked, and whether the issue will be raised in Europe. The government answered that CSR cannot be imposed as a result obligation, that companies should decide themselves in dialogue with stakeholders, and that the topic is already on the European Commission's agenda.

Vragen van de leden Koppejan en Uitslag (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het in rekening brengen van kosten door zorginstellingen voor diensten die onder de Algemene Wet Bij

MPs Koppejan and Uitslag (CDA) asked the state secretary about care institutions charging for services covered by the AWBZ, citing a Zeeland study in which one institution charged EUR 39 for an extra shower. The state secretary said there were no large-scale unlawful charges, that unlawful co-payments for insured care are not permitted, that transparency duties apply, and that she would report on enforcement early the following year.
The study shows there is no question of serious or large-scale unlawful practices in Zeeland.
Het onderzoek laat zien dat er in Zeeland geen sprake is van forse of grootschalige onrechtmatigheden.

Vragen van de leden Koppejan en Haverkamp (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris voor Infrastructuur en Milieu en de minister van Volksgezondheid Welzijn en Sport over de milieuvergunning aan Thermphos (ingezonden 18 novem

Two CDA MPs asked the state secretary about the environmental permit granted by the Zeeland province to Thermphos for dioxin emissions, and about the central government's oversight role and whether independent health research would be done. The state secretary replied that the province is primarily responsible, that the VROM-Inspectie exercises interbestuurlijk toezicht and will follow the agreements closely, and that no additional independent research is currently planned beyond the province's own health study.
For the time being I see no reason to conduct or commission additional research myself.
Vooralsnog zie ik geen reden om zelf aanvullend onderzoek te (laten) doen.
Vragen van het lid Koppejan (CDA) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over drinkwater en Europese vereisten (ingezonden 20 juli 2010).

Koppejan (CDA) asks the minister whether the national norm for non-human-toxicologically relevant pesticide metabolites in the Drinking Water Decree goes beyond the EU Drinking Water Directive, and why it is set and not notified, with questions on impact, costs and the RIVM advice. The minister answers that the Directive requires relevant metabolites to be covered, that the national 1.0 microgram/l norm is a precautionary choice based on RIVM advice that is less strict than in other member states, that no separate notification is needed for one-to-one implementation, and that no extra impact is expected from existing monitoring.
The norm will however be reported to the Commission as part of the Drinking Water Decree in implementation of Article 17(2) of the Drinking Water Directive.
De norm zal wel (als onderdeel van het Drinkwaterbesluit) aan de Commissie worden gemeld ter uitvoering van art. 17, tweede lid, van de Drinkwaterrichtlijn.

Vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Koppejan (CDA) aan de ministers van Justitie en van Economische Zaken over het aantal winkeldiefstallen dat vorig jaar sterk gestegen is (ingezonden 16 juli 2010).

CDA MPs Van Toorenburg and Koppejan asked the Justice and Economic Affairs ministers whether shoplifting rose sharply last year, whether current tools and penalties are adequate. Minister Hirsch Ballin answered that reported shoplifting rose only in registered crime, while the victim survey showed a 12% drop, and that existing preventive measures and penalties are sufficient.
It is not the number of shoplifting incidents that rose sharply, but the registered shop crime that rose.
Niet het aantal winkeldiefstallen is sterk gestegen, maar de geregistreerde winkelcriminaliteit is gestegen.

Vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Koppejan (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Economische Zaken over het mogelijk verdwijnen van banen bij het farmaceutisch bedrijf MSD in Oss (ingez

CDA MPs asked ministers about reports that MSD in Oss could lose more than half of its 4,500 jobs, including relocation of R&D abroad. The government confirmed R&D moves to the US and an expected loss of about 2,175 jobs in Oss, while production stays, and described efforts with the province, municipality and UWV to support affected workers and explore the European Globalisation Fund.
As a result of these measures, 2,175 of the 4,500 jobs in Oss are expected to be lost, of which 1,000 are in R&D.
Als gevolg van deze maatregelen gaan naar verwachting in Oss 2175 van de 4500 banen verloren, waarvan 1000 banen in R&D.
Vragen van de leden Koppejan, Blanksma-van den heuvel en Van Hijum (allen CDA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over het mogelijke massaontslag bij Organon te Oss (ingezonden 16 juli 2010).

Three CDA MPs asked the Economic Affairs minister about possible mass dismissals at Organon/MSD in Oss, including requests for postponing reorganisation to allow a science park, coordination with local and provincial authorities, and why R&D sites elsewhere in Europe are less affected. The minister replied that two working groups with the government, region, municipality and MSD have started, that R&D consolidation is a global process with a broad shift towards the US, and that MSD has historically viewed the Dutch investment climate positively.
Active use of the government's instruments for innovation and entrepreneurship will explicitly be taken into account.
Actieve inzet van het overheidsinstrumentarium voor innovatie en ondernemerschap zal daarbij nadrukkelijk worden meegenomen.

Vragen van het lid Koppejan (CDA) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer over individuele watermeters in gebouwen met twee of meer stijgleidingen (ingezonden 2 juni 2010).

An MP asks the minister whether she can instruct the drinking water company Evides to use individual meters showing actual consumption in multi-riser buildings, and how this fits earlier calls for full metering. The minister replies that she lacks the power to give such an instruction, that meter installation is the water companies' responsibility, and points to Vewin model terms, the Consumentenautoriteit and the Geschillencommissie.
I do not have the authority to issue an instruction regarding the installation of water meters.
Ik heb niet de bevoegdheid om een aanwijzing te geven met betrekking tot het plaatsen van watermeters.
Vragen van de leden Jager en Koppejan (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over te rigoureuze toepassing Natura 2000 (ingezonden 19 april 2010).

MPs Jager and Koppejan (CDA) asked the minister whether the implementation of Natura 2000 is too rigorous, citing press criticism of overly technical ecological precision and its effect on public support. The minister acknowledged the complexity and public-support concern, said the detailed rules stem from EU law, and pointed to flexibility already sought through the Crisis- en herstelwet and management plans, without committing to new structural changes.
I share the concern in the article. The implementation of Natura 2000 is complex, which does not contribute to public support for nature.
Ik deel de zorg in het artikel. De implementatie van Natura 2000 is complex, hetgeen niet bijdraagt aan het draagvlak voor natuur.
Vragen van de leden Koppejan en Schermers (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over mogelijke verdwijning van de ambulancepost in Oostkapelle (ingezonden 19 april 2010).

Two CDA MPs asked the health minister about news that the ambulance post in Oostkapelle might disappear and whether efficiency would outweigh access for residents and tourists on Walcheren. The minister replied that the regional emergency care partners must apply the 45-minute norm carefully, that the norm will be reviewed, and that the regional ambulance service decides how its posts are distributed.

It will be examined whether the structure of this norm, 15 minutes ambulance response time, 5 minutes stabilising the patient and 25 minutes driving time to the hospital, gives cause for possible new insight given the high quality of Dutch ambulance care.

Gekeken wordt of de opbouw van deze norm, 15 minuten aanrijdtijd voor de ambulance, 5 minuten stabiliseren patiënt en 25 minuten rijtijd naar het ziekenhuis in relatie tot de hoogstaande kwaliteit van de Nederlandse ambulancezorg aanleiding vormt voor mogelijk nieuw inzicht.

m: Motie van het lid Buijsse over een meer geïntegreerde of gezamenlijke aanpak rondom digitalisering
Asks the government to investigate a more integrated or joint approach, possibly merging, among the agencies responsible for government digitalisation.
requests the government, together with the agencies involved, to survey the options for a more integrated or joint approach, including a possible merger

verzoekt de regering, in samenwerking met de betrokken agentschappen, te inventariseren welke mogelijkheden er zijn voor een meer geïntegreerde of gezamenlijke aanpak, inclusief een mogelijke samenvoeging
Motie van de leden Buijsse en Kathmann over komen tot een stelsel van financiële administratie bij departementen waarin digitalisering is meegenomen
Asks the cabinet to investigate, before Prinsjesdag, whether a rule framework for departmental financial administration of digitalisation spending can be created and to inform the House.
requests the cabinet to examine before Prinsjesdag and inform the House whether, using the NDS, a system of rules for departmental financial administration can be established

verzoekt het kabinet vóór Prinsjesdag te onderzoeken en de Kamer te informeren of er, gebruikmakende van de NDS, tot een stelsel van regels voor de financiële administratie bij departementen gekomen kan worden
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Sneller en Buijsse ter vervanging van nr. 9 over extra middelen voor Prodemos
Shifts 1 million euro within the budget of the Openbaar bestuur article to keep funding ProDemos outreach to young people outside The Hague.
Coverage for this amendment is found in the not yet allocated funds of article 1.
Dekking voor dit amendement wordt gevonden in de nog niet verdeelde middelen van artikel 1.
Motie van de leden Six Dijkstra en Buijsse over onderzoek naar een getrapte afbouw van digitale monoculturen en de inzet van SBIR-programma's voor meer digitaal autonome overheidsdiensten
Asks the government to investigate how to phase out digital monocultures in government and how SBIR programmes could support more digitally autonomous public services.
requests the government to investigate how a phased reduction of digital monocultures can be steered responsibly across departments
verzoekt de regering te onderzoeken hoe op verantwoorde wijze interdepartementaal aangestuurd kan worden op een getrapte afbouw van digitale monoculturen
Motie van het lid Stoffer c.s. over het heroverwegen van beleidsmatige prikkels die reparatie en hergebruik van elektrische en elektronische apparatuur ontmoedigen
Asks the government to reconsider policy incentives that discourage repair and reuse of electrical equipment and to inform the House before year end.
requests the government to reconsider the mentioned policy incentives that discourage repair and reuse of discarded electrical and electronic equipment
verzoekt de regering de genoemde beleidsmatige prikkels die reparatie en hergebruik van afgedankte elektrische en elektronische apparatuur ontmoedigen te heroverwegen
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buijsse en Michon-Derkzen over de brief van de minister van Justitie en Veiligheid ‘Informatiebeveiliging OM’

MPs Buijsse and Michon-Derkzen asked about the Public Prosecution Service's disconnection of its internal systems from the internet after a Citrix vulnerability was exploited, including data theft, backups, court delays, patching and NCSC warnings. The Minister answered that disconnection was unavoidable, no evidence of data manipulation or theft has been found so far, backups are secured, a phased reconnection is underway, and that the investigation into patch timing and audit practice is ongoing.
Disconnecting the Public Prosecution Service from the internet is indeed a serious measure.
Het loskoppelen van het OM van het internet is inderdaad een zware maatregel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buijsse en Peter de Groot over probleemgevallen met certificeringen bij de ILT

MPs Buijsse and Peter de Groot asked the minister about inspection and certification delays for inland shipping after the accreditation suspension of the NBKB, including temporary certificates, the independence of new inspection bodies and capacity risks. The minister answered that the ILT outsources certification to accredited bodies, issued 690 temporary certificates, is working with new providers toward agreements once they meet independence requirements, and is working to expand inspection capacity.
The ILT is in close contact with both the inland shipping sector and the recognised classification societies and inspection bodies to keep a finger on the pulse and to intervene if necessary.
De ILT staat in nauw contact met zowel de binnenvaartsector als de erkende klassenbureaus en keuringsinstanties om vinger aan de pols te houden en in te grijpen als dit nodig zou zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buijsse over het bericht 'Ministeries getroffen door groot datalek'

MP Buijsse asked the Minister of Interior about a reported data leak affecting ministries, including which data leaked, how it happened, and why parliament was not informed and learned of it from the media. The State Secretary answered that personal data in document metadata (names, usernames, occasionally phone numbers) leaked, that parliament was not informed because the leak was active and public disclosure could increase misuse risk, and that the government regrets the media disclosure.
Unfortunately this is an active data leak. We are still in the first phase of addressing the data leak.
Het gaat hier helaas om een actief datalek. We bevinden ons nog in de eerste fase van de aanpak van het datalek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Buijsse over de kansen van generatieve AI voor de productiviteit in de publieke sector

MPs Erkens and Buijsse (VVD) asked about generative AI's potential to raise public-sector productivity, cite claimed savings of up to 20 billion euro, and question whether AI can ease staff shortages and reduce the need for a growing civil service. State Secretary Szabó replies that productivity trends are mixed, that the government is exploring AI in service processes via the National Digitalisation Strategy and an upcoming overheidsbrede handreiking, while stating that savings and job effects cannot be quantified yet and that many pilots are not yet evaluated.
That there are currently 425,000 vacancies is not entirely correct.
Dat momenteel sprake zou zijn van 425.0000 vacatures is niet geheel correct.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buijsse over het advies van de AIVD naar aanleiding van een risicoanalyse naar de beslissing van SIDN om een deel van het domeinregistratiesysteem naar Amazon Web Services te verhuizen

An MP from the VVD asked the government about the AIVD advice on SIDN's plan to move part of the .nl domain registration system to Amazon Web Services, including the current migration status, the risks of US data-transfer rules and the options to keep the system in Dutch hands. The State Secretary replied that SIDN has committed to no irreversible steps pending the government's decision, that the convenant addendum secures sovereign operation of the .nl DNS chain, and that there is currently no reason for the government to prevent the partial move to AWS.
The AIVD advice identifies national security risks of exclusively outsourcing the DNS infrastructure to third parties and is country-neutral, therefore it does not need to be revised.

Het advies van de AIVD benoemt nationale veiligheidsrisico's van het exclusief uitbesteden van de DNS-infrastructuur aan derde(n) en is landenneutraal opgesteld, derhalve hoeft het niet herzien te worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buijsse en Kisteman over het bericht 'Statiegeld mogelijk omhoog naar €1 per fles'

Two VVD MPs asked whether a reported possible increase of the deposit on bottles to EUR 1 would burden consumers, harm the environment, dirty streets, and how collection could be improved. The state secretary answered that no increase has been decided yet, the ILT is still reviewing Verpact's studies, an evaluation of the deposit scheme is underway with results due spring 2025, and that ILT has ordered Verpact to create 5,400 extra return points.
At this moment there is not yet any intention to increase the deposit.
Op dit moment is er nog geen sprake van een voornemen tot verhoging van het statiegeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buijsse over het artikel 'Minder (gerecycled) plastic geproduceerd, zorgen over duurzaamheid'

An MP from the VVD asked the state secretary about the bankruptcies of Dutch plastic recycling firms, the sector's signals, the role of incinerators and chemical industry, and recyclate volumes in the plastics chain. The government acknowledged the problem, outlined a plastic levy from 2028, a circular plastics norm from 2027, EUR 267 million in subsidies, and said it would weigh effects in the Spring Memorandum 2025 without irreversible decisions in the meantime.
At the Spring Memorandum 2025, the effects of the circular plastics norm and the plastic levy will be weighed together, and no irreversible decisions will be taken until then.
Bij de Voorjaarsnota van 2025 zullen de effecten van de circulaireplasticnorm en de plastic heffing integraal worden gewogen en zullen tot die tijd geen onomkeerbare besluiten worden genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Buijsse over het verminderen van regeldruk in circulaire processen

Two VVD MPs asked the government about reducing regulatory burden and advancing the circular economy, including how circularity affects competitiveness, emissions and the definition of waste. The State Secretary answered that Dutch circular policy is being developed at EU level, that the national programme will be updated in September 2025, and that the definition of waste follows EU law.
A new ICER will be published in early 2025. Partly on that basis, I will send an updated NPCE to the House in September of that year.
Begin 2025 komt een nieuwe ICER uit. Mede op basis hiervan zal ik in september van dat jaar een geactualiseerd NPCE aan de Kamer aanbieden.

m: Amendement van het lid Oostenbrink over loopbaanbegeleiding aan studenten op hogescholen met een handicap of chronische ziekte
Lets universities of applied sciences offer career guidance after graduation to students with a disability or chronic illness, funded from unused regional education budgets.
For the hbo it would be good if universities of applied sciences had the legal option (not the obligation) to do this too.
Voor het hbo zou het fijn zijn als hogescholen de wettelijke mogelijkheid (dus niet de verplichting) zouden hebben dit ook te doen.
Motie van de leden Ceder en Oostenbrink over de samenwerking binnen de Doorstroompuntregio's en arbeidsmarktregio's evalueren
Asks the government to evaluate yearly, with participating parties, the cooperation within the Doorstroompuntregio's and labour market regions and keep the House informed.
requests the government to evaluate the cooperation yearly in consultation with the participating parties
verzoekt de regering jaarlijks in samenspraak met de deelnemende partijen de samenwerking te evalueren
Motie van het lid Oostenbrink over de werkgelegenheid voor mensen met een functiebeperking bevorderen
Asks the government to talk with local employers and organisations to improve employment for people with a disability.
requests the government to talk with local employers and organisations in the region to promote employment for people with a disability.
verzoekt de regering in gesprek te gaan met lokale werkgevers en organisaties in de regio om de werkgelegenheid voor mensen met een functiebeperking te bevorderen
Motie van het lid Oostenbrink over grote verschillen tussen regio's voorkomen
Asks the government to talk with regional parties so that large differences between labour market regions are prevented when boundaries change.
requests the government to hold a conversation with the parties concerned so that large differences between regions are prevented
verzoekt de regering een gesprek te voeren met de betreffende partijen zodat grote verschillen tussen regio's worden voorkomen
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oostenbrink over de toegankelijkheid van historische NPO-, NOS- en Beeld & Geluid archieven voor het publiek

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about public access to historical NPO, NOS and Beeld & Geluid archives, including copyright limits, data on refused requests, and possible policy changes. The minister answered that access is adequately secured, that copyright and EU law limit new exceptions, and pointed to the forthcoming 'Schatkamer' public portal.
Beeld & Geluid states that it does not keep quantitative data on the number of rejected requests for access to or use of the material.
Beeld & Geluid geeft aan geen kwantitatieve gegevens bij te houden over het aantal afgewezen verzoeken tot toegang tot of gebruik van het materiaal.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oostenbrink en Wijen-Nass over het artikel ‘Middelbare scholen in Beverwijk en Heemskerk dicht vanwege jongerengeweld'

MPs Oostenbrink and Wijen-Nass asked the Justice and Education ministers about school closures in Beverwijk and Heemskerk due to youth violence, online intimidation, AI deepfakes, the role of social media, and prevention support for schools and municipalities. The minister answered that investigations are ongoing, that local authorities and existing prevention programmes handle these issues, and that a school safety bill and a planned increase in maximum penalties are underway, without committing to new structural funding.
The use of AI or deepfakes is not automatically a form of digital subversion; for that, AI would have to be used by criminals as a means to disrupt society in order to commit criminal acts.

Het gebruik van AI of deepfakes is niet automatisch een vorm van digitale ondermijning, hiervoor moet AI als middel worden gebruikt door criminelen om de samenleving te ontwrichten om criminele handelingen uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas, Vermeer, Pierik, Van Zanten, Rikkers-Oosterkamp, Wijen-Nass, Oostenbrink en Joseph over optredens van de haatprediker Bob Vylan in Nederland

MPs from BBB asked whether a Bob Vylan concert in Paradiso calling for violence against Zionists and whether such performances should be allowed, and asked about criminal liability, entry bans and municipal responsibility. The minister said prosecution is for the Public Prosecution Service and courts, declined to comment on individual cases, and noted that municipal mayors decide on events and that entry refusal is possible under Schengen rules but depends on available information.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service to investigate exactly what was said. The police investigation into this is still ongoing.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie om te onderzoeken wat er precies is gezegd. Het politieonderzoek hiernaar loopt nog.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oostenbrink over Europese plannen voor troepeninzet in Oekraïne aan de hand van het artikel 'Europe has 'pretty precise' plan to send troops to Ukraine, von der Leyen says'

An MP asked the Defence and Foreign Ministers about von der Leyen's claim of 'pretty precise' EU plans for troops in Ukraine, and whether this bypasses national sovereignty and parliamentary consent. The government answered that the planning is within the multinational Coalition of the Willing rather than an EU initiative, that Nederland's deployment requires an article 100 briefing to parliament before implementation, and that no new EU funding proposals currently exist.
Once there is agreement between the parties on ending hostilities and implementation comes into view, your House will be informed in accordance with article 100 of the Constitution.

Op het moment dat er sprake is van overeenstemming tussen de partijen over beëindiging van vijandelijkheden en tenuitvoerlegging in zicht komt, zal uw Kamer conform artikel 100 van de Grondwet worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosterbrink over het artikel Commissie kiest niet tussen Landbouwmuseum en 'Hindeloopen' van de Leeuwarder Courant

An MP asked the Minister of OCW about the advisory committee's failure to choose between the Fries Landbouwmuseum and Museum Hindeloopen for provincial culture subsidy, and whether the Ministry would intervene or provide structural funding. The Minister replied that provincial subsidy allocation is the province's responsibility, that the BIS subsidy for Friesland went to Fries Museum, and that structural funding is reserved for museums managing national collections, so no action was committed.
It is up to the province of Fryslân to decide how it deploys its funds within provincial culture policy.
Het is aan de provincie Fryslân om te bepalen hoe zij haar middelen inzet binnen het provinciale cultuurbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oostenbrink en Van Zanten over het artikel Visumvrij reizen 85 miljoen Turken stap dichterbij

BBB MPs asked whether the European Commission is seriously considering visa-free travel for all Turkish citizens despite Turkey's non-fulfilment of benchmarks, and what this means for migration control and sovereignty. The minister replied that visa liberalisation is not on the table because six of 72 criteria remain open, that the Schengen cascade model change only extends visa validity for frequent travellers, and that the government firmly maintains full fulfilment of the benchmarks.
See the answer to question 2. There is no question of visa-free travel.
Zie het antwoord op vraag 2. Er is geen sprake van visumvrij reizen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Mohandis, Eerdmans, Kostić en Oostenbrink over ledenwerving van ledenomroep WNL op het VVD-congres

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA, JA21, PvdD and BBB asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether it is acceptable that broadcaster WNL recruited members at the VVD party congress while wearing press badges, and how this squares with the integrity code and WNL's statutes. The Minister says such recruitment is undesirable, that broadcasters must be careful to distinguish membership drives from journalism, that the Commissariaat voor de Media is the supervisor of the binding parts of the code, and that the membership criterion will be abolished in the planned reform of the public broadcasting system.
I attach great value to the independence of the media.
Ik hecht zeer grote waarde aan de onafhankelijkheid van de media.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oostenbrink en Rikkers-Oosterkamp over het bericht ‘Kabinet zet streep door nieuwe tandartsopleiding in Rotterdam, Zeeland teleur gesteld; Absoluut onwenselijke situatie

MPs Oostenbrink and Rikkers-Oosterkamp asked why the cabinet dropped a new dental training programme in Rotterdam and kept the six-year dental course, despite the shortage of dentists in Zeeland. The ministers answered that the decision concerns keeping the six-year duration, that starting a new programme is up to institutions and the field under a fixed procedure, that 31 places are being realised now with a new capacity forecast expected at year end, and that shortening the course would only free funds from 2033.
At the end of 2025 the next integral forecast of the Capacity Body is expected.
Eind 2025 wordt de eerstvolgende integrale raming van het Capaciteitsorgaan verwacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Huidekooper over het bericht over een recordaantal grote storingen op het spoor waarbij ProRail waarschuwt voor jarenlange hinder

An MP asked the state secretary about the record number of major rail disruptions, the causes including maintenance backlogs and ICT problems, and whether procurement rules and staff shortages hamper repairs. The state secretary attributes the rise mainly to technical faults and third-party causes, says the causes are still under ProRail analysis, and commits to continued consultation with ProRail on reducing major disruptions.
I am awaiting ProRail's ongoing analysis so that it becomes clear which factors play the largest role in the increase in the number of impactful disruptions.
Verder wordt de lopende analyse van ProRail afgewacht, zodat helder wordt welke factoren de grootste rol spelen in de toename van het aantal impactvolle verstoringen.
